Berakhot 32b:3-10: Veamar rabbi elazar: gedola tefilla yoter min hakkarbanot, shenneemar "lamma li rov zivchechem", uchetiv: "uvefarischem kappechem".
Amar rabbi yochanan: kol kohen sheharag et hannefesh — lo yissa et kappav, shenneemar: "yedechem damim maleu".

Veamar rabbi elazar: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash ninalu shaare tefilla, shenneemar: "gam ki ezak vaashavvea satam tefillati". veaf al pi sheshshaare tefilla ninalu, shaare dima lo ninalu, shenneemar: "shima tefillati Adonai veshavati haazina el dimati al techerash".
Rava la gezar taanita beyoma deeva, mishshum shenneemar "sakkota veanan lach meavor tefilla".

Veamar rabbi elazar: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash nifseka chomat barzel ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim, shenneemar: "veatta kach lecha machavat barzel venatatta otah kir barzel bencha uven hair".

Amar rabbi chanin amar rabbi chanina: kol hammaarich bitfillato, en tefillato chozeret rekam. mena lan — mimmoshe rabbenu, shenneemar: "vaetpallel el Adonai", uchetiv batreh: "vayyishma Adonai elay gam bappaam hahi".

Ini?! veha amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammaarich bitfillato umeayyen bah — sof ba lide keev lev, shenneemar: "tochelet memushshacha machala lev". may takkanteh — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "veetz chayyim taava vaa", veen etz chayyim ella tora, shenneemar: "etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah". la kashya, ha demaarech umeayyen ba. ha demaarech vela meayyen ba
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: im raa adam shehitpallel velo naana — yachzor veyitpallel. shenneemar: "kavve el Adonai chazak veyaametz libbecha vekavve el Adonai".
Chullin 60b:2-6: Rabbi shimon ben pazzi rame: ketiv "vayyaas elohim et shene hammeorot haggedolim", uchetiv "et hammaor haggadol veet hammaor hakkaton". amra yareach lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, efshar lishne melachim sheyyishtammeshu becheter echad? amar lah: lechi umaati et atzmech.

Amra lefanav: ribbono shel olam, hoil veamarti lefanecha davar hagun, amit et atzmi?! amar lah: lechi umeshol bayyom uvallayla. amara leh: may revuteh? dishraga betihara may ahani? amar la: zil limno bach yisrael yamim veshanim. amra leh: yoma name i efshar dela manu beh tekufata, dichtiv "vehayu leotot ulemoadim uleyamim veshanim". zil likro tzaddike bishmich: "yaakov hakkatan", "shemuel hakkatan", "david hakkatan".

Chazyay dela ka miyyatteva data, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: haviu kappara alay shemmiatti et hayyareach! vehayeynu deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: ma nishtanna sair shel rosh chodesh shenneemar bo "laAdonai"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: sair ze yehe kappara al shemmiatti et hayyareach.

Rav assi rame, ketiv: "vattotze haaretz deshe" (bitlat) [bitlata] beshabba, uchetiv: "vechol siach hassade terem yihye vaaretz" bemaale shabbeta, melammed sheyyatzu deshaim veamdu al petach karka, ad shebba adam harishon uvikkesh alehem rachamim, veyardu geshamim vetzamchu, lelammedcha shehakkadosh baruch hu mitavve litfillatan shel tzaddikim.
Rav nachman bar pappa haveya leh hahi ginneta, shedi bay bizrane vela tzemach. bea rachame, ata mitra utzemach. amar: hayeynu derav assi.
Eruvin 21b:3-11: Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "haddudaim natnu reach" — ellu bachure yisrael shello taamu taam chet.
"Veal petachenu kol megadim" — ellu benot yisrael shemmaggidot pitchehen levaalehen. lashon acher: sheogdot pitchehen levaalehen.
"Chadashim gam yeshanim dodi tzafanti lach" — amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, harebe gezerot gazarti al atzmi yoter mimma sheggazarta alay, vekiyyaymtim.
Amar leh rav chisda lehahu midderabbanan dahava ka mesaddar aggadata kammeh: mi shemia lach "chadashim gam yeshanim" mahu? amar leh: ellu mitzvot kallot veellu mitzvot chamurot.
Amar leh: vechi tora peamim peamim nittena? ella — hallalu middivre tora, vehallalu middivre sofrim.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "veyoter mehemma beni hizzaher asot sefarim harebe vegomer" — beni, hizzaher bedivre sofrim yoter middivre tora. sheddivre tora yesh bahen ase velo taase. vedivre sofrim — kol haover al divre sofrim chayyayv mita.
Shemma tomar: im yesh bahen mammash, mippene ma lo nichtevu?! amar kera: "asot sefarim harebe en ketz".
"Velahag harebe yegiat basar" — amar rav pappa bereh derav acha bar adda mishshemeh derav acha bar ulla: melammed shekkol hammalig al divre chachamim, niddon betzoa rotachat.
Matkef la rava: mi ketiv laag? "lahag" ketiv! ella: kol hahoge bahen toem taam basar.
Jeremiah 32:12-15: Vaetten et-hassefer hammikna el-baruch ben-neriyya ben-machseya leene chanamel dodi uleene haedim hakkotvim besefer hammikna leene kol-hayyehudim hayyoshvim bachatzar hammattara
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael lakoach et-hassefarim haelle et sefer hammikna hazze veet hechatum veet sefer haggaluy hazze unetattam bichli-chares lemaan yaamdu yamim rabbim {s}
Ki cho amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael od yikkanu vattim vesadot ucheramim baaretz hazzot {p}
Jeremiah 32:16-20: Vaetpallel el-Adonai achare titti et-sefer hammikna el-baruch ben-neriyya lemor
Ahah adonay Adonai hinne ׀ atta asita et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz bechochacha haggadol uvizroacha hannetuya lo-yippale mimmecha kol-davar
Ose chesed laalafim umeshallem avon avot el-chek benehem acharehem hael haggadol haggibbor Adonai tzevaot shemo
Gedol haetza verav haaliliyya asher-enecha fekuchot al-kol-darche bene adam latet leish kidrachav vechifri maalalav
Asher-samta otot umoftim beeretz-mitzrayim ad-hayyom hazze uveyisrael uvaadam vattaase-lecha shem kayyom hazze
Jeremiah 32:21-26: Vattotze et-ammecha et-yisrael meeretz mitzrayim beotot uvemoftim uveyad chazaka uveezroa netuya uvemora gadol
Vattitten lahem et-haaretz hazzot asher-nishbata laavotam latet lahem eretz zavat chalav udevash
Vayyavou vayyirshu otah velo-shamu vekolecha (vabetarevatech) [uvetoratcha] lo-halachu et kol-asher tzivvita lahem laasot lo asu vattakre otam et kol-haraa hazzot
Hinne hassollot bau hair lelochdah vehair nittena beyad hakkasdim hannilchamim aleha mippene hacherev veharaav vehaddaver vaasher dibbarta haya vehinnecha roe
Veatta amarta elay adonay Adonai kene-lecha hassade bakkesef vehaed edim vehair nittena beyad hakkasdim {s}
Jeremiah 32:27-31: Hinne ani Adonai elohe kol-basar hamimmenni yippale kol-davar
Lachen ko amar Adonai hinni noten et-hair hazzot beyad hakkasdim uveyad nevuchadretztzar melech-bavel ulechadah
Uvau hakkasdim hannilchamim al-hair hazzot vehitztzitu et-hair hazzot baesh userafuha veet habbattim asher kitteru al-gaggotehem labbaal vehissichu nesachim lelohim acherim lemaan hacheiseni
Ki-hayu vene-yisrael uvene yehuda ach osim hara beenay minneurotehem ki vene-yisrael ach machisim oti bemaase yedehem neum-Adonai
Ki al-appi veal-chamati hayta li hair hazzot lemin-hayyom asher banu otah vead hayyom hazze lahasirah meal panay

Vayyavo elay chanamel ben-dodi kidvar Adonai el-chatzar hammattara vayyomer elay kene na et-sadi asher-baanatot asher ׀ beeretz binyamin ki-lecha mishpat hayerushsha ulecha haggeulla kene-lach vaeda ki devar-Adonai hu
Vaekne et-hassade meet chanamel ben-dodi asher baanatot vaeshkela-lo et-hakkesef shiva shekalim vaasara hakkasef
Vaechtov bassefer vaechtom vaaed edim vaeshkol hakkesef bemoznayim

Kiddushin 70a:7-70b:14: Amar rabba bar bar chana: kol hannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo, maale alav hakkatuv keillu charasho lechol haolam kullo uzerao melach, shenneemar: "veelle haolim mittel melach tel charsha".
Amar rabba bar rav adda amar rav: kol hannose ishsha leshum mamon – havayin lo banim sheenan mehugganim, shenneemar: "baAdonai bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu".

Veshemma tomar mamon palet, talmud lomar: "atta yochlem chodesh et chelkehem". veshemma tomar: "chelko" – velo chelkah, talmud lomar: "chelkehem". veshemma tomar lizman merubbe – talmud lomar: "chodesh". may mashma? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: chodesh nichnas vechodesh yatza umamonam avad.

Veamar rabba bar rav adda veamri la amar rabbi salla amar rav hamenuna: kol hannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo eliyyahu kofto vehakkadosh baruch hu rotzo. vetana: al kullam eliyyahu kotev vehakkadosh baruch hu chotem: oy lo lapposel et zaro, velappogem et mishpachto, velannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo, eliyyahu kofto vehakkadosh baruch hu rotzo.
Vechol happosel – pasul. veeno medabber bishvacha leolam, veamar shemuel: bemumo posel.

Hahu gavra deminnehardea deal leve matbechayya befumebdita. amar lehu: havu li bisra. amaru leh: netar ad deshakel (l)shammaeh derav yehuda bar yechezkel venittev lach. amar: man yehuda bar sheviskel dekadem li, deshakel min kammay?! azalu amaru leh lerav yehuda. shammeteh. amaru: regil dekare inashe "avde". achrez aleh deavda hu.

Azal hahu azmeneh ledina lekammeh derav nachman. ayyti pitka dehazmana. azal rav yehuda lekammeh derav huna. amar leh: ezil o la ezil? amar leh: mezal la mibbee lach lemezal, mishshum degavra rabba at, ella mishshum yekara deve nesia kum zil.

Ata ashkecheh dekaaved maake. amar leh: la savar la mar leha deamar rav huna bar idi amar shemuel: kevan shennitmanna adam parnas al hatztzibbur asur baasiyyayt melacha bifne shelosha? amar leh: pureta degunedrita hu deka avedna. amar leh: mi sene "maake" dichtiv beorayyta, o "mechitza" daamur rabbanan?

Amar leh: yetiv mar akkarpita. amar leh: umi sene "safsal" daamur rabbanan, o "itzteva" deamri inashe? amar leh: lechol mar etrunega. amar leh, hachi amar shemuel: kol haomer "etrunega" tilta beramut rucha – o "etrog" kidkaryu rabbanan, o "etroga" deamri inashe. amar leh: lishte mar anbaga. amar leh: mi sene "isparagos" dekaryu rabbanan o "anpak" deamri inashe?
Amar leh: tete donag tashkenan. amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: en mishtammeshim beishsha. ketanna hi. beferush amar shemuel: en mishtammeshim beishsha kelal, ben gedola ben ketanna.
Neshaddar leh mar shelama leyalta. amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: kol baishsha erva. efshar al yede shaliach. amar leh: hachi amar shemuel:
En shoalin bishlom ishsha. al yede balah! amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: en shoalin bishlom ishsha kelal. shelacha leh devethu: sheri leh tigreh dela nishavvevyach kishar am haaretz.

Amar leh: may sheyateh demar hacha? amar leh: taska dehazmanuta shaddar mar abbatray. amar leh: hasheta shuta demar la gemirna, taska dehazmanuta meshaddarna lemar?! appek diska dehazmanuta mibbe chadeh veachzi leh, amar leh: ha gavra veha diska. amar leh: hoil vaata mar lehacha lishtae milleh ki hechi dela lemru mechannefi rabbanan ahadade.
Amar leh: may tama shammeteh mar lehahu gavra? – tzayar shelicha derabbanan. venaggedeh mar, derav menagged al man dimtzaar shelucha derabbanan. daadif minneh avadi leh.

May tama achrez mar aleh deavda hu? amar leh: dirgil dekare inashe "avde", vetane: kol happosel – pasul, veeno medabber bishvacha leolam. veamar shemuel: bemumo posel. emar deamar shemuel lemechash leh, leachroze aleh mi amar?

Addehachi vehachi (ata hahu bar dineh minnehardae). amar leh hahu bar dineh lerav yehuda: ledidi karet li "avda", deatena mibbet chashmonay malka?! amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: kol deamar middevet chashmonay kaatena – avda hu.

Amar leh: la savar la mar leha deamar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: kol talmid chacham shemmore halacha uva, im kodem maase amarah – shomin lo, veim lav – en shomin lo? amar leh: ha ikka rav matna dekae kevoti.

Rav matna la chazyay linhardea telesar shene. hahu yoma ata. amar leh: dechir mar may amar shemuel ki kae chada kara aggudda vachada kara bemabbara? amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: kol deamar middevet chashmonay malka kaatena – avda hu, dela ishteyur minnayyhu ella hahi revita desalka leiggara veramya kala veamra: kol deamar mibbet chashmonay ana – avda hu.
Nefala meiggara umita. achruz aleh deavda hu.

Hahu yoma ikkaran kamma ketubbata binhardea. ki ka nafek, nafki abbatreh lemirgemeh. amar lehu: i (shetiku) [shatkitu] – shetiku, vei la megallena alayychu ha deamar shemuel tarte zarayayta ikka binhardea: chada mikkarya deve yona, vachada mikkarya deve oravti. vesimanaych: tame – tame, tahor – tahor. shadyu lehahu rigma midayyhu vekam atma binhar malka.

Machriz rav yehuda befumebdita: adda veyonatan – avde. yehuda bar pappa – mamzera, bati bar toviyya beramut rucha la shakel gitta decheruta. machrez rava bemachoza: ballae, dannae, tallae, mallae, zaggae – kullam lifsul. amar rav yehuda: govae – givonae, durenunita – darae netinae. amar rav yosef: hay be chubbe defumebdita – kullam deavde.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: arba meot avadim, veamri la arbaat alafim avadim hayu lo lefashchur ben immer, vechullam nitmeu bakkehunna. vechol kohen sheyyesh bo azzut panim eno ella mehem. amar abbaye: kullehu yatvan beshura devinhardea. ufeliga derabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: im raita kohen beazzut metzach – al teharher acharav, shenneemar: "veammecha kimrive chohen".

Amar rabbi avin bar rav adda amar rav: kol hannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo, keshehakkadosh baruch hu mashre shechinato meid al kol hashshevatim veen meid alav, shenneemar: "shivte yah edut leyisrael", ematay have edut leyisrael – bizman shehashshevatim shivte yah.

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: keshehakkadosh baruch hu mashre shechinato – en mashre ella al mishpachot meyuchasot shebbeyisrael, shenneemar: "baet hahi neum Adonai ehye lelohim lechol mishpechot yisrael", "lechol yisrael" lo neemar, ella "lechol mishpechot".

"[Vehemma] yihyu li leam", amar rabba bar rav huna: zo maala yetera yesh ben yisrael legerim. deillu beyisrael ketiv behu: "vehayiti lahem lelohim vehemma yihyu li leam", veillu begerim ketiv: "mi hu ze arav et libbo lageshet elay neum Adonai. vihyitem li leam veanochi ehye lachem lelohim".
Mishnah Eruvin 1:9-2:2:
Makkifin shelosha chavalim, ze lemala mizze veze lemala mizze, uvilvad shello yehe ben chevel lachavero shelosha tefachim. shiur chavalim veavyan, yater al tefach, kede sheyyehe hakkol asara tefachim: 
Makkifin bekanim, uvilvad shello yehe ven kane lachavero shelosha tefachim. beshayyara dibberu, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, lo dibberu veshayyara ella vahove. kol mechitztza sheenah shel sheti veshel erev, enah mechitztza, divre rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, echad mishshene devarim. arbaa devarim patru vammachane, meviin etzim mikkol makom, ufeturim merchitzat yadayim, umiddemay, umillearev: 
Osin passin labberaot arbaa deyumedin, nirin kishmona, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, shemona, nirin kishnem asar, arbaa deyumedin vearbaa feshutin. gavhan asara tefachim, verachban shishsha, veavyan kol shehu, uvenehen kimlo shete revakot shel shalosh shalosh bakar, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, shel arba arba, keshurot velo muttarot, achat nichneset veachat yotzet: 
Muttar lehakeriv labbeer, uvilvad shettehe fara roshah verubbah bifnim veshota. muttar leharechik kol shehu, uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin:
Mishnah Eruvin 2:3-6:
Rabbi yehuda omer, ad bet satayim. amru lo, lo amru vet satayim ella leginna ulekarpef, aval im haya dir o sachar, o muktze o chatzer, afillu vet chameshet korin, afillu vet asara korin, muttar. umuttar leharechik kol shehu, uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin: 
Rabbi yehuda omer, im hayta derech harabbim mafsaktan, yesallekenna latztzedadin. vachachamim omrim, eno tzarich. echad bor harabbim, uveer harabbim, uveer hayyachid, osin lahen passin, aval levor hayyachid osin lo mechitztza gavoah asara tefachim, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yehuda ven bava omer, en osin passin ella liver harabbim bilvad, velashshear osin chagora gavoah asara tefachim: 
Veod amar rabbi yehuda ven bava, hagginna vehakkarpef shehen shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim, mukkefet gader gavoah asara tefachim, metaltelin betochah, uvilvad sheyyehe vah shomera o vet dira, o shettehe semucha lair. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu en bah ella vor veshiach umeara, metaltelin betochah. rabbi akiva omer, afillu en bah achat mikkol ellu, metaltelin betochah, uvilvad sheyyehe vah shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim. rabbi eliezer omer, im haya arkah yater al rachbah afillu amma achat, en metaltelin betochah. rabbi yose omer, afillu arkah pi shenayim berachbah, metaltelin betochah: 
Amar rabbi illaiy, shamati merabbi eliezer, vaafillu hi kevet kor. vechen shamati mimmennu, anshe chatzer sheshshachach achad mehen velo erev, beto asur millehachnis ulehotzi, lo, aval lahem muttar. vechen shamati mimmennu, sheyyotzin beakravnim befesach. vechizzarti al kol talmidav uvikkashti li chaver, velo matzati:
Mishnah Eruvin 3:1-5:
Bakkol mearvin umishtattefim, chutz min hammayim umin hammelach. vehakkol nikkach bechesef maaser, chutz min hammayim umin hammelach. hannoder min hammazon, muttar bemayim uvemelach. mearvin lenazir beyayin uleyisrael bitruma. sumechos omer, bechullin. ulechohen bevet happeras. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu bevet hakkevarot, mippene sheyyachol lelech lachotz veleechol: 
Mearvin bidmay, uvemaaser rishon shenittela terumato, uvemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu. vehakkohanim, bechalla uvitruma. aval lo vetevel, velo vemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, velo vemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. hashsholeach eruvo beyad cheresh, shote vekatan, o veyad mi sheeno mode vaeruv, eno eruv. veim amar leacher lekabbelo mimmennu, hare ze eruv: 
Netano veilan, lemala measara tefachim, en eruvo eruv. lematta measara tefachim, eruvo eruv. netano bevor, afillu amok mea amma, eruvo eruv. netano verosh hakkane o verosh hakkundas bizman shehu talush venautz, afillu gavoah mea amma, hare ze eruv. netano vemigdal veavad hammafteach, hare ze eruv. rabbi eliezer omer, im eno yodea shehammafteach bimkomo, eno eruv: 
Nitgalgel chutz lattechum, venafal alav gal, o nisraf, o teruma venitmet, mibbeod yom, eno eruv, mishshechashecha, hare ze eruv. im safek, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim, hare ze chammar gammal. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, sefek eruv, kasher. amar rabbi yose, avtolmos heid mishshum chamishsha zekenim al sefek eruv shekkasher: 
Matne adam al eruvo veomer, im bau goyim min hammizrach, eruvi lammaarav. min hammaarav, eruvi lammizrach. im bau mikkan umikkan, limkom sheertze elech. lo vau lo mikkan velo mikkan, hareni chivne iri. im ba chacham min hammizrach, eruvi lammizrach. min hammaarav, eruvi lammaarav. ba lechan ulechan, limkom sheertze elech. lo lechan velo lechan, hareni chivne iri. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya echad mehen rabbo, holech etzel rabbo, veim hayu shenehem rabbotav, limkom sheyyirtze yelech:
Mishnah Eruvin 3:6-9:
Rabbi eliezer omer, yom tov hassamuch leshabbat, ben millefaneha uven milleachareha, mearev adam shene eruvin veomer, eruvi harishon lammizrach, vehashsheni lammaarav. harishon lammaarav, vehashsheni lammizrach. eruvi harishon, vehashsheni kivne iri. eruvi hashsheni, veharishon kivne iri. vachachamim omrim, mearev leruach achat, o eno mearev kol ikkar. o mearev lishne yamim, o eno mearev kol ikkar. ketzad yaase. molicho varishon, umachshich alav venotlo uva lo. bashsheni machshich alav veochlo. venimtza mistakker bahalichato umistakker beeruvo. neechal barishon, eruvo larishon veeno eruv lashsheni. amar lahem rabbi eliezer, modim attem li shehen shete kedushshot: 
Rabbi yehuda omer, rosh hashshana, shehaya yare shemma titabber, mearev adam shene eruvin veomer, eruvi varishon lammizrach uvashsheni lammaarav, barishon lammaarav uvashsheni lammizrach. eruvi barishon, uvashsheni kivne iri. eruvi bashsheni, uvarishon kivne iri. velo hodu lo chachamim: 
Veod amar rabbi yehuda, matne adam al hakkalkala beyom tov rishon veochlah bashsheni. vechen betza shennolda varishon, teachel bashsheni. velo hodu lo chachamim: 
Rabbi dosa ven harekinas omer, haover lifne hatteva beyom tov shel rosh hashshana omer, hachalitzenu Adonai elohenu et yom rosh chodesh hazze, im hayyom, im lemachar. ulemachar hu omer, im hayyom, im emesh. velo hodu lo chachamim:
Mishnah Eruvin 4:1-4:
Mi shehotziuhu goyim o ruach raa, en lo ella arba ammot. hecheziruhu, keillu lo yatza. holichuhu leir acheret. netanuhu vedir o vesahar, rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya omrim, mehallech et kullah. rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva omrim, en lo ella arba ammot. maase shebbau mipperandisin vehifliga sefinatam bayyam. rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya hillechu et kullah. rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva lo zazu mearba ammot, sheratzu lehachamir al atzman: 
Paam achat lo nichnesu lannamal ad shechashecha. amru lo lerabban gamliel, ma anu lered. amar lahen, muttar attem, shekkevar hayiti mistakkel, vehayinu vetoch hattechum ad shello chashecha: 
Mi sheyyatza virshut veamru lo, kevar naasa maase, yesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach. im haya vetoch hattechum, keillu lo yatza, shekkol hayyotzim lehatztzil, chozrin limkoman: 
Mi sheyyashav badderech, veamad, veraa vahare hu samuch lair, hoil velo hayta chavvanato lechach, lo yikkanes, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, yikkanes. amar rabbi yehuda, maase haya, venichnas rabbi tarfon belo mitkavven:
Mishnah Eruvin 4:5-9:
Mi sheyyashen badderech velo yada shechashecha, yesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach, divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri. vachachamim omrim, en lo ella arba ammot. rabbi eliezer omer, vehu veemtzaan. rabbi yehuda omer, leeze ruach sheyyirtze yelech. umode rabbi yehuda sheim berer lo, sheeno yachol lachazor bo: 
Hayu shenayim, miktzat ammotav shel ze betoch ammotav shel ze, meviin veochlin baemtza, uvilvad shello yotzi ze mittoch shello letoch shel chavero. hayu shelosha, vehaemtzai muvla benehen, hu muttar immahen vehen muttarin immo, ushenayim hachitzonim asurim ze im ze. amar rabbi shimon, lema haddavar dome, leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo ufetuchot lirshut harabbim, ervu shetehen im haemtzait, hi mutteret immahem vehen muttarot immah, ushetayim hachitzonot asurot zo im zo: 
Mi shebba vadderech vechashcha lo, vehaya makkir ilan o gader, veamar, shevitati tachtav, lo amar kelum. shevitati veikkaro, mehallech mimmekom raglav vead ikkaro alpayim amma, umeikkaro vead beto alpayim amma. nimtza mehallech mishshechashecha arbaat alafim amma: 
Im eno makkir, o sheeno vaki vahalacha, veamar, shevitati vimkomi, zacha lo mekomo alpayim amma lechol ruach. agullot, divre rabbi chanina ven antignos. vachachamim omrim, merubbaot, ketavla merubbaat, kede sheyyehe niskar lazzaviyyot: 
Vezo hi sheamru, heani mearev beraglav. amar rabbi meir, anu en lanu ella ani. rabbi yehuda omer, echad ani veechad ashir, lo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel al heashir, shello yetze viarev beraglav:
Mishnah Negaim 4:1-5:
Yesh besear lavan ma sheen befisyon, veyesh befisyon ma sheen besear lavan. shessear lavan metamme vattechilla, umetamme vechol mare loven, veen bo siman tohora. yesh befisyon, shehappisyon metamme vechol shehu, umetamme vechol hannegaim, chutz lannega, ma sheen ken besear lavan: 
Yesh bemichya ma sheen befisyon, veyesh befisyon ma sheen bemichya. shehammichya metamma vattechilla, umetamma vechol mare, veen bah siman tohora. yesh befisyon, shehappisyon metamme vechol shehu, umetamme vechol hannegaim, chutz lannega, ma sheen ken bemichya: 
Yesh besear lavan ma sheen bemichya, veyesh bemichya ma sheen besear lavan. shessear lavan metamme vashshechin uvammichva, bimchunnas uvimfuzzar, bimvutztzar veshello vimvutztzar. yesh bemichya, shehammichya metamma vakkarachat uvaggabbachat, hafucha veshello hafucha, umeakkevet et hahofech kullo lavan, umetamma vechol mare, ma sheen ken besear lavan: 
Shete searot, ikkaran mashchir veroshan malbin, tahor. ikkaran malbin veroshan mashchir, tame. kamma yehe vallavnunit, rabbi meir omer, kol shehu. rabbi shimon omer, kede likrotz bezug. hayta achat millematta venechleka milmala vehi niret kishtayim, tahor. baheret uvo sear lavan o sear shachor, tame. en choshshin shemma miet mekom sear shachor et habbaheret, mippene sheen bo mammash: 
Baheret kaggeris vechut yotze mimmenna, im yesh bo rochav shete searot, zokkah lesear lavan ulefisyon, aval lo lemichya. shete veharot vechut yotze mizzo lazo, im yesh bo rochav shete searot, metzarfan. veim lav, en metzarfan:
Mishnah Negaim 4:10-5:2:
Baheret kaggeris ufasta chaggeris, nolda lappisyon michya o sear lavan, vehalach lah haom, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim omrim, terae vattechilla. baheret kachatzi geris veen bah kelum, nolda vaheret kachatzi geris uvah saara achat, hare zo lehasegir. baheret kachatzi geris uvah saara achat, nolda vaheret kachatzi geris uvah saara achat, hare zo lehasegir. baheret kachatzi geris uvah shete searot, nolda vaheret kachatzi geris uvah saara achat, hare zo lehasegir: 
Baheret kachatzi geris veen bah kelum, nolda vaheret kachatzi geris uvah shete searot, hare zo lehachelit, mippene sheamru, im baheret kadma lesear lavan, tame. veim sear lavan kadam levaheret, tahor. veim safek, tame. verabbi yehoshua kiha: 
Kol sefek negaim tahor, chutz mizze, veod acher. veeze, ze mi shehayta vo baheret kaggeris vehisgirah, besof shavua vahare hi kassela, safek shehi hi, safek sheacheret baa tachteha, tame: 
Hechlito vesear lavan, halach sear lavan vechazar sear lavan, vechen bemichya uvefisyon, battechilla ubbesof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, hare hi chemo shehayta. hechlito vemichya, vehalcha hammichya vechazra hammichya. vechen besear lavan uvefisyon, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, hare hi chemo shehayta. hechlito vefisyon, halach happisyon vechazar happisyon. vechen besear lavan, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, hare hi chemot shehayta:
Mishnah Negaim 4:6-9:
Baheret kaggeris uvah michya chaadasha vesear lavan betoch hammichya, halcha hammichya, temea mippene sear lavan. halach sear lavan, tame mippene hammichya. rabbi shimon metaher, mippene shello hafachattu habbaheret. baheret, hi umichyatah kaggeris, vesear lavan betoch habbaheret, halcha hammichya, temea mippene sear lavan. halach sear lavan, tame mippene hammichya. rabbi shimon metaher, mippene shello hafachattu vaheret kaggeris. umode, sheim yesh bimkom sear lavan kaggeris, shehu tame: 
Baheret uvah michya ufisyon, halcha hammichya, temea mippene happisyon. halach happisyon, temea mippene hammichya. vechen besear lavan uvefisyon. halcha vechazra vesof shavua, hare hi chemot shehayta. leachar happetur, terae chattechilla. hayta azza venaaset keha, keha venaaset azza, hare hi chemo shehayta, uvilvad shello titmaet mearbaa marot. kansa ufasta, pasta vechansa, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin: 
Baheret kaggeris ufasta chachatzi geris, vehalach min haom kachatzi geris, rabbi akiva omer, terae vattechilla. vachachamim metaharin: 
Baheret kaggeris ufasta chachatzi geris vaod, vehalach min haom kachatzi geris, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. baheret kaggeris ufasta chaggeris vaod, vehalcha lah haom, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim omrim, terae vattechilla:
Mishnah Negaim 5:3-6:2:
Sear pekudda, akavya ven mahalalel metamme, vachachamim metaharin. eze hu sear pekudda, mi shehayta vo vaheret uvah sear lavan, halcha habbaheret vehinnicha lesear lavan bimkomo vechazra, akavya ven mahalalel metamme, vachachamim metaharin. amar rabbi akiva, mode ani veze shehu tahor. eze hu sear pekudda, mi shehayta vo vaheret kaggeris uvah shete searot, vehalach hemenna chachatzi geris vehinnicho lesear lavan bimkom habbaheret vechazar. amru lo, keshem shebbittelu et divre akavya, af devarecha enan mekuyyamin: 
Kol sefek negaim battechilla tahor, ad shello nizkak letuma. mishshennizkak letuma, sefeko tame. ketzad. shenayim shebbau etzel kohen, baze vaheret kaggeris uvaze kassela, besof shavua baze kassela uvaze kassela, veeno yadua beeze mehen pasa, ben beish echad ben bishne anashim, tahor. rabbi akiva omer, beish echad, tame. uvishne anashim, tahor: 
Mishshennizkak letuma, sefeko tame. ketzad. shenayim shebbau etzel kohen, baze vaheret kaggeris uvaze kassela, besof shavua baze kassela vaod uvaze kassela vaod, shenehen temein. af al pi shechazru lihyot kassela vechassela, shenehen temein, ad sheyyachzeru lihyot kaggeris. ze hu sheamru, mishshennizkak letuma, sefeko tame: 
Gufah shel baheret, kaggeris hakkilki merubba. mekom haggeris, tesha adashot. mekom adasha, arba searot. nimtzeu sheloshim vashesh searot: 
Baheret kaggeris uvah michya chaadasha, ravta habbaheret, temea. nitmaata, tehora. ravta hammichya, temea. nitmaata, tehora:
Mishnah Negaim 6:3-6:
Baheret kaggeris uvah michya fechuta mikkaadasha, ravta habbaheret, temea. nitmaata, tehora. ravta hammichya, temea. nitmaata, rabbi meir metamme, vachachamim metaharim, sheen hannega pose letochah: 
Baheret yetera mikkaggeris uvah michya yetera mikkaadasha, rabbu o shennitmaatu, temein, uvilvad shello yitmaatu mikkashshiur: 
Baheret kaggeris umichya kaadasha makkaftah vechutz lammichya baheret, happenimit lehasegir, vehachitzona lehachelit. amar rabbi yose, en hammichya siman tuma lachitzona, shehabbaheret letochah. nitmaata vehalcha lah, rabban gamliel omer, im mibbifnim hi chala, siman pisyon lappenimit, vehachitzona tehora. veim mibbachutz, hachitzona tehora vehappenimit lehasegir. rabbi akiva omer, ben kach uven kach, tehora: 
Amar rabbi shimon, ematay, bizman shehi chaadasha muvet. hayta yetera mikkaadasha, hammotar siman pisyon lappenimit, vehachitzona temea. haya vohak pachut mikkaadasha, siman pisyon lappenimit, veen siman pisyon lachitzona:
Mishnah Negaim 6:7-7:2:
Esrim vearbaa rashe evarin baadam sheenan mittammein mishshum michya, rashe etzbeot yadayim veraglayim, verashe aznayim, verosh hachotem, verosh haggeviyya, verashe haddaddim shebbaishsha. rabbi yehuda omer, af shel ish. rabbi eliezer omer, af hayyabbalot vehaddildulin enan mittammein mishshum michya: 
Ellu mekomot baadam sheenan mittammein bevaheret, toch haayin, toch haozen, toch hachotem, toch happe, hakkematin, vehakkematin shebbatztzavvar, tachat haddad, uvet hashshechi, kaf haregel, vehatztzipporen, harosh, vehazzakan, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach hammordin, enan mittammein bannegaim, veenan mitztarfim bannegaim, veen hannega pose letochan, veenan mittammein mishshum michya, veenan meakkevin et hahofech kullo lavan. chazar harosh vehazzakan venikrechu, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach venaasu tzarevet, hare ellu mittammein bannegaim, veenan mitztarfin bannegaim, veen hannega pose letochan, veenan mittammein mishshum michya, aval meakkevin et hahofech kullo lavan. harosh vehazzakan ad shello heelu sear, vehaddildulin shebbarosh veshebbazzakan, niddonim keor habbasar: 
Ellu veharot tehorot. shehayu vo kodem lemattan tora, benachri venitgayyer, bekatan venolad, bekemet venigla, barosh uvazzakan, bashshechin uvammichva vekedach uvammordin. chazar harosh vehazzakan venikrechu, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach venaasu tzarevet, tehorim. harosh vehazzakan ad shello heelu sear, heelu sear venikrechu, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach ad shello naasu tzarevet, naasu tzarevet vechayu, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov metamme, shettechillatan vesofan tame. vachachamim metaharim: 
Nishtannu marehen, ben lehakel ben lehachemir. ketzad lehakel. hayta chashsheleg venaasa chesid hahechol ketzemer lavan vechikrum betza, naaset mispachat seet, o mispachat azza. ketzad lehachemir. hayta chikrum betza venaaset ketzemer lavan kesid hahechol uchesheleg, rabbi elazar ben azarya metaher. rabbi elazar chisma omer, lehakel, tahor, ulehachmir, terae vattechilla. rabbi akiva omer, ben lehakel ben lehachemir, terae vattechilla:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:1-4:
Echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot, bidrisha uvachakira, shenneemar (Vayikra kad) mishpat echad yihye lachem. ma ben dine mamonot ledine nefashot. dine mamonot bishlosha, vedine nefashot beesrim ushelosha. dine mamonot potchin ben lizchut ben lechova, vedine nefashot potchin lizchut veen potchin lechova. dine mamonot mattin al pi echad ben lizchut ben lechova, vedine nefashot mattin al pi echad lizchut veal pi shenayim lechova. dine mamonot machazirin ben lizchut ben lechova, dine nefashot machazirin lizchut veen machazirin lechova. dine mamonot hakkol melammedin zechut vechova, dine nefashot hakkol melammedin zechut veen hakkol melammedin chova. dine mamonot hamelammed chova melammed zechut vehamelammed zechut melammed chova, dine nefashot hamelammed chova melammed zechut, aval hamelammed zechut en yachol lachazor ulelammed chova. dine mamonot danin bayyom vegomrin ballayla, dine nefashot danin bayyom vegomrin bayyom. dine mamonot gomrin bo vayyom ben lizchut ben lechova, dine nefashot gomrin bo vayyom lizchut uveyom shelleacharav lechova, lefichach en danin lo veerev shabbat velo veerev yom tov: 
Dine hattumot vehattohorot matchilin min haggadol, dine nefashot matchilin min hatztzad. hakkol kesherin ladun dine mamonot veen hakkol kesherin ladun dine nefashot, ella chohanim, leviyyim, veyisreelim hammassiin lakkehunna: 
Sanhedrin hayta kachatzi goren agulla, kede sheyyehu roin ze et ze. ushene sofre haddayyanin omdin lifnehem, echad miyyamin veechad missemol, vechotvin divre hamezakkin vedivre hamechayyevin. rabbi yehuda omer, shelosha, echad kotev divre hamezakkin, veechad kotev divre hamechayyevin, vehashshelishi chotev divre hamezakkin vedivre hamechayyevin: 
Veshalosh shurot shel talmide chachamim yoshvin lifnehem, kol echad veechad makkir et mekomo. hayu tzerichin lismoch, somchin min harishona. echad min hashsheniyya ba lo larishona veechad min hashshelishit ba lo lashsheniyya, uvorrin lahen od echad min hakkahal umoshivin oto vashshelishit. velo haya yoshev bimkomo shel rishon, ella yoshev bemakom harauy lo:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:5-5:4:
Ketzad meayyemin et haedim al ede nefashot, hayu machnisin otan umeayyemin alehen. shemma tomru meomed, umishshemua, ed mippi ed umippi adam neeman shamanu, o shemma i attem yodin shessofenu livdok etchem bidrisha uvachakira. hevu yodin shello chedine mamonot dine nefashot. dine mamonot, adam noten mamon umitkapper lo. dine nefashot, damo vedam zariyyotav teluyin bo ad sof haolam, shekken matzinu vekayin sheharag et achiv, shenneemar (Bereshit 4) deme achicha tzoakim, eno omer dam achicha ella deme achicha, damo vedam zariyyotav. davar acher, deme achicha, shehaya damo mushlach al haetzim veal haavanim. lefichach nivra adam yechidi, lelammedcha, shekkol hameabbed nefesh achat miyyisrael, maale alav hakkatuv keillu ibbed olam male. vechol hamekayyem nefesh achat miyyisrael, maale alav hakkatuv keillu kiyyem olam male. umippene shelom habberiyyot, shello yomar adam lachavero abba gadol meavicha. veshello yehu minin omrim, harebe rashuyyot bashshamayim. ulehaggid gedullato shel hakkadosh baruch hu, sheadam tovea kamma matbeot bechotam echad vechullan domin ze laze, umelech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu tava kol adam bechotamo shel adam harishon veen echad mehen dome lachavero. lefichach kol echad veechad chayyav lomar, bishvili nivra haolam. veshemma tomru ma lanu velatztzara hazzot, vahalo chevar neemar (Vayikra 5) vehu ed o raa o yada im lo yaggid vegomer. veshemma tomru ma lanu lachuv bedamo shel ze, vahalo chevar neemar (Mishlei 11) uvaavod reshaim rinna: 
Hayu vodkin otan besheva chakirot, beeze shavua, beezo shana, beeze chodesh, bechamma vachodesh, beeze yom, beezo shaa, beeze makom. rabbi yose omer beeze yom, beezo shaa, beeze makom. makkirin attem oto. hitretem bo. haoved avoda zara, et mi avad, uvamme avad: 
Kol hammarbe vivdikot, hare ze meshubbach. maase uvadak ben zakkay beuktze teenim. uma ben chakirot livdikot. chakirot, echad omer eni yodea, edutan betela. bedikot, echad omer eni yodea, vaafillu shenayim omrim en anu yodin, edutan kayyamet. echad chakirot veechad bedikot, bizman shemmachchishin ze et ze, edutan betela: 
Echad omer bishnayim bachodesh veechad omer bishlosha vachodesh, edutan kayyemet, shezze yodea beibburo shel chodesh veze eno yodea beibburo shel chodesh. echad omer bishlosha veechad omer bachamishsha, edutan betela. echad omer bishte shaot veechad omer beshalosh shaot, edutan kayyemet. echad omer beshalosh veechad omer bechamesh, edutan betela. rabbi yehuda omer, kayyamet. echad omer bechamesh veechad omer besheva, edutan betela, shebbechamesh chamma vammizrach uvesheva chamma vammaarav: 
Veachar kach machnisin et hashsheni uvodkin oto. im nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanin, potchin bizchut. amar echad min haedim yesh li lelammed alav zechut, o echad min hattalmidim yesh li lelammed alav chova, meshattekin oto. amar echad min hattalmidim yesh li lelammed alav zechut, maalin oto umoshivin oto venehen, velo haya yored mishsham kol hayyom kullo. im yesh mammash bidvarav, shomin lo. vaafillu hu omer yesh li lelammed al atzmi zechut, shomin lo, uvilvad sheyyesh mammash bidvarav:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 5:5-6:3:
Im matzu lo zechut, petaruhu. veim lav, maavirin dino lemachar. hayu mizdavvegin zugot zugot, umemaatin bemaachol, velo hayu shotin yayin kol hayyom, venosin venotnin kol hallayla, velammochorat mashkimin uvain levet din. hamezakke omer ani mezakke umezakke ani vimkomi, vehamechayyev omer ani mechayyev umechayyev ani vimkomi. hamelammed chova melammed zechut, aval hamelammed zechut eno yachol lachazor ulelammed chova. tau vedavar, shene sofre haddayyanin mazkirin otan. im matzu lo zechut, petaruhu. veim lav, omdim leminyan. shenem asar mezakkin veachad asar mechayyevin, zakkay. shenem asar mechayyevin veachad asar mezakkin, vaafillu achad asar mezakkin veachad asar mechayyevin veechad omer eni yodea, vaafillu esrim ushenayim mezakkin o mechayyevin veechad omer eni yodea, yosifu haddayyanin. ad kamma mosifin, shenayim shenayim ad shivim veechad. sheloshim veshishsha mezakkin usheloshim vachamishsha mechayyevin, zakkay. sheloshim veshishsha mechayyevin usheloshim vachamishsha mezakkin, danin ellu keneged ellu ad sheyyire echad min hamechayyevin divre hamezakkin: 
Nigmar haddin, motziin oto lesaklo. bet hassekila haya chutz levet din, shenneemar (Vayikra kad) hotze et hamekallel. echad omed al petach bet din vehassudarin beyado, veadam echad rochev hassus rachok mimmennu kede sheyyehe roehu. omer echad yesh li lelammed alav zechut, halla menif bassudarin vehassus ratz umaamido. vaafillu hu omer yesh li lelammed al atzmi zechut, machazirin oto afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, uvilvad sheyyesh mammash bidvarav. matzu lo zechut, petaruhu, veim lav, yotze lissakel. vecharoz yotze lefanav, ish peloni ben peloni yotze lissakel al sheavar avera felonit, ufeloni ufeloni edav, kol mi sheyyodea lo zechut yavo vilammed alav: 
Haya rachok mibbet hassekila keeser ammot, omrim lo hitvadde, shekken derech hammumatin mitvaddin, shekkol hammitvadde yesh lo chelek laolam habba. shekken matzinu veachan sheamar lo yehoshua, beni sim na chavod laAdonai elohe yisrael veten lo toda vegomer vayyaan achan et yehoshua vayyomar amna anochi chatati laAdonai elohe yisrael vechazot vegomer (yehoshua 7). uminnayin shekkipper lo vidduyo, shenneemar (sham) vayyomer yehoshua me achartanu yakarcha Adonai bayyom hazze. hayyom hazze atta achur, vei atta achur laolam habba. veim eno yodea lehitvaddot, omrim lo, emor tehe mitati chappara al kol avonotay. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya yodea shehu mezummam, omer tehe mitati kappara al kol avonotay chutz meavon ze. amru lo, im ken, yehu chol adam omrim kach kede lenakkot et atzman: 
Haya rachok mibbet hassekila arba ammot, mafshitin oto et begadav. haish, mechassin oto millefanav. vehaishsha, millefaneha umeachareha, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, haish niskal arom veen haishsha niskelet arumma:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:4-7:1:
Bet hassekila haya gavoah shete komot. echad min haedim dochafo al matnav. nehpach al libbo, hofcho al matnav. im met bah, yatza. veim lav, hashsheni notel et haeven venotnah al libbo. im met bah, yatza. veim lav, regimato vechol yisrael, shenneemar (Devarim 17) yad haedim tihye bo varishona lahamito veyad kol haam baacharona. kol hanniskalin nitlin, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, eno nitle ella hamegaddef vehaoved avoda zara. haish tolin oto panav kelappe haam, vehaishsha paneha chelappe haetz, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, haish nitle veen haishsha nitlet. amar lahen rabbi eliezer, vahalo shimon ben shatach tala nashim beashkelon. amru lo, shemonim nashim tala, veen danin shenayim beyom echad. ketzad tolin oto, meshakkein et hakkora vaaretz vehaetz yotze mimmenna, umakkif shete yadav zo al gabbe zo vetole oto. rabbi yose omer, hakkora mutta al hakkotel, vetole oto kederech shehattabbachin osin. umattirin oto miyyad. veim lan, over alav belo taase, shenneemar (Devarim 21) lo talin nivlato al haetz ki kavor tikberennu ki killat elohim taluy vegomer. kelomar, mippene ma ze taluy, mippene shebberach et hashshem, venimtza shem shamayim mitchallel: 
Amar rabbi meir, beshaa sheadam mitztaer, shechina ma hallashon omeret kivyachol, kallani meroshi, kallani mizzeroi. im ken hammakom mitztaer al damam shel reshaim shennishpach, kal vachomer al damam shel tzaddikim. velo zo vilvad, ella kol hammelin et meto, over belo taase. helino lichvodo lehavi lo aron vetachrichim, eno over alav. velo hayu kovrin oto bekivrot avotav, ella shete vatte kevarot hayu metukkanin levet din, achat lanneheragin velannechenakin veachat lanniskalin velannisrafin: 
Nitakkel habbasar, melakketin et haatzamot vekovrin otan bimkoman. vehakkerovim baim veshoalin bishlom haddayyanim uvishlom haedim, kelomar sheen belibbenu alechem kelum, sheddin emet dantem. velo hayu mitabbelin, aval onnin, sheen aninut ella vallev: 
Arba mitot nimseru levet din, sekila, serefa, hereg, vachenek. rabbi shimon omer, serefa, sekila, chenek, vahereg. zo mitzvat hanniskalin:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:2-6: Mitzvat hannisrafin, hayu meshakkein oto vazzevel ad arkubbotav venotnin sudar kasha letoch harakka vechorech al tzavvaro. ze moshech etzlo veze moshech etzlo ad sheppoteach et piv, umadlik et happetila vezorkah letoch piv veyoredet letoch meav vechomeret et bene meav. rabbi yehuda omer, af hu im met beyadam lo hayu mekayyemin bo mitzvat serefa, ella fotchin et piv bitzvat shello vetovato umadlik et happetila vezorkah letoch piv veyoredet letoch meav vechomeret et bene meav. amar rabbi eliezer ben tzadok, maase bevat kohen achat shezzinneta, vehikkifuha chavile zemorot userafuha. amru lo, mippene shello haya vet din shel otah shaa baki:

Mitzvat hanneheragim, hayu mattizin et rosho vesayif kederech shehammalchut osa. rabbi yehuda omer, niuul hu ze, ella mannichin et rosho al hassaddan vekotzetz bekofitz. amru lo, en mita menuvvelet mizzo. mitzvat hannechenakin, hayu meshakkein oto vazzevel ad arkubbotav venotnin sudar kasha letoch harakka vechorech al tzavvaro, ze moshech etzlo veze moshech etzlo, ad shennafsho yotza:

Ellu hen hanniskalin, habba al haem, veal eshet haav, veal hakkalla, veal hazzechur, veal habbehema, vehaishsha hamevia et habbehema, vehamegaddef, vehaoved avoda zara, vehannoten mizzaro lammolech, uvaal ov veyiddeoni, vehamechallel et hashshabbat, vehamekallel aviv veimmo, vehabba al naara hameorasa, vehammesit, vehammaddiach, vehamechashshef, uven sorer umore. habba al haem, chayyav aleha mishshum em umishshum eshet av. rabbi yehuda omer, eno chayyav ella mishshum haem bilvad. habba al eshet av chayyav aleha mishshum eshet av umishshum eshet ish, ben bechayye aviv ben leachar mitat aviv, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin. habba al kallato, chayyav aleha mishshum kallato umishshum eshet ish, ben bechayye veno ben leachar mitat beno, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin. habba al hazzechur veal habbehema, vehaishsha hamevia et habbehema, im adam chata, behema me chatat, ella lefi shebbat laadam takkala al yadah, lefichach amar hakkatuv tissakel. davar acher, shello tehe behema overet bashshuk veyomru zo hi shenniskal peloni al yadah:

Hamegaddef eno chayyav ad sheyyefaresh hashshem. amar rabbi yehoshua ben karcha, bechol yom danin et haedim bechinnuy yakke yose et yose. nigmar haddin, lo horgim bechinnuy, ella motziim kol adam lachutz veshoalim et haggadol shebbahen veomrim lo emor ma sheshshamata beferush, vehu omer, vehaddayyanim omdin al raglehen vekorin velo meachin. vehashsheni omer af ani kamohu, vehashshelishi omer af ani kamohu:

Haoved avoda zara, echad haoved, veechad hazzoveach, veechad hamekatter, veechad hamenassech, veechad hammishtachave, veechad hamekabbelo alav leeloah, vehaomer lo eli atta. aval hamegappef vehamenashshek vehamechabbed vehammerabbetz vehammarchitz, hassach, hammalbish vehammanil, over belo taase. hannoder bishmo vehamekayyem bishmo, over belo taase. happoer atzmo levaal peor, zo hi avodato. hazzorek even lemarkulis, zo hi avodato:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:7-10: Hannoten mizzaro lammolech, eno chayyav ad sheyyimsor lammolech veyaavir baesh. masar lammolech velo heevir baesh, heevir baesh velo masar lammolech, eno chayyav, ad sheyyimsor lammolech veyaavir baesh. baal ov ze fittom hamedabber mishshechyo, veyiddeoni ze hamedabber befiv, hare ellu viskila, vehannishal bahem beazhara:

Hamechallel et hashshabbat, bedavar shechayyavin al zedono charet veal shiggato chattat. hamekallel aviv veimmo, eno chayyav ad sheyyekallelem bashshem. killelam bechinnuy, rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrin:
Habba al naara hameorasa, eno chayyav ad shettehe naara vetula meorasa vehi vevet aviha. bau aleha shenayim, harishon biskila vehashsheni bechenek:

Hammesit, ze hedyot hammesit et hahedyot. amar lo yesh yira vemakom peloni, kach ochelet, kach shota, kach metiva, kach merea. kol chayyave mitot shebbattora en machminin alehem, chutz mizzo. amar lishnayim vehen edav, meviin oto levet din vesoklin oto. amar leechad, hu omer yesh li chaverim rotzim bechach. im haya arum veeno yachol ledabber bifnehem, machminin lo edim achore haggader, vehu omer lo emor ma sheamarta li veyichud, vehalla omer lo, vehu omer lo heach nanniach et elohenu shebbashshamayim venelech venaavod etzim vaavanim. im chozer bo, hare ze mutav. veim amar kach hi chovatenu vechach yafe lanu, haomdin meachore haggader meviin oto levet din vesoklin oto. haomer eevod, elech veeevod, nelech venaavod. azabbeach, elech vaazabbeach, nelech unezabbeach. aktir, elech veaktir, nelech venaktir. anassech, elech vaanassech, nelech unenassech. eshtachave, elech veeshtachave, nelech venishtachave. hammaddiach, ze haomer, nelech venaavod avoda zara:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Devarim hachofzim oto ketzad. im haya tzarich linkavav lo yitpallel. vechol hatztzarich linkavav vehitpallel tefillato toeva vechozer umitpallel achar sheyyaase tzerachav. veim yachol lehaamid atzmo kede parsa tefillato tefilla. veaf al pi chen lechattechilla lo yitpallel ad sheyyivdok atzmo yafe yafe veyivdok nekavav veyasir kicho venio vechol haddavar hattordo veachar kach yitpallel:

Mi sheggihek ufihek venitattesh bitfillato im lirtzono hare ze megunne. veim badak gufo kodem sheyyitpallel uva leanso en bechach kelum. nizdammen lo rok bitfillato mavlio betallito o bevigdo. veim haya mitztaer bechach zorko beyado laachorav kede shello yitztaer battefilla venimtza tarud. yatza mimmennu ruach millematta keshehu omed bitfilla shello ledato shohe ad shettichle haruach vechozer litfillato:

Bikkesh lehotzi ruach millematta venitztaer harebe veeno yachol lehaamid atzmo mehallech leacharav arba ammot umamtin ad shettichle haruach. veomer ribbon kol haolamim yetzartanu nekavim nekavim chalulim chalulim galuy veyadua lefanecha cherpatenu uchelimmatenu cherpa uchelimma bechayyenu tolea verimma bemitatenu vechozer limkomo umitpallel:
Haya omed bitfilla venatfu me raglav al birkav mamtin ad sheyyichlu hammayim vechozer lammakom sheppasak. veim shaha kede ligmor et hattefilla chozer larosh:

Vechen hammashtin mayim shohe kede hilluch 4 ammot veachar kach yitpallel. umishshehitpallel shohe achar tefillato kede hilluch arba ammot veachar kach mashtin kede sheyyifsok divre hattefilla mippiv:

Kavvanat hallev ketzad. kol tefilla sheenah bechavvana enah tefilla. veim hitpallel belo kavvana chozer umitpallel bechavvana. matza dato meshubbeshet velibbo tarud asur lo lehitpallel ad shettityashshev dato. lefichach habba min hadderech vehu ayef o metzer asur lo lehitpallel ad shettityashshev dato. amru chachamim yishhe shelosha yamim ad sheyyanuach vetitkarer dato veachar kach yitpallel:

Ketzad hi hakkavvana. sheyyefanne et libbo mikkol hammachashavot veyire atzmo keillu hu omed lifne hashshechina. lefichach tzarich leshev meat kodem hattefilla kede lechavven et libbo veachar kach yitpallel benachat uvetachanunim velo yaase tefillato kemi shehaya nose massooy umashlicho veholech lo. lefichach tzarich leshev meat achar hattefilla veachar kach yippater. chasidim harishonim hayu shohin shaa achat kodem tefilla veshaa achat leachar tefilla umaarichin bitfilla shaa:

Shikkor al yitpallel mippene sheen lo kavvana. veim hitpallel tefillato toeva. lefichach chozer umitpallel kesheyyitroken mishshichruto. shatuy al yitpallel veim hitpallel tefillato tefilla. e ze shikkor ze sheeno yachol ledabber lifne hammelech. shatuy yachol ledabber bifne hammelech veeno mishtabbesh. af al pi chen hoil veshata reviit yayin lo yitpallel ad sheyyasir yeno mealav

Vechen en omdin lehitpallel lo mittoch sechok velo mittoch kallut rosh velo mittoch sicha velo mittoch meriva velo mittoch kaas ella mittoch divre tora. velo mittoch din vahalacha af al pi shehem divre tora kede shello yehe libbo tarud bahalacha. ella mittoch divre tora sheen bah iyyun kegon halachot pesukot:

Tefillot happerakim kegon tefillat musaf rosh chodesh utefillat moadot tzarich lehasedir tefillato veachar kach omed umitpallel kede shello yikkashel bah. haya mehallech bimkom sakkana kegon mekom gedude chayyot velistim vehiggia zeman tefilla mitpallel beracha achat. vezo hi. tzarche ammecha yisrael merubbim vedatam ketzara. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettitten lechol echad veechad kede parnasato ulechol geviyya ugeviyya de machsorah vehattov beenecha ase baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla. umitpallel otah badderech keshehu mehallech, veim yachol laamod omed. ucheshehu maggia leyishshuv vetitkarer dato chozer umitpallel tefilla ketakkanatah tesha esre berachot:

Kissuy haerva ketzad. af al pi shekkissa ervato kederech shemmechassin likriat shema lo yitpallel ad sheyyechasse et libbo. veim lo kissa libbo o shenneenas veen lo bema yechasse hoil vechissa ervato vehitpallel yatza. ulechattechilla lo yaase:

Tohorat mekom hattefilla ketzad. lo yitpallel bimkom hattinnofet velo bammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse velo baashpa velo bemakom sheeno bechezkat tohora ad sheyyivdekennu. kelalo shel davar kol makom sheen korin bo keriat shema en mitpallelin bo. ucheshem shemmarchikin mitztzoa umimme raglayim vereach ra umin hammet umeriyyat haerva likriat shema kach marchikin litfilla:

Hammitpallel umatza tzoa bimkomo hoil vechata mippene shello badak ad shello hitpallel chozer umitpallel bemakom tahor. haya omed bitfilla umatza tzoa kenegdo im yachol lehallech lefanav kede sheyyizrekenna leacharav arba ammot yehallech veim lav yesallekenna latztzedadin. veim eno yachol yafsik. gedole hachachamim lo hayu mitpallelim bevayit sheyyesh bo shechar velo bevayit sheyyesh bo mureyays beet ippusho mippene sherecho ra af al pi shehammakom tahor:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 8:10-12:
Hassochet et happerot lehotzi memehen chayyav mishshum mefarek. veeno chayyav ad sheyyihye bammashkin shessachat kigrogeret. veen chayyavim min hattora ella al derichat zetim vaanavim bilvad. umuttar lischot eshkol shel anavim letoch haochel. shemmashke habba leochel ochel hu venimtza kimfarek ochel meochel. aval im sachat lichli sheen bo ochel hare ze dorech vechayyav. vehacholev letoch haochel o hayyonek befiv patur veeno chayyav ad sheyyachalov letoch hakkeli: 
Hazzore o habborer kigrogeret chayyav. vehamechabbetz hare hu toledet borer. vechen habborer shemarim mittoch hammashkin hare ze toledet borer o toledet merakked vechayyav. shehazzore vehabborer vehamerakked domin inyenehem ze laze. umippene ma manu otan bishlosha mippene shekkol melacha shehayta bammishkan monin otah bifne atzmah: 
Habborer ochel mittoch pesolet o shehayu lefanav shene mine ochalin uverer min mimmin acher benafa uvichvara chayyav. bekanon o betamchuy patur. veim berer beyado leechol lealtar muttar:
Niddah 20b:11-19: Yalta (ayytea) [ayytay] dema lekammeh derabba bar bar channa, vetammi la. hadar (ayytea) [ayytay] lekammeh derav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda, vedakki la.
Vehechi aved hachi? vehatanya: chacham shettimme — en chavero rashshay letaher, asar — en chavero rashshay lehattir!
Meikkara tammoye hava metamme la, kevan daamara leh dechol yoma hava medakke li ki hay gavna, vehaiddana hu dechash beeneh — dakki la.
Umi mehemna? in, vehatanya: neemenet ishsha lomar "kaze raiti veibbadtiv".
Ibbaya lehu: "kaze tiher ish peloni chacham", mahu?
Ta shema: neemenet ishsha lomar "kaze raiti veibbadtiv", shane hatam, deleteh lekamme.

Ta shema: deyalta (ayytea) [ayytay] dema lekammeh derabba bar bar channa — vetammi la. lekammeh derav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda — vedakki la. vehechi aved hachi? vehatanya: "chacham shettimme en chavero rashshay letaher" vechulei,
Veamrinan: tammoye hava metamme la, kevan daamara leh dechol yoma medakke la ki hay gavna, vehaiddana hu dechash beeneh — hadar dakki la, alma mehemna le!
Rav yitzchak bar yehuda aggemareh semach.

Sanhedrin 21b:18-22a:7: Vechotev sefer tora lishmo. tena: uvilvad shello yitnae beshel avotav.

Amar rava: af al pi shehinnichu lo avotav leadam sefer tora, mitzva lichtov mishshello, shenneemar: "veatta kitvu lachem et hashshira". etiveh abbaye: vechotev lo sefer tora lishmo, shello yitnae beshel acherim. melech – in, hedyot – lo!
La, tzericha lishte torot, vechidtanya: "vechatav lo et mishne vegomer" – kotev lishmo shete torot: achat shehi yotza venichneset immo, veachat shemmunnachat lo bevet genazav.

Otah sheyyotza venichneset immo, ose otah kemin kamea vetolah bizroo, shenneemar: "shivviti Adonai lenegdi tamid ki mimini bal emmot". eno nichnas bah lo levet hammerchatz velo levet hakkisse, shenneemar: "vehayta immo vekara vo" – makom harauy likrot bo.

Amar mar zutera, veittema mar ukeva: battechilla nittena tora leyisrael bichtav ivri uleshon hakkodesh. chazra venittena lahem bime ezra bichtav ashshuri uleshon arammi. berru lahen yisrael ketav ashshuri uleshon hakkodesh, vehinnichu lahedyotot ketav ivrit uleshon arammi.
Man hedyotot? amar rav chisda: kutae. may ketav ivrit? amar rav chisda: ketav libbonaa.

Tanya, rabbi yose omer: rauy haya ezra shettinnaten tora al yado leyisrael, ilmale lo kedamo moshe. bemoshe hu omer: "umoshe ala el haelohim", beezra hu omer: "hu ezra ala mibbavel". ma aliyyay haamura kan – tora, af aliyyay haamura lehallan – tora.

Bemoshe hu omer: "veoti tzivva Adonai baet hahi lelammed etchem chukkim umishpatim". beezra hu omer: "ki ezra hechin levavo lidrosh et torat Adonai elohav velaasot ulelammed beyisrael chok umishpat". veaf al pi shello nittena tora al yado, nishtanna al yado hakketav, shenneemar:

"Uchetav hannishtevan katuv aramit umeturgam arammit". uchetiv: "la chahalin ketava lemikre ufishre lehodaa lemalka". [melammed shebbeoto hayyom nittan] uchetiv: "vechatav et mishne hattora hazzot" – ketav harauy lehishtannot.
Lamma nikra shemo ashshuri? sheala immahem meashshur.

Tanya, rabbi omer: battechilla bichtav ze nittena tora leyisrael. kevan shechatu, nehpach lahen leroetz. kevan shechazru bahen, hechziro lahem, shenneemar: "shuvu levitztzaron asire hattikva gam hayyom maggid mishne ashiv lach".
Lamma nikra shemo ashshuri? shemmeushshar bichtavo‍.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi eliezer ben parta, sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar hammodai: ketav ze lo nishtanna kol ikkar, shenneemar: "vave haammudim". ma ammudim lo nishtannu, af vavim lo nishtannu. veomer: "veel hayyehudim kichtavam vechilshonam" – ma leshonam lo nishtanna, af ketavam lo nishtanna.

Ella ma ani mekayyem "et mishne hattora hazzot"? lishte torot: achat sheyyotza venichneset immo, veachat shemmunnachat lo bevet genazav. otah sheyyotza venichneset immo – ose otah kemin kamea vetolah bizroo, shenneemar: "shivviti Adonai lenegdi tamid".

Veiddach, hay "shivviti" may daresh beh? hahu mibbee leh kidrav chana bar bizna, deamar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: hammitpallel tzarich sheyyire atzmo keillu shechina kenegdo, shenneemar: "shivviti Adonai lenegdi tamid".
Zohar, Addenda, Volume III 6:28-32: Dichtiv totze haaretz nefesh chayya, dehahu chayya ilaa. uvegin dehay nefesh chayya ihi kaddisha ilaa, kad ara kaddisha mashcha lah begavav vitkelilat bah, keden karenan lah neshama. veta chaze, bechol zimna debar nash azil beorach keshot, ufume velishane memallan milin kaddishin bitzlota, beorayyta. hay nishmata itdabbekat beh, rechima hu demareh. kama neturin natrin leh mikkol sitrin. reshima hu letav leella vetatta ushechinta kaddisha sharyay aloy. veda hi desalka leella umemalla kame malka kaddisha veayyla bechol tarin velet deyimche bidaha. veal da ittekre ruach memalla. deha kol shear nafshata (napeshatean) let lon reshu lemallela kame malka bar hay.

Uvezimna deihu aste orchoy vesifvvavteh velishane memallan milin bishin, shechinta istalkat minneh venishmata kaddisha itabberat minneh vela itdabbekat beh. umisitra dechivyay bisha takkifa itar rucha chada deshat veachil bealma, dela sharyay ella beatar dikdusha ilaa istelak mittamman.

Vinun milin salkin leatar dechivyay bisha, decholla leatreh ithadar. uveshaata desalkin, kolla machrizin veamrin istalaku sucheraneh demila bisha diflanya. penun atar learcheh dechivyay takkifa. vehahi neshama salka bechissufa, beaku decholla. vela yahavin lah atar lemallela kemilkadmin. ucheden chivyyay izdaman.

Vechad hahi milla bisha salka beorchin yedian veshare kame dechivyay takkifa kama ruchin mitarin bealma verucha nachta mehahu sitra, veashkach dehahu bar nash itar leh bemilla bisha. veha rucha memalla kaddisha itabberat minneh, keden sharyay aloy vesaiv leh, ucheden hu sagir vitpegim bivsareh bechizu deanpoy becholla.

Veal da ketiv (Mishlei 21:23) shomer piv uleshono shomer mitzarot nafsho. nafsho vadday, hahi dehava memalla itavidat mashtuka begin milula bisha uchemma deonsha debar nash behay, begin milla bisha, kach onsheh begin milla tava (deate lideh deyachil lemallala velo mallil):
Zohar, Behar 2: Ta chaze, kevan dealu yisrael leara, la ishtechachu bah dinin tattain, ukkeneset yisrael havat bah benayycha, al kanfe dichruvim. kema deittemar, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 1:21) tzedek yalin bah. keden havat lah nayycha mikkolla. deha yisrael la nayymin, ad dimkarve karbena deven haarbayim, veisteliku dinin. veola hava ittokad al madbecha, ucheden hava lah nayycha mikkolla, vela ishtechach ella itteta bevalah, hada hu dichtiv ki tavou vegomer veshavta haaretz, nayycha vadday. (Vayikra 25:2) veshavta haaretz shabbat laAdonai, shabbat laAdonai mammash.

Tu patach ribbi elazar, (Shemot 21:2) ki tikne eved ivri shesh shanim yaavod vegomer. begin dechol bar yisrael deitgezar, deit beh reshima kaddisha, it leh nayycha bishmitta. deha dileh hu hahu shemitta, lenayycha beh. veda ikre shabbat haaretz, vday cheru it bah. nayycha bah, kema deshabbat nayycha hu decholla, hachi name shemitta nayycha decholla, nayycha hu derucha vegufa.

Ta chaze, Adonai nayycha hu deilae vetattae. begin kach, Adonai illaa, Adonai tattaa. nayycha deillain, nayycha detattain. Adonai illaa, sheva shanim sheva peamim. Adonai tattaa, sheva shanim bilchodayyhu. da shemitta, veda yovla.

Vechad mistakkelin mille kolla chad. begin kach veshavta haaretz, behahu nayycha deara, itzterichu avdin nayycha. uvegin kach, uvashsheviit yetze lachafshi chinnam. chinnam, mahu chinnam. dela yahiv lemareh kelum.
Zohar, Behar 3: Ella da raza, hacha olifna, ketiv (Bamidbar 11:5) zacharnu et haddaga asher nochal bemitzrayim chinnam, bela beracha. dela hava alana bemitzrayim ol dilella. ta chaze, avadin peturin meol malchuta dilella, veal da peturin min hammitzvot. may ol malchut shamayim. ella, kehay tora deyahavin aleh ol bekadmita, begin leappaka minneh tav lealma. vei la kabbil aleh hahu ol, la avid midi. hachi name itzterich leh lebar nash lekabbela aleh ol bekadmita, ulevatar deyiflach beh bechol ma deitzterich. vei la kabbil aleh hay bekadmita, la yechul lemiflach.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 2:11) ivdu et Adonai beyira. mahu beyira. kema deat amer (Tehillim 111:10) reshit chachma yirat Adonai. veda malchut shamayim. uvegin kach ol malchut shamayim. veal da hay bekadmita hu decholla. man ochach. tefilla, bekadmita shel yad. begin divhay ayel lishar kedushsha. vei hay la ishtechach legabbeh, la sharya beh kedushsha leella, begin kach (Vayikra 16:3) bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh vegomer ketiv.

Vehay ol la sharya, beman deihu kafit beochora. veal da avadin peturin meol malchut shamayim. vei mehay ol peturin, mikkol shear peturin. deha shear la sharya aleh debar nash, ad deishtechach gabbeh behay ol. uvegin kach havo achle yisrael bemitzrayim chinnam. uf hacha yetze lachafshi chinnam. deha avda hava, vechol ma deavid, chinnam hu, bela ol malchut shamayim. veaf al gav dechinnam havo ovadohi yetze lachafshi, vihe leh nayycha.
Zohar, Behar 3:9-4:15: Ella da raza, hacha olifna, ketiv (Bamidbar 11:5) zacharnu et haddaga asher nochal bemitzrayim chinnam, bela beracha. dela hava alana bemitzrayim ol dilella. ta chaze, avadin peturin meol malchuta dilella, veal da peturin min hammitzvot. may ol malchut shamayim. ella, kehay tora deyahavin aleh ol bekadmita, begin leappaka minneh tav lealma. vei la kabbil aleh hahu ol, la avid midi. hachi name itzterich leh lebar nash lekabbela aleh ol bekadmita, ulevatar deyiflach beh bechol ma deitzterich. vei la kabbil aleh hay bekadmita, la yechul lemiflach.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 2:11) ivdu et Adonai beyira. mahu beyira. kema deat amer (Tehillim 111:10) reshit chachma yirat Adonai. veda malchut shamayim. uvegin kach ol malchut shamayim. veal da hay bekadmita hu decholla. man ochach. tefilla, bekadmita shel yad. begin divhay ayel lishar kedushsha. vei hay la ishtechach legabbeh, la sharya beh kedushsha leella, begin kach (Vayikra 16:3) bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh vegomer ketiv.

Vehay ol la sharya, beman deihu kafit beochora. veal da avadin peturin meol malchut shamayim. vei mehay ol peturin, mikkol shear peturin. deha shear la sharya aleh debar nash, ad deishtechach gabbeh behay ol. uvegin kach havo achle yisrael bemitzrayim chinnam. uf hacha yetze lachafshi chinnam. deha avda hava, vechol ma deavid, chinnam hu, bela ol malchut shamayim. veaf al gav dechinnam havo ovadohi yetze lachafshi, vihe leh nayycha.

Levatar deihu becheru, veishtechach beh nayycha, yahavin aleh ol, mehahu atar deappik leh lecheru. vei bar nash yesarev lemeppak lecheru, kema deat amer veim amor yomar haeved ahavti et adoni vegomer. ha vadday pagim leh lehay atar, deshavik ol malchuta dilella, venatil ol demareh. veal da ma ketiv, vehiggisho adonav el haelohim vehiggisho el haddelet vegomer. vehiggisho adonav el haelohim. el haelohim setam. legabbe hahu atar defagim leh dehachi name elohim ikre.

Ulean atar yitkeriv legabbeh. el haddelet o el hamezuza. begin dehay atar pitcha hu dilella, umezuza ikre, veha ittemar. vechevan deihu achvvavn leafgama lehay atar, hahu pegimu ishtear bahadeh beh begufeh hada hu dichtiv, veratza adonav et azno bammartzea vaavado leolam. yeheve avda techot ragloy demareh, ad shatta deyovla.

Et azno amay. ha okmuha. aval shemia tale behay atar, asiyya leella. uvegin deyisrael kad kerivu letura desinay, vahavu birchimu delibbayyhu leitkarva lekudesha berich hu, akdimu asiyya lashshemia, deha shemia bekadmita, ulevatar asiyya. shemia behay shemita talya. veal da hu pagim lehay shemia, yitpegim shemia dileh, veyishtear pegimu beh. vela yishtear hu avda lemareh, ad deyitkarev lehahu atar defagim, veyitpegim hu kammeh, veyishtear beh hahu pegimu. uvegin kach, vehiggisho adonav el haelohim setam, kema deokimna. veal da, veshavta haaretz shabbat laAdonai.

(Vayikra 25:4) shesh shanim tizra sadecha vegomer, uvashshana hashsheviit shabbat shabbaton yihye laaretz shabbat laAdonai. veha okmuha, dichtiv, (Shemot 23:11) uvashsheviit tishmetenna unetashtah vegomer. may tama veachlu evyone ammecha. begin demiskene behay atar talyayn, uvegin kach shavik lon lemechal. veal da, man derachim lemiskena, yahiv shelama bichneset yisrael, veosif birchata bealma, veyahiv chedu vechela laatar deitkere tzedaka, learka birchata lichneset yisrael, veokimna.
Zohar, Behar 9: Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havo azle bearcha, pagu behahu tura, ashkachu tere gavre dahavo azle, addehachi chamu chad bar nash dehava ate, veamar lon, bematu minnayychu, havu li mezona pitta denahama, dehane teren yomin detaina bemadbera, vela achalna midi. ishtemit chad meinnun tere gavre, veappik mezoneh deihu ayyte leorcha, veyahiv leh, veachil veashke leh. amar leh chavreh, ma taavid min mezona, deha ana didi achalna. amar leh, ume ale didach, ana azil, yativ gabbeh hahu miskena, ad deachal kol ma dehava gabbeh, vehahu nahama deishtear, yahav leh leorcha, veazal leh.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, la baa kudesha berich hu demilla da yitavid al yedan. amar ribbi yose dilma dina itgezar al hahu bar nash, uvaa kudesha berich hu lezammena kammeh hay, begin leshezava leh. ad dahavo azle, laa hahu gavra beorcha, amar leh chavreh, vela amena lach dela titten nahama leochora. amar ribbi chiyyay leribbi yose, ha mezona gabban nihav leh lemechal. amar ribbi yose tive lemeppak minneh zechuta, nezil venechome, deha vaday bekafture deda tifsa demota itachid, uvaa kudesha berich hu lezammena zechuteh, begin leshezveh.

Addehachi, yativ hahu bar nash, venaim techot chad ilana, vechavreh itrechik minneh, veyativ bederech ochora. amar ribbi yose leribbi chiyyay, hasheta netiv venechome, devadday kudesha berich hu bae lemirchash leh nisa, kamu veorichu. addehachi chamu chad tifsa beshalhove kaim gabbeh. amar ribbi chiyyay, vavy al hahu bar nash, dehashta yaymut. amar ribbi yose, zakkaa hahu bar nash, dekudesha berich hu yarchish leh nisa. addehachi nachat meilana chad chivya, uvaa lemikteleh. kam hahu tifsa aleh vekatleh. kistter beresheh tifsa, veazal leh.

Amar ribbi yose, vela amena lecha dekudesha berich hu baa lemirchash leh nisa, vela tippuk zechuteh minneh. addehachi ittear hahu bar nash, vekam veazil leh. achidu beh ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose, veyahavu leh lemechal. batar deachal, achviu leh nisa derachish leh kudesha berich hu.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Tehillim 37:3) betach baAdonai vaase tov shechan eretz uree emuna, zakkaa chulakeh devar nash deavid tov middideh, deha ittear tov bichneset yisrael. uvemma. bitzdaka. dechad ittear tzedaka, hu tov keden ittear legabbe keneset yisrael. veal da ketiv (Mishlei 10:2) utzedaka tatztzil mimmavt. may tama. begin ditzdaka ilana dechayye hu, veittear al hahu ilana demota, venatil innun daachidan beh, vesheziv lon min mota. man garim lehahu ilana dechayye deittear lehay, havi ema hahi tzedaka deihu avid, kivyachol hu avid leh leella, kema deat amer (tehillim 110) ose tzedaka vechol et. veha ittemar.
Zohar, Terumah 16: Kad nahir yemama beyoma deshabbatta, seliku dechedva salik (Bereshit 8 amud alef) bechullehu almin, benayycha bechedva. keden (Tehillim 19:2) hashshamayim mesapperim kevod el umaase yadav maggid harakia. man shamayim. illen shamayim, dishma illaa itchaze behu, dishma kaddisha itreshim behu.
Mesapperim, may mesapperim, i tema keman demishtae sippur devarim. lav hachi. ella denaharin unetzitzin bintzitzu dinhora illaa, vesallekin bishma, dechalil binhiru dishlimu illaa.

Uman ihu sippur. denatztzetze binhiru dishlimu desefer illaa. uvegin kach, sallekin bishma shelim, venaharin binhiru shelim, venatztze bintzitzu shelim. inhu menatztze venahare begarmayyhu, miggo nehiru dintzitzu desefer illaa, venatztze venahare lechol setar usetar (nusach acher lechol kevod vechavod) demitdabbekan beh, deha minnayyhu, mehahu sefiru unehiru, nahir kol izka veizka, venatzitz bintzitzu, begin dibbehay yoma mitatteran shamayim, vesallekin bishma kaddisha, yattir mishshear yomin.
Umaase yadav, hahu talla illaa, denahir mikkol sitrin genizin, deihu maase yadav, vetikkuna dileh, demittatkena beyoma da mikkol shear yomin.

Maggid harakia. may maggid. mashich venagid letatta, meresha demalka, malya mikkol sitroy. harakia, hahu rakia, deihu mabbua devera. veda ihu hahu nahar denafik meeden, veda ihu denagid umashich letatta, negidu detalla illaa, denahir venatzitz bintzitzu mikkol sitrin. veda rakia angid leh bimshichu dirchimu vetiuveta, leashkaa shakyu dechedva, lemaale shabbatta.
Vechad nagid umashich hahu talla divdolcha, kolla (nagid) malya ushelim beatvoy kaddishin, bechol innun shevilin kaddishin. kevan decholla itchabbar beh, itavid beh archa leashkaa ulevarcha letatta.

Yom leyom: yoma leyoma, veizka leizka. hasheta mishtae kera beorach perat, hech shamayim mesapperim umetakkenin bisfiru uvintzitzu illaa lehay kavod, vehech nagid umashich hahu rekia, negidu detalla illaa. veamar, yom leyom yabbia omer. yoma leyoma, vedarga ledarga, yechavve (sefer acher ochez) leitkallela da beda, uleitnahara da min da, mehahu sefiru dimnatztzetze umenahare shamayim, lehay kavod. yabbia: kema deat amer mabba itavid vegomer. ochu leanhara da min da, uleitnatztzetza da min da, mehahu sefiru unetzitzu.

Omer: kelala deatvavn ushevilin denafkin meabba veimma, vehahu resha denafik minnayyhu, deihu bera buchera, alef: abba. vechad ihu salik venachit, itchabberat 40 bahade 1, veihu em. Rabbi: resha (178 amud bet) buchera. kad mitchabberan atvavn kullehu, omer. da nehiru deabba veimma uvera buchera, venaharin da beda bechibbura chada. shalta beyoma deshabbatta. veal da kolla itkelil da beda, begin lemehve chad. uvegin kach ochu da beda, hahu omer shelitu illaa, lemeheve kolla chad.
Vechad kol hay itnegid veitmeshach lehay rakia, keden ihu ashke veanhir letatta, lehay kevod el, lemebad toladin bediyyukena deinnun shamayim, denaharin lehahu kevod el. (veda hu dichtiv)

Velayla lelayla yechavve daat, retichin dilah (da leda) deinnun gufa dechurseyay, vechullehu ikrun lelot, kema deat amer (Tehillim 16:7) af lelot yisseruni chilyotay. reticha illaa, itkere yamim, yom leyom. reticha tattaa, ikre lelot, layla lelayla.

Yechavve. daat, yechavve: yechayye. yechayye toladin, deinnun (nusach acher beinnun) shamayim. vei tema, yechavve lav yechayye. ta chaze, ketiv (Bereshit 3:20) vayyikra haadam shem ishto chavva, ki hi hayta em kol chay. chavva vechayya bemilla chada sallekin. veal deistallak (nusach acher da istallak) 10, veayil 6, deihu kedka yeot, deha 6 ihu chayyin vadday, veal da chavva vechayya, 10 (sefer acher zeera netila) natla chayyin min 6. uf hacha, yechavve, yechayye.

Daat: da ihu raza deshamayim. ma shamayim shit sitrin, uf hacha shit sitrin, beinnun toladin deka yechayye kegavvna dileh, veal da yom leyom itkelil bedarga illaa omer. velayla lelayla beraza didchura, deka nahir lah deihu shemeh (nusach acher 390) daat.

Uvegin dehay omer raza illaa ihu, vela kishar amiran, ahdar kera aleh veamar, en omer veen devarim, kishar amiran dealma. ella hay omer, raza illaa ihu, bedargin illain, delet tamman amiran udevarim, vela ishtemau, kishar dargin deinnun raza dimhemnuta, deinnun kala demishtema, aval hane la (Bereshit 50) ishtemau lealmin, vehayeynu dichtiv beli nishma kolam.

Aval bechol haaretz yatza kavvam, af al gav deinnun temirin illain, dela ityeydau lealmin, negidu umeshichu dilhon, itmeshach veitnegid letatta. uvegin hahu meshichu, it lan mehemnuta shelemata, behay alma, vechol beni alma mishtau raza dimhemnuta dekudesha berich hu, beinnun dargin, keillu itgalleyayn, vela havo temirin ugenizin, vehayeynu uviktze tevel millehem, meresha dealma, ad sayyfe alma mishtaan innun chakkime libba, beinnun dargin genizin, af al gav dela ityeydau.

Aval bema ishtemodan, begin delashshemesh sam ohel bahem, begin shimsha kaddisha, deihu mashkena meinnun dargin illain kaddishin, veihu nehora, denatil kol nehorin genizin, vehahu meshichu dilhon, uvegineh itchaze mehemnuta bechol alma.

Man denatil leshimsha, keman denatil lechullehu dargin. begin deshimsha ihu ohel deitkelil behon, venatil kolla, veihu nahir lechol innun gevavne nehorin letatta. veal da vehu kechatan yotze mechuppato, binhiru unetzitzu dechol nehorin genizin, dechullehu betiuveta biruta shelim, yahave leh reutayyhu unehiru dilhon, kema dilchatan it reu vetiuveta dechalla (nusach acher dechullehu) lemehav lah nevizbezan umattenan. veal da vehu kechatan yotze mechuppato.

Man chuppato. da eden. veraza da, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden. eden, da ihu chuppa dechafya al kolla. yasis kagibbor. yasis, missitra deor kadmaa dela ishtechach beh dina kelal. kegibbor, missitra digvura, veaf al gav digvura ihi dina shelim, kegibbor ketiv, vela gibbor, begin deamtik dina bechesed, venatil kolla kachada, betiuveta ureuta shelim. vechol da, larutz orach. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam darech leashkaa uleashlema nehiru desihara bechol sitrin, (215 amud alef) ulemiftach bah orach leanhara letatta.

Miktze hashshamayim motzao, missayyfe illen shamayim illain dekaamaran, ihu appik, begin divsiyyuma degufa, ihu appik, uvehahu atar ishtemoda ben dechar lenukeba. veda hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:32) ulemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim. ketze hashshamayim da (Rabbi amud alef) alma illaa. ulemiktze hashshamayim, da (malka 4) shelama dileh. kema dehay natil kol nehorin, vechullehu beh, uf hachi hay, natil kol nehorin, vechullehu beh, veihu nafik mikketze hashshamayim.

Utekufato: desachara (sefer acher desihara) bechol innun sitrin (nusach acher sefiran) kaddishin, deitchazun leitnahara uleitshakaa ulenatztzetza minneh. veen nistar, let man deitchafya mehahu nehiru, deha lechullehu anhir bichlala chada, lechol chad vechad kema deitchaze leh.

Vechad kullehu ishtelimu veitnehiru miggo shimsha, keden sihara mitattera begavvna deimma illaa, shelema ben tarin, veda ihu dichtiv torat Adonai temima, deha keden ihi (shelema) temima, mikkol sitrin, beraza dachamesh dargin, kegavvna deima illaa, deinnun chamesh raza dechamshin.

Uvegine kach, ihi atya bachamesh chamesh tevin, begin leashlema leraza dechamshin. torat Adonai temima meshivat nafesh, ha chamesh. edut Adonai neemana machkimat peti, ha chamesh. pikkude Adonai yesharim mesammeche lev, ha chamesh. mitzvat Adonai bara meirat enayim, ha chamesh. yirat Adonai tehora omedet laad, ha chamesh. mishpete Adonai emet tzadku yachdav, ha chamesh. vechullehu atyayn bachamesh chamesh, leitkallela kegavvna deimma illaa.

Veal da, Adonai Adonai shit zimnin, lokovel shit sitrin illain, deinnun raza dishma illaa, (nusach acher dishmayya illain) veal da, sihara itmalleya veishtelim besiddura illaa kedka yeot, veda ihu beyoma deshabbatta, decholla ishtelim kedka yeot, beraza deshabbatta ella vetatta.

Veal da beyoma da, ittosaf nehiru becholla, kidkamran. shamayim natle mimmekora dechayye bekadmita, veinnun menahare umetakkene lichvod illaa, meraza (Bereshit 35 amud bet) desefer illaa, abba decholla. umeraza desefer, imma illaa. veihu, meraza desippur. uvegin kach, mesapperim, kidkamran. beraza ditlat shemahan illen, deshaltin beyoma deshabbatta, al kol shear yomin.

Uvegine kach tushebachta da, kaamar david beruach kudsha, al nehiru unetzitzu veshuletanu (nusach acher ushelimu) deyoma deshabbatta al kol shear yomin (sefer acher vetikkuna dileh deittatkenat beyoma da mikkol shear yomin) begin raza dishma illaa, deka nahir binhiru, venatzitz bintzitzu, veishtelim bishlimu ella vetatta. ucheden torat Adonai temima, shabbat demaale shabbatta, (sefer acher raza deshamor kevod layla deha hi torat Adonai temima tora shebbeal pe moshe kibbel tora missinay veha ittearu al tora shebbeal pe deillu tora shebbichtav ha ketiv vaytzav masheraz et haleviyyim vegomer lakoach et sefer hattora. veda lelevae itchaze lehay deachid beshimsha umalka daatayya minneh moshe nahir leyisrael 40 shenin shimsha beyomoy vetorat Adonai da mealay shabbeta) beraza chada kidkamran.

rashi: Ki cho amar Adonai. sofan liknot battim:
targum: Are chidnan amar Adonai tzevaot elaha deyisrael od yizdabbenun battin vechaklin vecharmin beara hada:

rashi: Uvaadam. bishar anashim. davar acher: otot shehayu shekulin leyisrael ulemitzrayim, ketzad? "vayhi heanan vehachoshech vayyaer hallayla" (Shemot 14:20) – oto mazzal sheshshimmesh choshech lemitzrayim, shimmesh or leyisrael; midrash aggada:
targum: Deshaveta atin umoftin beara demitzrayim ad yoma haden uleyisrael avadta perishan bego bene enasha vaavadta lach shum beyoma haden:

rashi: Velo tonu ish et amito. kan hizhir al onaat devarim, shello yaknit et chavero velo yassiennu etza sheenah hogenet lo, lefi darko vahanaato shel yoetz, veitto mi yodea im nitkavvanti leraa? lechach neemar veyareta meelohecha — hayyodea machashavot hu yodea. kol davar hammasur lallev, sheen makkir ella mi shehammachashava velibbo, neemar bo veyareta meelohecha (sifra; bava metzia 58):
ohc: Velo tonu vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (bava metzia noach:) shehakkatuv medabber beonaat devarim, ulefi peshat hakkatuv yirtze ki hagam sheamar lemala al tonu vedikdek lomar miyyad lehodia ki beonaat mittaltelim hakkatuv medabber velo beonaat karka, chash hakkatuv sheyyite hattoe ki bekarkaot muttar leonot, laze amar lo tonu vegomer. veamar veyareta meelohecha perush, hagam sheen din onaa bahem, hu davka leinyan mishpat yoshve tevel, aval leolam issur onaa yesh baddavar, vetaam sheamarti sheen bo onaa hu mittaam shehinnachti mishpat ze ladun oto ani, vehu amro ki ani Adonai elohechem perush, shofet etchem baddavar hazze lo letzad shemmuttar leonot bekarka. veharebe dinim matzinu battora she sillek mishpatam levet din shel mala, veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat mishpatim (Shemot 21:12). uma shellefanenu yesh taam baddavar letzad sheyyimmatze adam mocher shave mea bachamishshim o lehefech, en bet din yachol laamod al haddavar ladaat hakkinyan shehu letzad haratzon veet shehu letzad haonaa, vesillek Adonai dino levochen levavot veyodea machshevot adam vetachbulotav.

Uchevar katavti lemala ki mikkach taut yeshno afillu bekarkaot, vechen katav harambam beferek 15 mehilchot mechira: vechen hammocher lachavero karka vechulei venimtza vammikkach mum shello yada bo hallokeach, machziro afillu leachar kamma shanim, ad kan. uferushenu ze kelaluhu chazal bemaamaram sheamru "al tonu" beonaat devarim, shebbaze nichlal kol min onaa, ki gam hameanne chavero lerammoto bedivre sheker hu meannehu, vahare hu bichlal onaat devarim.

rashi: Befesha ish ra. yavo mokesh:
Vetzaddik. shello halach bidrachav, yarun vesameach:
targum: Gavra visha bechoveh mittetzid vetzadika dayetz vechade:

rashi: Lishlosh hashshanim. liktzat hashshishshit — minnisan vead roah, velashsheviit, velashsheminit, sheyyizreu vashsheminit bemarcheshvan veyiktzeru venisan:
ohc: Vetzivviti et birchati vegomer. beracha zo enah batztzomeach, shekkevar hivtiach "venatna haaretz piryah" shehu gevul sheggaval Adonai bechochah, ella shemmavtiach birkat hattevua kechad kemach hatztzarfit (Melachim 1 17:16) ucheshemen eshet ovadya (Melachim 2 4:7), vehu sheddikdek lomar veasat et hattevua, perush habberacha sheyyetzav Adonai taase ribbuy battevua kede shettaspik leshalosh shanim, hagam shehaaretz totzi tzimchah kemidde shana beshana. tze ulemad mikkav chittim shebbaaliyya (taanit kad.), veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk "vechi yesh li chol" (Bereshit 33:11).

Lishlosh hashshanim. peshat hakkatuv hu lashshana atzmah shehi shishshit, veshana sheviit, veshana sheminit. al ze hadderech: mechodesh sivan shel shana shishshit ad chodesh sivan shel sheviit veshel sheminit hare shete shanim, umechodesh sivan shel sheminit ad sivan shel teshiit hare shalosh shanim. vehu maamar hakkatuv ad hashshana hatteshiit (Vayikra 25:22), velo ad techillatah shel teshiit ella ad bo tevuatah, hare shalosh shanim miyyom leyom. vehutzrach hakkatuv lefaresh leval tachshov shemmiktzat shana chashuv shana.

rashi: Umode veozev. mode peshaav veozvam mishshuv bam od:
targum: Dimchase chovoy la nitzlach udemode chatoy veshavek nircham aloy elaha:

rashi: Ki avaday hem. shetari kodem (sifra):
Lo yimmachru mimkeret aved. behacheraza — "kan yesh eved limkor" velo yaamidennu al even hallekach (sifra):
Vehaaretz lo timmacher. litten lav al chazarat sadot labbealim bayyovel, shello yehe hallokeach kovshah:
Litzmitut. lifsika, limchira fesuka olamit:
Ki li haaretz. al tera encha vah sheenah shellecha (sifra):
Veare haleviyyim. arbaim ushemone ir shenittenu lahem:
