Geullat olam. goel miyyad, afillu lifne shete shanim, im machru sade missedotehem hannetunot lahem bealpayim amma sevivot hearim, o im machru vayit beir choma, goalin leolam veeno chalut lesof shana (sham):

Vaasher yigal min haleviyyim. veim yikne vayit o ir mehem veyetze vayyovel oto mimkar shel bayit o shel ir veyashuv lallevi shemmecharo, velo yihye chalut kishar batte are choma shel yisrael, ugeulla zo leshon mechira; davar acher, lefi shenneemar geullat olam tihye lalviyyim, yachol lo dibber hakkatuv ella belokeach yisrael shekkana vayit beare haleviyyim, aval levi shekkana millevi, yihye chalut, talo vaasher yigal min haleviyyim — af haggoel miyyad levi goel geullat olam:
Veyatza mimkar bayit. hare zo mitzva acheret, veim lo gealah, yotza vayyovel veeno nechlat lesof shana kevayit shel yishorael:

Ki vatte are haleviyyim hiv achuzzatam. lo haya lahem nachalat sadot ucheramim, ella arim lashevet umigreshehem, lefichach hem lahem bimkom sadot, veyesh lahem geulla chesadot, kede shello tufka nachalatam mehem:
Yihye laaretz. lassadot velakkeramim:
Lo tizmor. shekkotztzin zemoroteha, vetargumo la tichsach, vedome lo "kotzim kesuchim" (Yeshayahu 33), "shorufa vaesh kesucha" (Tehillim 80):

Uvechol eretz achuzzatchem. lerabbot battim veeved ivri, vedavar ze meforash bekiddushin beferek rishon (daf 21). ulefi feshuto samuch lefarasha shelleacharav, shehammocher achuzzato rashshai legoolah leachar shete shanim, o hu o kerovo, veen hallokeach yachol leakkev:
Ba elecha. al pi haddibbur:
targum: Ha chanamel bar shalum achavuch ate levatach lememar zevun lach yat chakli devaanatot are lach chazya achsanta lemizban:

rashi: De hashiv lo. mikkan sheeno goel lachatzain (sifra; arachin 30):
Ad shenat hayyovel. shello yikkanes letoch otah shana kelum, shehayyovel meshammet bitchillato (sifra; arachin 28):
ohc: Veamro veim lo matza yado de hashiv. perush, im yire haadon ki en koach baam lisbol chavalim od, verabbu chovotehem lemala rosh veafas bahem koach hassabbal, vehaya mimkaro ad shenat hayyovel shehu zeman hammugbal ligulla beittah, veaz veyatza bayyovel veshav laachuzzato ki ketz haggalut yeshno afillu yihyu yisrael reshaim gemurim chas veshalom.

rashi: Vechishshav et shene mimkaro. "kamma shanim hayu ad hayyovel? kach vechach, uvechamma mechartiha lecha? bechach vechach, atid hayita lehachazirah bayyovel, nimtzeta kone mispar hattevuot kefi cheshbon shel kol shana, achalta otah shalosh shanim o arba, hotze et demehen min hacheshvon vetol et hashshear"; vezehu veheshiv et haodef bidme hammekach al haachila sheachalah veyittenem lallokeach:
Laish asher machar lo. hammocher hazze shebba legoolah:
ohc: Veamro vechishshav vegomer. hinne letzad shehammecher hu baavonotenu, keamro (yeshaya 50:1) "hen baavonotechem nimkartem", veheavon hu chov al haadam, bishat keriat hashshetar tzarich laasot cheshbon hachov shealav velifroa hannishar, vehu amro vechishshav et shene mimkaro hashshanim shennishar habbayit machur veyitnakke lefi shiur hashshanim meavonot yisrael, vehaodef yashiv, al derech amram zichronam livracha (yoma 86:) bemishpete hatteshuva vetikkuneha teshuvat hammishkal, im adam nehena meheavon yesaggef atzmo keshiur ma shennehena mehachet uvaze yifra chovo. uchemo chen yaase adon haolam kesheyyitkarev zeman haggeulla, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin tzach:) sheyyihyu chevle mashiach, uvaze veshav laachuzzato perush, chozer el hakkadosh baruch hu gam al yisrael, al derech amro (Devarim 30:3) "veshav Adonai et shevutecha", veamru zichronam livracha (Megila 29:) "yashiv" lo neemar ella "veshav" vegomer:

rashi: Ad shenat hayyovel. shehare chol atzmo lo kenao ella leavdo ad hayyovel, shehare vayyovel yetze, kemo shenneemar lematta veyatza bishnat hayyovel; uvegoy shettachat yadcha hakkatuv medabber (sifra; kiddushin 16), veaappiche lo tavo alav baakifin mippene chillul hashshem (bava kamma 113), ella keshebba liggael, yedakdek bacheshbon, lefi hammaggia bechol shana veshana yenakke lo haggoy min damav, im hayu esrim shana mishshenimkar ad hayyovel, ukenao beesrim mane, nimtza shekkana haggoy avodat shana bemane, veim shaha ze etzlo chamesh shanim, uva liggael, yenakke lo chamishsha manim, veyitten lo haeved 15 manim, vezehu vehaya kesef mimkaro bemispar shanim:
Kime sachir yihye immo — cheshbon hammaggia lechol shana veshana yachashov, keillu niskar immo kol shana bemane, vinakke lo:

Asher hotzeti vegomer. vehivchanti ven bechor lesheeno vechor, af ani yodea venifra min hammalve maot leyisrael beribbit veomer shel goy hem; davar acher: asher hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim al menat shettekabbelu alechem mitzvotay, vaafillu hen kevedot alechem:
Latet lachem et eretz kenaan. bischar shettekabbelu mitzvotay:
Lihyot lachem lelohim. shekkol haddar beeretz yisrael ani lo lelohim vechol hayyotze mimmenna keoved aza (sifra; ketuvot 110):

Ad hashshana hatteshiit. ad chag hassukkot shel teshiit, shehu et bo tevuatah shel sheminit letoch habbayit, shekkol yemot hakkayitz hayu vassade baggeranot, uvetishre hu et haasif labbayit; ufeamim shehayta tzericha laasot learba shanim — bashshishshit shellifne hashshemitta hashsheviit, shehen betelin meavodat karka shete shanim retzufot — hashsheviit vehayyovel, umikra ze neemar bishar hashshemittot kullan:
ohc: Uzeratem et hashshana vegomer. hutzrach lomar ken, mitztzad sheamar "veasat et hattevua lishlosh hashshanim" chash sheyyomar haomer: im shana sheminit bat zeria hi, lamma yaase nes kede shettihye tevuat shana shishshit osa lashsheminit? laze gamar omer "uzeratem et hashshana hashsheminit", venatan taam levirkat tevuat shana shishshit tzarche shana sheminit, shehu mittaam "vaachaltem min hattevua yashan" kede shettochlu shana sheminit tevua yashan velo chadash, ki hayyashan meshubbach labberiyyot yoter min hechadash (bava batra tze:) kayyadua, ucherachem av al banim yerachem Adonai al ammo.

rashi: Vekiddashtem. bichnisatah mekaddeshin otah bevet din, veomrim mekuddeshet hashshana (rosh hashshana 24):

Ukeratem deror. laavadim, ben nirtza ben shello chalu lo shesh shanim mishshennimkar: amar rabbi yehuda mahu leshon deror? kimdayyar be dayra vechulei — sheddar bechol makom shehu rotze veeno virshut acherim (sifra; rosh hashshana 9):
Yovel hiv. shana zot muvdelet mishshear shanim binkivat shem lah levaddah, uma shemah? yovel shemah, al shem tekiat shofar:
Veshavtem ish el achuzzato. shehassadot chozrot levalehen:
Veish el mishpachto tashuvu. lerabbot et hannirtza (kiddushin 15):
Adam ashuk bedam nafesh. (sheyyesh alav oshek dam) hu hammachati et chavero veavda nafsho al yado:
Ad bor yanus. ad yom moto yanus leezra, sheyyitkapper lo:
Veal yitmechu vo. mishshamayim lehasepik beyado lashuv, shello yehe hu began eden vetalmido begehinnom. kach nidrash bemassechet yoma (yoma paz.):
targum: Bar nasha dechashesh bidma denafsha ad guva nerok la netzuruneh:

rashi: Leene chanamel dodi. vead achshav kerao ben dodi, shemma shenayim hayu, veim en zot lo yadati mahu. veyesh notim lomar dodo uven dodo haya chanamel leyirmeya, kegon reuven nasa et bat shimon achiv veyalda lo nemuel, uchevar holid shimon yamin, hare yamin dodo linmuel, shebben achi immo hu vegam ben dodo, shehu ben shimon achi aviv shel nemuel. veenah hi hammidda, shello matzinu bechol hammikra ach haem karuy dod:
targum: Vihavet yat shitra dizvine levaruch bar neriya bar machseya leene chanamel achavi uleene sahadaya dichtivin beshitra dizvine leene kol yehudae deyatvin bedarat bet asiraya:

rashi: Vekam habbayit … tzameytet. yatza mikkocho shel mocher veomed bechocho shel kone:

Asher lo choma. "lo" karenan, amru rabbotenu zichrono livracha aappi sheen lo achshav hoil vehayta lo kodem lachen; veir nekeva hi, vehutzrach lichtov "lah", ella mittoch shetztzarich lichtov "lo" bifnim, tikkenu "lo" bammasoret — ze nofel al ze:
Lo yetze bayyovel. amar rav safra im paga bo yovel betoch shenato lo yetze (80 arachin 31):

Lo tirde vo befarech. melacha shello letzorech, kede leannoto, al tomar lo, hachem li et hakkos hazze vehu eno tzarich, ador tachat haggefen ad sheavo; shemma tomar en makkir baddavar im letzorech im lav, veomer ani lo shehu letzorech, hare haddavar hazze masur lelibbo, lechach neemar "veyareta" (sham):
Machalik. medabber chalakot:
targum: Gavra demitpelag al chavreh metzudeta pares al hilchateh:

rashi: Gozel aviv. hakkadosh baruch hu:
Veimmo. keneset yisrael: hammachati et harabbim, sheggozel hakkadosh baruch hu, mafrid mimmennu banav vegozel mehem tova:
Mashchit. yaravam (sanhedrin kav.):
targum: Degazel laavuy uleimeh vaamar let chova chavra hu legavra mechabbelana:

rashi: Uvatte hachatzerim. ketargumo "patzchin" — ayarot petuchot meen choma, veyesh harebe besefer yehoshua, "hearim vechatzrehem" (Yehoshua 13), "bechatzrehem uvetirotam" (Bereshit 25):
Al sede haaretz yechashev. hare hen kesadot, hannigalim ad hayyovel veyotzin bayyovel labbealim im lo nigalu:
Geulla tihye lo. miyyad, im yirtze, uvaze yafe chocho mikkoach sadot, shehassadot en nigalot ad shete shanim (arachin 33):
Uvayyovel yetze. bechinnam:
Chasar tevunot. mittoch shehu chasar tevuna hu rav maashakkot, ki eno noten lev al chayyav umarbe laashok; shehare hasone vetza yaarich yamim:
targum: Shalita chasir haveyana sagian oshkoy veina desane tulemaya nigdun yomoy:

rashi: Mochiach adam vegomer. al averot shebbeyado umafrisho mehem:

Acharay chen. leachar zeman chen yimtza beenav yoter mimmachalik lashon. matzinu bivreshit rabba (Bereshit Rabba 44:5): kol makom shenneemar 'achare eno ella muflag, 'achar samuch. betanchuma (tanchuma, havesapeh lefarashat Devarim 2) al "elle haddevarim" (Devarim 1:1): mochiach adam acharay, ze moshe shehochiach et yisrael achar hakkadosh baruch hu, shennikreu 'adam, shenneemar "adam attem" (Yechezkel 34:31), veneemar bo "ki matzata chen beenay" (Shemot 33:17); mimmachalik lashon. ze bilam, haomer leyisrael devarim metukkanim "ma tovu ohalecha yaakov" (Bamidbar 24:5). moshe machriz: "hishshamru lachem pen yifte" (Devarim 11:16), uvilam machriz umachanif: asu taavatchem veeno makpid! "lo ish el vichazzev" (Bamidbar 23:19) – baummot, aval bachem omer velo yaase (raa sham). ushelomo tzavach al shenehem: "neemanim pitze ohev venatarot neshikot sone" (Mishlei 27:6):
targum: Demachas levar nasha kodamoy chesda nishkach tav min hu demafleg belishan:

rashi: Umeshallem avon avot el chek. haddor hazze, haholchim achare avotehem bederech haraa:
Haggadol haggibbor. velo amar vehannora, amar: ovde elilim merakkedin behechalo, ayye norotav? bemassechet yoma (yoma 69:):
targum: Eved tivu lealfe darin umeshalem chove avahata levanaya kad meshalmin lemechete batrehon elaha rabba gavra Adonai tzevaot shemeh:

rashi: Vattakre otam. hikreta otam; leshon "mikre" (Shmuel 1 6:9):
targum: Vealu veachsinu yatah vela kabbilu lememrach uveoraytach la halichu yat kol defakedta lehon lemebed la avadu vaaraat yathon yat kol bishta hada:

rashi: Shabbetot shanim. shemittot shanim, yachol yaase sheva shanim retzufot shemitta veyaase yovel acharehem, talo sheva shanim sheva peamim, heve omer kol shemitta ushemitta bizmannah (sifra):
Vehayu lecha yeme sheva vegomer. maggid lecha, sheaappi shello asita shemittot, ase yovel lesof 49 shana; ufeshuto shel mikra: yaale lecha cheshbon shenot hashshemittot lemispar 49:
Din dallim. yissure dallim uma hem tzerichim, venoten lahem lev:
targum: Yadea tzadika dinhon demiskene verashie la mitbaynin yediata:

rashi: Avodat aved. avoda shel genay sheyyehe nikkar bah keeved, shello yolich kelav acharav levet hammerchatz velo yanil lo minalav (80 sifra):
ohc: Vechi yamuch achicha vegomer. parasha zo tirmoz lema sheamru zichronam livracha besefer hazzohar (Tikkunim 10) ki Adonai tzivva lesar edom shehu 131 shello yitnaheg beachzariyyut im yisrael, vehu amro ki yamuch achicha al derech amro (Malachi 1:2) "halo ach esav leyaakov". "immach", perush, nemichuto vaaniyyuto hu letzad heyoto immach, shennitlavva lidrachecha haraim. venimkar lach al derech (Yeshayahu 52:3) "chinnam nimkartem", vedarshu besefer hazzohar (10 128.) ki bechinat 131 tikkare chinnam, sheggalut hachel hazze hu leedom, "zechor Adonai livne edom".

Vitzav Adonai lo taavod bo avodat aved, al derech amro (yirmeya 2:14) "haeved yisrael" vegomer, ella kesachir ketoshav yihye vegomer, letzad sheyyesh beyisrael shete bechinot: hamon haam veyoshve bashshevet tachkemoni (Shmuel 2 23:8). vetimtza shehagam sheyyisrael maalin missim vearnoniyyot, en lomde hattora bichlal, dichtiv (Devarim 33:3) "vehem tukku leraglecha" veamru zichronam livracha (bava batra 8.) vechulei, uchetiv (Ezra 7:24) "minda velo vahalach la shallit" vegomer. keneged hamon am amar "kesachir", shehem mechurim bead avonotehem, ucheneged hatztzaddikim amar "ketoshav", sheenam ella yoshvim ben haummot baggalut aval en alehem massa melech.

Veamro ad shenat hayyovel – hu gevul haggeulla kayyadua, "yaavod immach", umodia Adonai ki sof sof yetze meimmo, dichtiv veyatza meimmach, hu uvanav – perush, hannitzotzim hammitbarrim beemtzaut heyotam immo, vehu sod haggalut. sheim lo chen, lamma lo yeyasserem Adonai beshevet musar sham beartzam uvenachalatam? ella echad mehatteamim hu kede sheyyevarru hannitzotzot shel hakkedushsha mibben haaratzot, ki chol makom umakom sheyyimmatzun sham yisrael, beemtzaut hayyissurin vehattora vehammitzvot, hannitzotzot mitbarrim meatzmam, vehu sod amro (Kohelet 8:9) "et asher shalat haadam beadam lera lo".

Veim tomar, im ken im lo hayu yisrael chotim vegolim mi haya mevarer hammitbarrim atta bitfutzat yisrael? da ki im lo hayu yisrael chotim haya lahem koach levarer nitzotzot hakkedoshot bammakom shehem mikkol hammekomot asher bau sham, ma sheen ken achar chetam dechalash kocham, ulevay shettassig yadam bammakom atzmo asher sham hannitzotzot.

Veamar veshav el mishpachto, ki bevo haggoel yitta Adonai betochenu oro yitbarach asher sham hu mishpachat am bene yisrael, gam yakumu shochne afar veyashuvu kol echad el achuzzat avotav, hu or olam bet hammikdash konnu yadav yitbarach.
Lo tirde vo befarech veyareta meelohecha, umitztzad davar ze yitchayyev mita 131 leatid lavo, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (socha nov.), shehare hu mutere veavar mitzvat Adonai:

rashi: Vehaavarta. leshon "vayyaaviru kol bammachane" (Shemot 36), leshon hacheraza (rosh hashshana 34):

Beyom hakkippurim. mimmashma shenneemar beyom hakkippurim, eni yodea shehu beasor lachodesh? im ken lamma neemar beasor lachodesh? ella lomar lecha, tekia beasor lachodesh docha shabbat bechol artzechem, veen tekiat rosh hashshana docha shabbat bechol artzechem ella bevet din bilvad (sifra):

ohc: Veamar et kaspecha vegomer. kan peresh ma hu hanneshech vehattarbit asher machshichim oro, et kaspecha hem haddevarim shehaadam kosef baolam hazze lidvarim hannidmim, lo titten lo beneshech ki kesheadam mashlim taavat nafsho habbahamit umatim rucho mikkissufav hu nashuch baze umetil bo eres hachet. veamar uvemarbit lo titten achlecha perush afillu achlecha shehu davar shehuresheta leechol, lo tarbe bo, ki kesheadam holech achar gerono veyatte gevul hattaava shebbo lemotarot baze yachshich or hannefesh, ki keshezze kam ze nofel, keshemmitrabbe teavon hammurgash mitmaet teavon haruchani, vehu maamar hakkatuv (Mishlei 13:25) "tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho", lo lahanaat hahergesh. veamro ani Adonai vegomer, perush, vahagam sheani omer lachem lehotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim latet lachem et eretz kenaan, lo leechol mittuvah velisboa mippiryah hu hattachlit ella lihyot lachem lelohim hu ikkar haaretz. veamru zichronam livracha betorat kohanim veze leshonam: kol hayyoshev beeretz yisrael mekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim.

rashi: Vayyomer yirmeyahu vegomer. lo letzidkiyyahu amar ken, ella peresh hakkatuv lamma kelao, vechozer ledibburo harishon lefaresh ma haddavar asher haya el yirmeyahu:
targum: Vaamar yirmeya hava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:

rashi: Yovel hiv shenat hachamishshim shana. ma talo? lefi shenneemar vekiddashtem vegomer kidita berosh hashshana (daf 8) uvetokko:

Et nezireha. et haanavim hameshummarim, aval botzer atta min hammufkarim; keshem shenneemar bashsheviit kach neemar bayyovel, nimtzeu shete shanim kedoshot semuchot zo lazo — shenat 49 shemitta, ushenat hachamishshim yovel:

Vishavtem al haaretz lavetach. shebbaavon shemitta yisrael golim, shenneemar "az tirtze haaretz et shabbetoteha, vehirtzat et shabbetoteha" (Vayikra 26), veshivim shana shel galut bavel keneged shivim shemittot shebbittelu hayu:
Vaasher dibbarta. raa aleha, haya uva:
targum: Ha malyata alu al karta lemichbeshah vekarta itmesarat bida dechasdae demagichin kerava alah min kodam dekatlin becharba vechafna umota udemalelta hava ukedamach gele:

rashi: Yaamid aretz. im shofet emet hu, yaamid aretz:

Veish terumot. ish geut, sheeno chash lihyot matun baddin. verabbotenu amru (ketuvot 105:): im haddayyan dome lemi sheeno tzarich liknot ohavim velikkach shochad, hu yaamid aretz, veim dome lechohen hashshoel terumot al haggeranot, hu yehersenna:
targum: Malka vedina nokem ara vegavra avla aker lah:

rashi: Neshech vetarbit. chad shavvinhu rabbanan, velaavor alav bishne lavin (bava metzia 60):

Veyareta meelohecha. lefi sheddato shel adam nimshechet achar haribbit, vekashe lifrosh hemennu, umore leatzmo hetter bishvil meotav shehayu vetelot etzlo, hutzrach lomar veyareta meelohecha, o hattole meotav begoy kede lehalevotam leyishorael beribbit, hare ze davar hammasur lelibbo shel adam umachashavto, lechach hutzrach lomar veyareta meelohecha (sham sefer acher):
Hu uvanav immo. amar Rabbi shimon im hu nimkar, banav mi mecharan? ella mikkan sherabbo chayyav bimzonot banav (kiddushin 22):
Veel achuzzat avotav. el kevod avotav, veen lezalzelo bechach (sifra; mechilta 13):
Achuzzat. chazakat:
Venatna haaretz vegomer, vishavtem lavetach aleha. shello tidagu mishshenat batztzoret:
Vaachaltem lasova. af betoch hammeayim tehe vo beracha (80 sifra):
ohc: Venatna haaretz piryah. perush peri hakkatzuv bechochah laasot, shehagam shennire peri haaretz lo neshaer ki ze hu koach haaretz velo yoter, shehalo timtza (ketuvot 112.) sheggaar hechacham baaretz veatzra kochah velo natna peroteha achar kach kasseder harishon, veharoe peroteha achar gaarato lo kodem yachshov ki hu ze kochah.

Vaachaltem lasova. ulay ki letzad sheamar "venatna haaretz piryah" shehu bigvul haacharon beshomen happerot vetaam happerot, letzad ze en adam yachol leechol mehem kede sevia, veze hu middevarim hannirgashim kefi hatteva, laze hivticham Adonai ki yihyu happerot beofen sheyyochlu mehem lasova.

Vishavtem lavetach vegomer. vahagam shekkevar amar bappasuk shellifne ze "vishavtem al haaretz lavetach", chazar lomar ken, lehavetiach shello yesovev hafelagat shevach happerot lavo alehem shoded. velaze dikdek lomar befasuk rishon "vishavtem al haaretz", lomar shehavetacha zo hi al chimmud haaretz, vehavetacha sheniyya al chimmud peroteha, uvaze nimtzeu betuchim al haaretz veal peroteha.

rashi: Ki yamuch achicha umachar. melammed sheen adam rashshay limkor sadehu ella mechamat dochak oni (80 sifra):
Meachuzzato. velo kullah, limmed derech eretz, sheyyeshayyer sade leatzmo:
Vegaal et mimkar achiv. veen hallokeach yachol leakkev:
ohc: Ki yamuch achicha vegomer. parasha zo tirmoz inyan gadol veheara leyoshve tevel. "ki yamuch" al derech amro (Kohelet 10:18) "baatzaltayim yimmach hammekare", veamru zichronam livracha (taanit 7:) asitem leoto shenneemar bo (tehillim 104:3) "hamekare vammayim aliyyotav" mach, ki keshehattachtonim mattin midderech hattov mistallekim hahashpaot umitmasken ammud hakkedushsha, ki haikkar taluy battachtonim.

Veamar umachar meachuzzato. yirtze al hammishkan, mishkan haedut, asher hu achuzzato yitbarach shebbo hishra shechinato, uvaavonotenu nimkar habbayit beyad haummot. uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (midrash tehillim et) beferush pasuk "mizmor leasaf bau goyim" vegomer, vehodia hakkatuv ki geullato hi beyad hatztzaddik asher yihye karov laAdonai, al derech amro (Vayikra 10:3) "bikrovay ekkadesh", hu yigal mimkar achiv. ki haadon baruch hu yikra latztzaddikim ach kivyachol, dichtiv (tehillim 122:8) "lemaan achay vereay", vehaggeulla tihye behair libbot bene adam veyomar lahem: "hatov lachem ki teshvu chutz, golim meal shulchan avichem? uma yeerav lachem hachayyim baolam zulat hachevra haelyona asher heyitem semuchim seviv leshulchan avichem, hu elohe olam baruch hu laad?" veyamis beenav taavot hannidmim viorrem becheshek haruchani gam nirgash levaal nefesh kol chay, ad asher yetivu maasehem. uvaze yigal Adonai mimkaro. veal ze atidin litten et haddin kol adone haaretz gedole yisrael, umehem yevakkesh Adonai elbon habbayit healuv.

rashi: Kesachir ketoshav. avodat karka umelechet ummanut kishar sechirim hitnaheg bo:
Ad shenat hayyovel. im paga bo yovel lifne shesh shanim hayyovel motzio:
Lo yippale. lo yikkached; veyodea atta shessofenu liglot, velamma amarta li liknot sade?
targum: Kabbel bauti Adonai elohim ha at avadta yat shemaya veyat ara vechelach rabba uvidraach meramma la yitkase min kadamach kol pitgam:

rashi: Yifsha gaver. hammatte mishpat:
targum: Misav beappe la tav veal pittecha delachma nechuv gavra:

rashi: Bemispar shanim achar hayyovel tikne. zehu feshuto leyashshev hammikra al afnav: al haonaa ba lehazehir, keshettimkor o tikne karka, deu kamma shanim yesh ad hayyovel, ulefi hashshanim utevuot hassade shehi reuya laasot yimkor hammocher veyikne hakkone, shehare sofo lehachazirah lo bishnat hayyovel, im yesh shanim muatot veze mochrah bedamim yekarim, hare nitanna lokeach, veim yesh shanim merubbot veachal mimmenna tevuot harebe, hare nitanna mocher, lefichach tzarich liknotah lefi hazzeman, vezehu shenneemar bemispar shene tevuot yimkar lach — lefi minyan shene hattevuot shettehe omedet beyad hallokeach timkor lo. verabbotenu darshu mikkan shehammocher sadehu eno rashshay ligol pachot mishte shanim — shettaamod shete shanim beyad hallokeach miyyom leyom, vaafillu yesh shalosh tevuot beotan shete shanim, kegon shemmecharah lo bekamoteha; ushene eno yotze mippeshuto — kelomar mispar shanim shel tevuot velo shel shiddafon, umiut shanim shenayim (sifra; arachin 29):
ohc: Bemispar vegomer achar hayyovel. tzarich ladaat: 1, lamma amar "achar hayyovel" velo amar "ad hayyovel", ki shanim hanniknim hem mizzeman hakkeniyya ad hayyovel, lo ma sheavru mishshenat hayyovel ad zeman hakkeniyya. 2, lamma shinna hakkatuv leshono, keshehizkir mispar shanim amar "tikne" vetala haddavar ballokeach, ucheshehizkir mispar tevuot amar "yimkar lach", yiches haddavar lammocher.

Uvemassechet arachin perek hammocher (arachin 29:) tenan: hammocher sadehu bishat hayyovel eno muttar ligol pachot mishshete shanim, shenneemar "bemispar shene tevuot". hayta shenat shiddafon o sheviit enah ola min hamminyan. rabbi eliezer omer: mecharah lo berosh hashshana melea perot, hare ze ochel shalosh tevuot, ad kan. uvaggemara: "eno goel" lo katane, ella "eno muttar", alma kasavar issura nammi ikka. velo mibbaya mocher dekae baase, dichtiv "yimkar lach", ella afillu lokeach nammi kae baase dichtiv "tikne", ad kan. od tanya sham veze leshono: achalah shana achat lifne hayyovel mashlimin lo shana acheret achar hayyovel, ad kan. nimtzenu omrim arba halachot: ha – mitzva lishnehem shello yihye hammecher pachot miggevul haamur bakkatuv, 2 – sheim hayu shalosh tevuot bishte shanim hem lallokeach, hag – im lo hayu tevuot bishte shanim kegon shenat shiddafon vechulei enah ola lo min hamminyan, had – im era yovel betoch hashshete shanim enah yotza ad sheyyashlimu shete shanim. ufasak harambam learba halachot ellu beferek 11 mehilchot shemitta veyovel.

Veal pi ze yityashshevu haddikdukim al nachon. amro bemispar shanim achar hayyovel perush, mispar hashshanim sheomer hakkatuv yitchayyevu lihyot, hagam sheyyishlemu achar hayyovel, ki en hayyovel mafkiam. veshinna hakkatuv leshono lomar paam echad "tikne" ufaam echad "yimkar", lehattil mitzva al hallokeach veal hammocher shello yihye hammecher pachot mehaamur. vehizkir hashshanim vehattevuot latet zechut hashshanim uzechut hattevuot. veamar mispar tevuot velo amar mispar tevua, leim hayu shanim sheen bahem tevua o mechamat shiddafon o shenat shemitta veyovel enam olim lo mehamminyan.

Veyesh ladaat taam nachon bedavar ze, lamma yeesor Adonai lallokeach leval yachzir hassade pachot mishshete shanim vechulei, vechi asur lo leadam latet o limchol mamono o lehafekiro veyihye ze keechad mehem? veulay letzad ki retzono yitbarach hu leval yimkor adam sadehu, uchemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha (torat kohanim befasuk 25) "ki yamuch achicha" vegomer sheen adam rashshay limkor sadehu ulehanniach hammaot vechulei, laze yechavven Adonai batztzav lallokeach leval yashiv hakkinyan lammocher, kede shebbeemtzaut haddavar yaamod ben enav hechlet hachazara toch shete shanim, velifamim yimmana mechamat ze velo yimkor.

Od nire al pi ma shekkatav rambam sham beferek 11 veze leshono: hammocher sadehu leshishshim shana enah yotza bayyovel, sheeno chozer bayyovel ella davar hannimkar setam o litzmitut, ad kan. vehakkesef mishne lo rasham minnayin hotzi harav din ze. veulay ki din ze hu ma sherasham Adonai bemaamar ze al ze hadderech: bemispar shanim achar hayyovel – perush, keshehu mocher bemispar hashshanim learbaim o shishshim shana vamala, "yimkar" – perush yachol limkor veyimmashech hammecher gam achar hayyovel, veen hayyovel mafsik lehotziah miyyado kevan shemmachar lemispar shanim. uma sheggamar omer bemispar shene tevuot vegomer – perush noten taam laddavar lamma mecher leshanim yimmashech achar hayyovel, veamar "bemispar shene tevuot yimkar lach" mecher ze, perush, kevan shemmocher leshanim hare ze eno mocher ella shene tevuot lo guf hakkarka, sheal mechirato hu shemmakpid hakkatuv.

rashi: Geulla tihye lo. miyyad, al tannichehu sheyyittama:
Yisba rish. aniyyut:
targum: Defaleach beareh nisba lachma uderadef serikuta nisba maskenuta:

rashi: Bet moshav ir choma. bayit betoch ir hammukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun (sifra):

Vehayta geullato. lefi shenneemar besade sheyyachol legoolah mishshete shanim vaelach kol zeman sheyyirtze, uvetoch shete shanim harishonim eno yachol legoolah, hutzrach lefaret baze shehu chilluf — sheim ratza ligol beshana rishona goalah, uleachar mikkan eno goalah:
Vehayta geullato. shel bayit:
Yamim. yeme shana shelema keruyim yamim, vechen "teshev hannaara ittanu yamim" (Bereshit 24):
ohc: Veish ki yimkor. achar sheamar inyan mecher habbayit, chazar hakkatuv latet taam laddavar ech yihye haddavar hazze sheyyimkor Adonai achuzzato bet habbechira, vehu amro "veish" – ze hakkadosh baruch hu, ki yimkor bet moshav – perush bayit shebbo moshav elohim, ze bet hammikdash, "ir choma" – zo yerushalayim, dichtiv (Tehillim 125:2) "yerushalayim harim saviv lah". amar hattaam hu vehayta geullato shebbeemtzaut ze adrabba niggael, al derech amram zichronam livracha (midrash Tehillim 79:1) befasuk "mizmor leasaf" vegomer, shehishlich Adonai chamato al etzim vaavanim, shezzulat ze lo haya nishar miyyisrael sarid ufalit, veim en yisrael en bet hammikdash velo yerushalayim. laze "vehayta geullato" shel am ugeullat habbayit, ki yesh tikva veshavu vanim ligvulam.

rashi: Veim lo yiggael beelle. beelle hu nigal veeno nigal beshesh (kiddushin 15):
Hu uvanav immo. haggoy chayyav bimzonot banav:
Nivhal lahon. memaher leharebot hon vegozel terumotav umaasrotav (tanchuma, behar 1):
Ki cheser yevoennu. chissaron yavo lo, shehammeera mishtallachat bemaase yadav:
targum: Demistarhav lemazala gavra devish ayneh vela yeda dechuserana ate aloy:

rashi: Rechav nefesh. lehassig kol taavato:
Yegare madon. megare alav middat haddin:
targum: Gavra rechav megareg tigre vedimsabbar belaha nidhon:

rashi: Lo taasu lachem elilim. keneged ze hannimkar legoy, shello yomar hoil verabbi megalle arayot, af ani kemoto, hoil verabbi oved aza, af ani kemoto, hoil verabbi mechallel shabbat, af ani kemoto, lechach neemru mikraot hallalu; veaf happarashiyyot hallalu neemru al hasseder: battechilla hizhir al hashsheviit, veim chamad mamon venechshad al hashsheviit, sofo limkor mittaltelav, lechach samach lah vechi timkeru mimkar — (ma ketiv beh? o kano miyyad amitecha — davar hannikne miyyad leyad) — lo chazar bo, sof mocher achuzzato, lo chazar bo, sof mocher et beto, lo chazar bo, sof love veribbit — kol ellu haacharonot kashot min harishonot — lo chazar bo, sof mocher et atzmo, lo chazar bo, lo dayyo leyisrael ella afillu legoy:
Veeven maskit. leshon kissuy, kemo "vesakkoti chappi" (Shemot 33), shemmechassin hakkarka beritzpat avanim:
Lehishtachavot aleha. afillu lashshamayim, lefi shehishtachavaa befishshut yadayim veraglayim hi veasra tora laasot ken chutz min hammikdash (Megila 22):
Vehair nittena. velamma li sade?
targum: Veat amart li Adonai elohim zevun lach chakla bechaspa veashed sahaden vekarta imsarat bida dechasdae:

rashi: Vehechezakta bo. al tannichehu sheyyered veyippol veyihye kashe lahakimo, ella chazzekehu mishsheat motat hayyad; lema ze dome? lemassooy sheal hachamor, odehu al hachamor echad tofes bo umaamido, nafal laaretz, chamishsha en maamidin oto:
Ger vetoshav. af im hu ger o toshav; veezehu toshav? kol shekkibbel alav shello laavod aza veochel nevelot (80 sifra):
ohc: Vechi yamuch achicha vegomer. parasha zo tair haadam al ruach Adonai achinu asher shachan betochenu, veamar "ki yamuch achicha" shehu ruach hachayyim asher nata betochenu lechayyotenu, im raa haadam ki lo heir battora velo bammitzvot ki en ani ki im min hattora vehammitzvot, umata yado vehechshich oro vehodo, immach perush letzad heyoto immach hu shennitmotet shezzulatcha haya oro meir missof haolam vead sofo, vetimtza sheyyevakkesh Adonai lehachazir lo haruach kaasher netanah, keamro (Kohelet 12:7) "veharuach tashuv" vegomer veamru zichronam livracha (shabbat kinnev:) "tenah lo kemo shennetanah lecha", vitzav Adonai vehechezakta bo perush, sheyyitchazzek lashuv bitshuva lahashivo limchono, ki en lecha davar hammaamid laruach hachiyyuni bemakom gavoah kitshuva.

Vechi yamuch achicha umata yado immach. da ki amru yode nistarot laAdonai (102 hayyashar perek lev) ki yesh bechinat nefashot she meviam baadam besod haibbur lesibbot yeduot, yesh shebbaim lehitgorer im haadam baasoto eze mitzva kede lehishtattef bammaase vezoche baze, veyesh shebbaa umityashshevet lesibbot muflaot asher hifli Adonai betikkun hannefashot, ucheneged shenehem amar ger vetoshav vachay immach keneged shete hannefashot habbaim shello middato keshehu mitchazzek lashuv bitshuva, veyizzaher od shello yachshich or rucho vehaggerim itto, vehu amro al tikkach meitto ma sheyyesh bo, uvamme, beneshech uvemarbit kaasher avaer besamuch, veyareta meelohecha perush ki meoro (mechalav) [machtzav] hannefashot hattehorot heshiv lo pikdono, umevakkesh od veche achicha immach sheyyachzir hannefesh betosfot chayyut beemtzaut avodat hakkodesh asher tzivvahu Adonai, vahagam sheamru tena lo kemo shennatna lecha, ze tzad hahistappekut, o lefi ma shepperashti besifri chefetz Adonai (shabbat kinnev.) ki kesheyyittenah laAdonai kemo shennetanah lo baze hi mitallet umosifa chayyim veor elyon veayyen sham.

rashi: Ish emunot. hannoten maasrotav beemuna, sheen ed baddavar ella hakkadosh baruch hu, roe umarbe lo beracha:
Veatz lehaashir. dochek hashshaa lehitashsher beshel aniyyim:
targum: Gavra mehemna sagian birketeh uderahet beavla denetar la mizdakke:

rashi: Hamimmenni yippale. vechi haatidot alumot mimmenni?
targum: Ha ana Adonai elaha kol bisra hamin kadamay yitkase kol pitgam:

rashi: Yippol beechat. beraa achat, veen tekuma lemappalto:
targum: Dimhalech bitmimuta nitperek vedimakman archateh nippul bachada:

rashi: Ari nohem. hu lahem:
Vedov shokek. nehima laari ushekika laddov, shenehem leshon tzeaka:
targum: Arya nahem veduva matzriach al rashia demishtelit al ama miskena:

rashi: Ko amar vegomer. al tomar: lechinnam ani matzniam, shehare hakkol golim:
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai tzevaot elaha deyisrael sav yat shitraya hailen yat shitra dizvena haden yat dichtiv beetz vachatem veyat shitra peticha haden vetitteninun beman dachasaf bedil deyitkayymun yomin sagiin:

rashi: Et sefiach ketzircha. afillu lo zeratah vehi tzamcha min hazzera shennafal bah beet hakkatzir vehu karuy safiach:
Lo tiktzor. lihyot machazik bo kishar katzir, ella hefker yihye lakkol:
Nezirecha. shehinzarta vehifrashta vene adam mehem velo hifkartam:
Lo tivtzor. otam encha votzer, ella min hammufkar:
Tashuvu ish el achuzzato. vahare chevar neemar veshavtem ish el achuzzato? ella lerabbot hammocher sadehu veamad beno ugealah shechozeret leaviv bayyovel (sham):

Usede migrash arehem lo yimmacher. mecher gizbar, sheim hikdish ben levi et sadehu velo gealah umecharah gizbar, enah yotza lakkohanim bayyovel kemo shenneemar beyisrael veim machar et hassade leish acher lo yiggael od (Vayikra 27), aval ben levi goel leolam:
Et sefer hammikna. shetar hammechira:
Et hechatum vegomer. im chatimato, keshehu chatum kedat vechok:

Veet haggaluy. shehuchezak bevet din al pi edav, vechatvu vechatmu haddayyanin ashreta dedayyane, hu kiyyum hashshetarot (ketuvot ka:), laasot haddavar galuy umefursam, pen yamutu haedim. verabbotenu pershu leinyan get pashut umekushshar bevava batra (160.-160:):
targum: Unesevet yat shitra dizvina yat dichtiv beitz vachatem kehilchata vechidachaza veyat shitra peticha:

rashi: Veavdecha vaamatcha asher yihyu lach. im tomar im ken bema eshtammesh? baavaday eni moshel, baummot eni nochel, shehare hizhartani lo techayye kol neshama, ella mi yeshammesheni?
Meet haggoyim. hem yihyu lecha laavadim (sham):
Asher sevivotechem. velo shebbetoch gevul artzechem, shehare vahem amarti lo techayye kol neshama:
Vehayta shabbat haaretz vegomer. aappi sheasartim alecha, lo vaachila velo bahanaa asartim, ella shello tinhog vahem kevaal habbayit, ella hakkol yihyu shavim bah, atta usechircha vetoshavcha:
Shabbat haaretz lachem leochla. min hashshavut atta ochel, vei atta ochel min hashshamur (sifra):

Lecha uleavdecha velaamatecha. lefi sheneemar veachlu evyone ammecha (Shemot 23), yachol yihyu asurim baachila laashirim, talo lecha uleavdecha velaamatecha, hare vealim vaavadim ushefachot amurim kan (sifra):
Velischircha uletoshavcha. af haggoyim (sham):
ohc: Vehayta shabbat vegomer. perush, shello tomar sheyyihye mishpato kishar shulchan haggavoah shehakkohanim zochim bo, ella "lachem" – lechullechem yachad, kohanim leviyyim yisreelim vechulei, vechazar uferat "lecha" vegomer. veim tomar im ken lamma neemar "lachem", shello haya lo lomar ella "haaretz leachla lecha" vegomer? venire ki chash lomar bederech ze, shehayiti omer hakkodem bappasuk kodem baachila, kederech sheamru (sifre) aniyyecha vaaniyye ircha vegomer, mimma sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 15:7) "ki yihye vecha evyon" vegomer, laze kadam hakkatuv vechalal kullam yachad veamar "lachem", sheen gader leechad yoter mechavero beferot sheviit.

rashi: Vehitnachaltem otam livnechem. hachaziku vahem lenachala letzorech benechem acharechem; velo yittachen lefaresh hanechilum livnechem, sheim ken haya lo lichtov "vehinchaltem" otam livnechem, vehitnachaltem kemo vehitchazzaktem:
Ish beachiv. lehavi nasi veammav umelech bimshartav shello lirdot befarech:

ohc: Shesh shanim vegomer. nitkavven litten ase al hazzeria vegomer veal hazzemira shel shana sheviit, ki lav habba mikkelal ase ase (fesachim ma:), vahagam shekkatav rambam behilchot shemitta (perek 1) ki ase nishma meamro "veshavta haaretz shabbat" vegomer, af al pi chen eno nishma mishsham ase dizria vaase dizmira, o ulay lechayyevo bishne asin, veayyen befasuk "veasafta".

Veshesh shanim tizmor. kafal lomar "veshesh shanim" velo hispik lomar "shesh shanim tizra sadecha vetizmor karmecha", yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha beferek Adonai dishviit veze leshonam: benot shuach sheviit shellahem sheniyya vechulei, vechatvu hattaam mishshum sheanu holchim bahem achar chanata, vechevan shechantu bashsheviit dinam keferot sheviit vaasurim bashshana sheniyya lashsheviit. hare shebbailanot anu holchim achar chanata, uvedagan uvirakot anu holchim bahem achar lekita, kemo sheamru beferek kamma derosh hashshana (13:), vaasher al ken hivdil Adonai veamar shesh shanim shel zerone sade bifne atzman veshesh shanim shel hakkerem bifne atzman, letzad sheen mishpatan shave, shezze anu holchim bo achar lekita veze anu holchim bo achar chanita.

Veasafta vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "veasafta", veulay shennitkavven ledayyek veasafta et tevuatah velo seficheha haolim bashsheviit, vehakkavvana baze litten ase al asifat sefichim ki lav habba mikkelal ase ase, o yirtze lehavetiach shehagam shezzaru haaretz shesh shanim uchefi teva haaretz keshezzorah shana achar shana lo titten kochah, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (bava batra 29.) zorea shana achat umovirah shana achat vechulei, shebbaze titten kochah, aval shana al shana uvifrat shesh shanim vadday shettichchash haaretz, veyomar haomer hinne tov meod shettishbot haaretz beofen echad beseder shettitten kochah bishnat hazzeria, veen ledavar ze gevul shettihye shana hashsheviit bediyyuk shenat shabbaton, laze amar shesh shanim veaf al pi chen veasafta et tevuatah begeder harauy lah belo hachechasha mishshana leshana, veen tzorech lehovir otah beshana mishshene hashshesh ki yetzav Adonai et habberacha baaretz hakkedosha. veulay ki laze gam ken nitkavven beamro dabber veamarta, dabber kifshatah, veamarta ki adrabba mattana tova ani noten lahem sheyyizreu hassade vechulei shesh shanim ze achar ze velo tichchash haaretz mittet kochah beshave mibbeli sheyyitztarchu lehovir zulat shana hashsheviit lemitzvat melech.

Od yitbaer al derech ma sheamru besanhedrin daf 26 veze leshonam: machriz rabbi yannay, puku veziru bashsheviit mishshum arnona. vechatvu hattosafot: veim tomar, mishshum arnona hittiru lacharosh bashsheviit deorayta? veyesh lomar vechulei, i namme yesh lomar defikkuach nefesh hu sheshshoel mimmennu veen lo vechulei, ad kan. vehu maamar hakkatuv shesh shanim vegomer veasafta vegomer, perush, ematay en ani mattir lecha ella shesh velo sheva? "veasafta" – kesheatta zorea leesof leatzmecha, aval learnona latet lammoshel – ziru afillu bashsheviit kedivre rabbi yannay.

rashi: Vechi timkeru vegomer. lefi feshuto chemashmao; veod yesh derasha: minnayin kesheatta mocher, mechor leyisrael chavercha? talo vechi timkeru mimkar — laamitcha mechor, uminnayin sheim bata liknot kene miyyisrael chavercha? talo o kano — miyyad amitecha (sifra):
Al tonu. zo onaat mamon (bava metzia 58):
ohc: Vechi timkeru vegomer. betorat kohanim amru veze leshonam: minnayin sheen onaa lekarkaot? talmud lomar "o kano miyyad – al tonu", hammittaltelin yesh lahem onaa veen onaa lekarkaot, ad kan. uvaggemara (bava metzia 56.) hikshu mippasuk "et kol artzo miyyado", veheelu, kol yado – yado mammash, veshane hatam delekka lememar hachi, ad kan. kashe, venilmad mishsham shekkesheyyomar "yado" en yado mammash? veyesh lomar shettevat "yado" mashmauto hu yado mammash, ella sheggam yachol lihyot nishma gam ken reshuto, aval mashmaut yado hu yoter karov bannishma. velaze kesheyyomar hakkatuv yado, hagam sheshshene happerushim tzodkim bah, en ani dan bah ella haddarga hayyoter kerova shehu yado. veim en kavvanat hakkatuv lomar yado mammash, alav shello lomar teva shennuchal lefaresh bah havana zara, ma sheen ken bemakom sheen lefaresh bah ella perush echad, lo yachush hakkatuv ledabber belashon sheyyachol lehishshama bo hainyan. venishar lanu lachkor zot ledivrehem zichronam livracha sheddarshu sheazharat "al tonu" enah ella bemittaltelin, vahalo ikkar hakkatuv bemecher karkaot neemar.

Venire ki hagam sherabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu chen, hu al pi hahalachot shehaya beyadam missinay, semachum bakketuvim. veal kol panim yityashshev hakkatuv lefi peshuto al ze hadderech, ki letzad shetztzivva Adonai al haaretz shello timmacher litzmitut, tzivva shello yone hammocher lallokeach sheeno baki bemishpete hattora, ki haaretz tihye lo ulezaro ad olam, veachar kach yavo betaanat devar melech lehachazirah lo. vedavar ze kayyotze beonaa zo yutzdak gam bekarkaot, hammocher karka al menat sheen aleha meararim veyatzu aleha meararim shehu bittul mikkach, vechan en lecha meararim kehu atzmo shechozer learer al sadehu lehachaziro betaanat zechut hattora. laze tzivva Adonai veamar "bemispar shanim vegomer yimkar lach", ella bema sheamar hakkatuv "al tonu" setam, shekkalal kol min onaa, ze eno ella bemittaltelin, kemo sheddikdek lomar "kano miyyad" kedivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha.

rashi: Ani Adonai. neeman leshallem sachar:
ohc: Et shabbetotay tishmoru vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma chazar hakkatuv vetzivva kan al hashshabbat. venire shennitkavven lehasemich mitzvat shabbat lammitzva shellefaneha, dichtiv "lo taasu lachem elilim" vegomer, lomar keshem sheavoda zara shekula kechol hattora, gam mitzvat shabbat shekula kechol hattora kullah.
Gam od yechavven lomar al hashshemittot, shehem nikraim shabbatot, dichtiv (Vayikra 25:2) "shabbat laAdonai", shemmazhir alehem leshamram.

Vesamach leazhara zo amro umikdashi tirau, al derech amram zichronam livracha (avot 85) lo nechrav habbayit ella bishvil shello shamru mitzvat sheviit, vechen amar hakkatuv (Vayikra 26:34) "az tirtze haaretz et shabbetoteha", vehu atzmo amro et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau shello tesabbevu lehacherivo keshello tekayyemu mitzvat hashshabbatot. veyesh lecha ladaat ki hagam she mashlich chamato al beto venachalato lechallelah lechapparat avon, keamram zichronam livracha (midrash tehillim et) befasuk "mizmor leasaf", im kol ze al hakkol yavi Adonai bemishpat kol hammesabbev becheto et haddavar hara hazze beyom hammishpat hannora kesheyyaamod baal habbayit hammekuddash veyitba haish hammegaresh. uma gam lema sheamar hannavi (Hoshea 11) "lo avo beir", vedarshu zichronam livracha (Zohar 9 1:) nishba hakkadosh baruch hu kulei, ana yolich et cherpato uma maane bilshono uma gemul yaarichennu. vehu ma sheramaz hakkatuv kan beamro "umikdashi tirau" ki ansho gadol, vishaer mizze onesh hashshemita leshamrah.
Chassalat parashat behar sinay

rashi: Ish ashir vedal mevin. keneged rav vetalmid hu medabber, shehattalmid choker veal yado harav mitchakkem:
targum: Gavra attira chakkim hu veaynoy umiskena sucheltana vaser leh:

rashi: Ki li vene yisrael avadim. shetari kodem:
Ani Adonai elohechem. kol hameshabedan millematta keillu meshabedo milmala (sifra):
ohc: Ki li vene yisrael avadim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar "avadim avaday hem", venire ki yechavven lomar al ze hadderech: "ki li bene yisrael avadim" meikaram, kedoshim mibbeten umeherayon beshoresh nafshotam, hagam shello haya motziam mimmitzrayim, vechol ze lema shemmimmennu veelav. aval ma shemehem lechayyevam lehachazik et atzman laavadim – "avaday hem asher hotzeti otam meeretz mitzrayim", shehu taam muchrach lahem umechayyev lehityaches lahem shem avdut.

Ani Adonai elohechem. taam shehitchil hakkatuv ledabber derech nistar "ki li vegomer avaday hem" vegamar omer lenocheach "ani Adonai elohechem", ulay ki letzad shemmetzavve lakkone eved ivri sheyyeshallechennu bishnat hayyovel, laze natan lo hattaam letzad shehu eved Adonai, keamro "avaday hem". uletzad sheyyomar hakkone ki taam ze yutzdak legabbe haeved shello yafkia avodato veyimkor atzmo litzmitut, aval hakkone en alav chiyyuv, uma gam im hu mocher atzmo leger toshav o leeker hu haover al mitzvat Adonai, laze gamar omer ani Adonai elohechem medabber im hakkone sheimmo hitchil ledabber bitchillat happarasha "ki tikne" veim otam shetztzivva otam lenocheach "lo yirdennu veferech leenecha", ki devar melech shilton alehem lekayyem kol hakkatuv.

rashi: Veish ki lo yihye lo goel. vechi yesh lecha adam beyishorael sheen lo goalim? ella goel sheyyuchal ligol mimkaro (kiddushin 21):
ohc: Veamro veish ki lo yihye lo goel. al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 93.) en ish ella hakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv (Shemot 15:3) "Adonai ish milchama", keshello yihye lo goel ki en ish sam al lev, en menahel veen machazik beyad umma yisreelit lahashivah el aviha, al tomar ki chas veshalom avda tikva, ella "vehissiga yado umatza kede geullato". amru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin tzach.) ki hayyissurin vehaggalut hem tikkun hauma lehacheshirah, vehu ma sheramaz vehissiga yado al derech amro (Devarim 2:15) "yad Adonai hayta bam" shehi middat haggevura hachovetet bauma baggalut hammar, uveemtzaut ze yassig limtzo kede geullat habbayit.

rashi: Vegam mibbene hattoshavim. shebbau missevivotechem lissa nashim beartzechem, veyaldu lahem, habben holech achar haav, veeno bichlal lo techayye, ella atta muttar liknoto keeved (kiddushin 27):
Mehem tiknu. otam tiknu:
Mefached tamid. doeg meonesh, uvechach mitrachek meavera:
targum: Tuvohi devar nasha demadliach libbeh tedira uman demakshe libbeh nafel bevishta:

rashi: Yechuppas adam. yitchappes bechol mine alilot:
targum: Kad yechedun tzadikaya sagia shavhora uvekuma derashie mivtze bar nasha:

rashi: Shabbat laAdonai. leshem Adonai, keshem shenneemar beshabbat bereshit (80 sifra):
ohc: Dabber vegomer veamarta vegomer. taam hakkefel, letzad sheyyesh bemitzva zo inyan meniat avodat adama vehafekarat happerot haolim mehailanot vetzemach haadama. keneged meniat avodat haadama vahachanat hatzelachato amar dabber leshon koshi, ki hu davar sheen retzon adam chafetza bo letzad heyoto meniat hattov, ucheneged hafekarat hatztzomeach amar veamarta, ki hu davar shekkol echad yismach bo sheyyomar yado bakkol, gam letzad hahavtachot shetztzivva bainyan (Vayikra 25:21) "veasat et hattevua lishlosh hashshanim" amar "veamarta", amira hammesaedet et hallev.

Od yirtze, letzad shemmitzva zo shel shevitat haaretz yesh bah shene devarim: haechad devar melech shilton sheal avadav chiyyuv lekayyem kol davar, vehashsheni hagam sheyyihye davar ze ben adam lachavero yitchayyev asoto kefi haddin, ki hannoten mattana lachavero umatne immo bishat hammattana tenao kayyam, uchemo chen haadon baruch hu bishat hammattana matne tenaim, keamro "asher ani noten" velo amar "asher natatti", asher al ken amar keneged devar melech shilton amar "dabber", ucheneged heyot haddavar mitchayyev mehammishpat amar "veamarta", perush belo taam gezerat melech yekabbelu hammaamar.
Veshavta haaretz vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hi kavvanat hakkatuv bemaamar ze, im al shenat hashshemita hare hu omer besamuch (Vayikra 25:4) "uvashshana hashsheviit shabbat shabbaton".

Achen nitkavven Adonai lomar samuch lezichron hannetina lahem shiyyur laAdonai baaretz, vehu amro ani noten velo mattana chaluta ella veshavta vegomer laAdonai, vechazar uferesh shiur shabbat ze, im chodesh, im shana, bechamma shanim, veamar shesh shanim uvashshana hashsheviit shabbat vegomer, umeatta im lo haya omer hakkatuv "veshavta" vegomer ella ma sheamar achar kach "uvashshana hashsheviit" lo hayiti yodea sheshshiyyer Adonai leatzmo shana zo, ella shennatan mattana chaluta litzmitut, velo chen hu.

Vehitztzatzti veraiti ki elohim chashavah letova beseder maase ze, ki im haya Adonai noten haaretz al tenay, behibbatel hattenay titbattel hammattana, uvema sheasa hashshiyyur kesheyyishlechu yad bashshiyyur lo mippene ze titbattel hammattana, ella alehem lifroa kol haole bashshiyyur. vehaed hanneeman ma sheamar hakkatuv (Vayikra 26:34) "az tirtze haaretz et shabbetoteha et asher lo shavta" vegomer, umeatta en bittul lemattenat haaretz ad olam:

Od nire taam semichut "veshavta" leasher ani noten", al pi divrehem sheamru (bava metzia 23.) hen shel talmid chacham bimkom shevua, vehechacham asher mimmennu totzot chachma hu Adonai elohim, velaze keshehotzi mippi elyon "ani noten" amirato bimkom shevua. o gam ken letzad shemmattenat Adonai leyisrael din tzedaka yesh lah vaamiratah kedin neder (rosh hashshana 6.), velaze techef umiyyad toch kede dibbur leamro "asher ani noten" amar "veshavta haaretz" vegomer, vezulat ze ma sheamar achar kach "uvashshana hashsheviit" vegomer eno toch kede dibbur lemaamar hannetina shehare hifsik bemaamar "shesh shanim" vegomer "veshesh shanim" vegomer.

rashi: Yafichu. yalhivu, kelahevet esh hannafuach baruach:
targum: Gavra memikne memallin kedava vechakkime mehappechin rugeza:

rashi: Velo neesof. el habbayit:
Et tevuatenu. kegon yayin uferot hailan usefichin habbaim meelehem:
ohc: Vechi tomru vegomer. peshat hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: "vechi tomru ma nochal", uletzad sheyyesh bemashmaut maamar ze shene derachim: haechad hu taam shelilut haratzon bedavar ze shello yizreu vechulei, sheim ken ma nochal uvehechreach lizroa lechayyotenu al haadama. vederech sheni hu sheela al hannisbav mikkiyyum mitzva zo – ma nochal kevan shello nizra. laze ba hakkatuv uferesh hakkavvana bemaamar "ma nochal" bema sheggamar omer hen lo nizra vegomer, perush, lo sheanu omrim "ma nochal" latet taam lishlilut kiyyum mitzva zo, ella hen anu mekabbelim "lo nizra" vegomer, ella keven sheomer lifne aviv "ma nochal", az "vetzivviti" vegomer. aval im tihye kavvanatam bemaamar "ma nochal" ladderech harishon, az lo yetzav Adonai ittam et habberacha.

rashi: Velivhemtecha velachayya. im chayya ochelet, behema lo kol shekken, shemmezonoteha alecha, ma talo velivhemtecha? makkish behema lachayya, kol zeman shechayya ochelet min hassade, haachel livhemtecha min habbayit, kala lachayya min hassade, kalle livhemtecha min habbayit (sham; taanit 6):
Lemin hayyom asher banu otah. beyom shehusad habbayit, nasa shelomo et bat paro (Vayikra Rabba 12, 5):
targum: Are rugezi vechemti chal bekarta hada lemin yoma divno yatah vead yoma haden leagleyutah mikavel memri:

rashi: Tarbe miknato. timkerenna veyoker:
Tamit miknato. tamit bedameha:

Behar sinay. ma inyan shemitta etzel har sinay? vahalo chol hammitzvot neemru missinay? ella ma shemitta neemru chelaloteha uferatoteha vedikdukeha missinay af kullan neemru chelalotehen vedikdukehen missinay, kach shenuya betokko; venire li shekkach perushah: lefi shello matzinu shemittat karkaot shennishnet bearvot moav bemishne tora, lamadnu shekkelaloteha uferatoteha kullan neemru missinay, uva hakkatuv velimmed kan al kol dibbur shennidbar lemoshe, shemmissinay hayu chullam, kelalotehen vedikdukehen, vechazru venishnu bearvot moav:
ohc: Behar sinay vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hizkir har sinay bemitzva zo, vahagam sherabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (torat kohanim) ki lelammed ba shekkol hammitzvot neemru kelalotehen uferatotehen besinay, adayin yesh makom lishelatenu lamma lo limmed ze ella bemitzva zo bediyyuk velo bemitzva rishona o acharona. veulay ki letzad shehizkir mattenat haaretz, dichtiv asher ani noten dikdek lomar behar sinay, lomar ki mechamat har sinay, perush, ma shekkibbelu bo hi shennigmera hammattana, sheal menat tora natan Adonai et haaretz.

Od al pi maamar haggemara massechet avoda zara (77 20.) ufasko rambam beferek 3 mehilchot zechiyya, veze leshono: asur latet leakkum mattenat chinnam, ad kan. veim ken yisrael kodem shekkibbelu hattora dinam keakkum, veachar kabbalat tora yachol litten lahem, laze amar behar sinay shebbaze yachol lomar "asher ani noten lachem". uvaze nityashshev gam ken lamma hutzrach lomar "asher ani noten", ki peshita ki hu hannoten veen acher litot bo. vetimtza shebbefarashat kedoshim (Vayikra 19:23) amar "ki tavou el haaretz unetatem" vegomer, velo hutzrach lomar bah siman, ella shennitkavven lema shekkatavnu. umeatta yityashshev lamma bachar Adonai lilmod binyan av ze lechol hattora befarasha zo velo befarasha acheret.

rashi: Im od rabbot bashshanim. ad hayyovel:
Lefihen. hakkol kemo shepperashti:
Veroe. mechabber lo zonot. verabbotenu amru (eruvin sad.): haomer shemua zo naa – eshnenna, vezo enah naa – lo eshnenna. vesiyyua bammikra, sheen "zonot" bammikra male ella ze bilvad:
targum: Gavra derachem chachmeta nachade avuy udemitchabber bezanyuta movid mazaleh:

rashi: Yad ger vetoshav. ger vehu toshav, ketargumo arel totav, vesofo mochich — venimkar "leger toshav":
Vechi tassig yad ger vetoshav immach. mi garam lo sheyyaashir? dibbuko immecha.
Umach achicha immo. mi garam lo sheyyamuch? dibbuko immo, al yede shellamad mimmaasav:
Mishpachat ger. ze haggoy, keshehu omer leeker, ze hannimkar leaza atzmah, lihyot lah shammash, velo leelohut ella lachatov etzim velishov mayim (sifra; bava kamma 113):
Lo yirdennu beferech leenecha. kelomar veatta roe (sifra):
Kodesh tihye lachem. tofeset dameha kehekdesh, yachol tetze hi lechullin, talo tihye — bahavayatah tehe (sifra; socha 40):
Min hassade tochlu. ay hassade atta ochel min habbayit, sheim kala lachayya min hassade, atta tzarich levaer min habbayit; keshem shenneemar bashsheviit kach neemar bayyovel (sifra):
Makshe oref. millishmoa:
Peta yishshaver. maher yishshaver:
targum: Gavra dela mekabbel machsenuta umakshe kedaleh baagala nittevar vela teheve leh asu:
Vihavt lehon yat ara dekayemta laavahathon lemittan lehon ara avda chalav udevash:

Veyealun kasdae demagichin kerava al karta hada veyidlekun yat karta hada benura veyokdunah veyat battaya deasiku busemin al egorehon levaala unesichu nischin letaavat palche kochvaya bedil leargaza kadamay:
Bechan kidnan amar Adonai haana masar yat karta hada bida dechasdae uveyad nevuchadretzar malka devavel veyichbeshinah:
Uchetavet beshitra vachatamet veashedet sahaden utekalet kaspa bemoznaya:
Besugea detzadike chade ama uveshuletana derashie nitanach ama:
Uzevanet yat chakla min chanamel bar achavi devaanatot utekalet leh yat kaspa shava manan vaasar silin dichsaf:
Deravrevin milchohi vesagiin ovadohi di kadamach galyan kol orchat bene enasha lemittan leenash keorchateh uchefere ovadohi:
Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai im yirmeya lememar:
Ufakdet yat baruch leenehon lememar:
Veappekta yat amach yat yisrael meara demitzrayim beatin uvemoftin uveyad takifa uveedra meramam uvechezvana rabba:

Vaata levati chanamel bar achavi kefitgama dayya ledarat bet asiraya vaamar li zevun kean yat chakli divanatot divara shivta vinyamin are lach chazya yeruta velach achsanta zevun lach vidaet are pitgama dayya hu:
Are havo bene yisrael uvene yehuda beram avdin devish kadamay mizorehon are vene yisrael beram margezin kadamay beovade yedehon amar Adonai:
Vetzaleti kodam Adonai batar dihavet yat shitra dizvine levaruch bar neriya lememar:

bart: Mearev adam shene eruvin. im haya tzarich lelech yom rishon lechan veyom sheni lechan, yachol learev lammizrach velammaarav erev yom harishon, veomer eruvi shel mizrach yikne li hayyom letzorech machar, veeruvi shel maarav yikne li ben hashshemashot dilmachar letzorech yom sheni. dekasavar rabbi eliezer shabbat veyom tov lav kechad yoma aricha ninhu ella shete kedushshot [hen], uven hashshemashot dekamma ledideh hu dekane velo leyom sheni:

Eruvi varishon uvashsheni kivne iri. kelomar veim lo haya tzarich lelech ella beyom rishon, uvashsheni en tzarich lazuz mimmekomo veeno rotze lehafesid lo alpayim shel techumo mikkan velo alpayim shel techumo mikkan, yearev eruv echad latztzad shehu rotze lelech bo beyom rishon, veomer eruvi ze yikne li letzorech machar, uvashsheni hareni kivne iri shello ervu. o im haya tzarich lelech bashsheni velo barishon, yomar eruv ze yikne li ben hashshemashot shel machar uvarishon eheye kivne iri:

O mearev lishne hayyamim. hayenu leruach achat deamre leel. veha tu lamma li, ella hachi kaamre leh rabbanan lerabbi eliezer, i atta mode leyom echad deo mearev leruach achat o eno mearev kol ikkar, sheeno yachol lomar chatzi yom eruvi lammizrach vachatzi yom eruvi lammaarav. lishne hayyamim nammi, dehaynu leshabbat veyom tov, o mearev kemo leyom echad o eno mearev kol ikkar. disfeka lehu lerabbanan shabbat veyom tov i keyoma aricha damu i lo, veavde hacha lechumra deen yachol learev lishte ruchot dilma chada kedushsha hi, vehacha lechumra deamre lekamman neechal barishon en eruv lashsheni, dilma shete kedushshot hen velo keyoma aricha damu:
Molicho. hashshaliach erev yom tov shellifne shabbat umachshich alav ad sheyyikne haeruv:
Venotlo uva lo. shemma yeaved veshuv en lo eruv lashsheni, kidkatane neechal eruvo barishon eruv larishon veen eruv lashsheni:

Bashsheni. chozer umolicho bashsheni. dekayma lan hamearev befat barishon verotze learev befat bashsheni tzarich sheyyearev beoto eruv atzmo shekkara alav shem meetmol, veatta shotek, aval lo befat acheret, devae lemikra aleh hasheta shem eruv, vehave mechin miyyom tov leshabbat:
Venimtza mistakker bahalichato. kelomar kone lo halicha leyom machar:

Umistakker beeruvo. sheochlo. veyom tov achar hashshabbat delo efshar behachi, molicho barishon veeno ochlo, vechozer veholech sham bashsheni lirot, im kayyam haeruv machshich alav, veim rotze yochlennu achare chen:

Modim attem li shehen shete kedushshot. deamritu neechal eruv barishon en eruv lashsheni, vei chada kedushsha ninhu hava leh kechad yoma arichta veyikne ben hashshemashot shel rishon lishnehem, vechevan dishte kedushshot ninhu yachol learev nammi lishte ruchot. verabbanan azle hacha lechumra vehacha lechumra kidamran, mishshum dimsappeka lehu. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer deshabbat veyom tov shete kedushshot hen:
Sear pekudda. leshon pikkadon, shehifkida habbaheret et hassear beor habbasar vehalcha lah:
Vachachamim metaharim. vetaamayhu, dichtiv vehi hafcha, shehafachattu hi velo hafachattu chavertah:
Af devarecha en mekuyyamin. dehay nammi tahor. vahalacha kachachamim:

Zokkah lesear lavan ulefisyon. dei ikka veoto hachut sear lavan, machlito. o im pasa etzel hachut besof shavua, tame. aval im en berochav hachut shete searot veit beh sear lavan, lo metamme, dela chashiv min hannega. vechen im pasa etzel hachut sheen berachbo shete searot, kefisyon rachok min hannega hu chashuv uvae kaggeris:
Aval lo lemichya. daafillu yesh berochav hachut shete searot, en michya shebbo metammea. shehammichya tzericha shettehe mevutztzeret beemtza hannega kemivtzar shehu veemtza hair:
Metzarfan. veniddonim kenega echad. veim pasa achat mehen mashshehu, o nolad sear lavan beachat mehen, machlit al shetehen:
Veim lav eno metzarfan. veniddonim kishne negaim, veim pasta haachat vehaacheret lo fasta, machlit bezo umasgir bezo. venafka minna, dilchi mittehar bae laatoye shene karbanot:

Im hayta derech harabbim. derech sherabbim bokim bah mafseket ben happassim, yesalkenna latztzedadim michutz lappassim, shello yihyu harabbim mehallechim ben happassim, demashvu la kirshut harabbim umevattelim hammechitztza. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Bor harabbim. i paske mayya madkere ahadade, shello hittiru passe beraot ella sheyyihyu mayim metzuyin livhemot ole regalim, vechol zeman sheen sham mayim en lappassin torat mechitztza:
Beer hayyachid. nammi share, diver mayim chayyim hen veha lo paske mayya:

Liver harabbim. deikka tarte limalliyyuta. vechen halacha. veen muttar lemalot mayim ulehotzi min habbeer al yede passe beraot ella kede lehashekot behemtan shel ole regalim uveeretz yisrael bilvad. aval lehotzi mayim kede lishtot haadam atzmo asur, ella yored labbor veshote, o ose mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim:

Nitgalgel chutz lattechum eno eruv. hoil veyesh mibbeto shehu lan sham ad eruvo yoter mealpayim amma, lo matze lemezal ulemishkeleh. vehu shennitgalgel shete ammot chutz lealpayim amma, shekkol adam yesh lo arba ammot mimmekom eruvo, shete ammot mitztzad mizracho shel eruv ushete ammot mitztzad maaravo:
Nafal alav gal. vehu devae mara vachatzina lefinnuye, dehavya melacha velo shevut:

Teruma venitmet. dehashta lo chazya lo ledideh velo leacharine. veitzterich tanna leashmeinan nitgalgel chutz lattechum venafal alav gal, dei ashmeinan nitgalgel, mishshum deleteh gabbeh have hu bemakom echad veeruvo bemakom acher, aval nafal alav gal deiteh gabbeh ema leheve eruv. vei ashmeinan nafal alav gal delo matze shakel leh ella bimlacha bemara vachatzina, aval nitgalgel deefshar denashev zika umahdar leh letoch hattechum ema leheve eruv, ka mashma lan. vetana nisraf lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose, deaf al gav deeno baolam mishshum safek lo mitsar. vetana teruma shennitmet lehodiacha kocho derabbi meir, deaf al gav deyeshno baolam veyesh lomar haamidenna ben hashshemashot al chezkatah shel kodem lachen utehora hayta, afillu hachi lo amrinan chazaka lekulla:
Mishshechashecha hare ze eruv. dilachar shekkana ben hashshemashot en choshshin lo im neevad:

Hare ze chammar gammal. dimsafka lan i kana leh eruv vehacha haveya beto umehacha yesh lo alpayim lechol ruach, vehifsid alpayim shemmeever beto vahala, o shemma lo kana eruv umibbeto yesh lo alpayim lechol ruach, velo kana leever eruvo kelum, umechamat safek ze neesar lalechet ella alpayim amma shebben beto laeruv, demimma nafshach behanach mishtere, aval baalpayim demieruvo vaelach lo, dilma lo kana eruv. umibbeto vaelach nammi lo, dilma kana eruv. nimtza ze moshcho lechan veze moshcho lechan, keadam hammanhig chamor vegamal, shehachamor holech lefanav veze manhigo, vehaggamal meachorav vehu moshcho, vetzarich lifnot lefanav uleacharav:
Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim sefek eruv kasher. deamrinan haamed eruv al chezkato, ucheshehenicho haya betoch hattechum vehaya tahor velo haya alav gal, lefichach eruvo eruv. vechen halacha:

Zehu sheamru. kegon ze shehu badderech veen immo pat, dehashta ani hu, lo hittiru chachamim learev beraglav. disvira leh lerabbi meir ikkar eruv befat, vekulla hi daakilu gabbe ani o mi shebba badderech veen immo pat learev beraglav. verabbi yehuda savar ikkar eruv baregel, vekulla hi daakilu leashir sheeno yachol lelech beraglav lishloach eruvo al yede shaliach. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda. uven rabbi meir uven rabbi yehuda shavim hem shehaomer shevitati bemakom peloni eno kone shevita beoto makom sheamar, ella im ken hu ani o ba badderech sheen immo pat, aval ashir tzarich sheyyishlach pat bimkom shevitato. vehaomer shevitati bemakom peloni eno kone sham shevita ella im ken yesh shehut bayyom shehaya yachol larutz ulehaggia sham kodem shettechshach, veim en kol kach shehut bayyom beshaa sheomer shevitati bemakom peloni lo kana sham shevita:

Osin passin labberaot. shebbirshut harabbim. lefi shehabberaot reshut hayyachid hen sheamukkim asara, veen yecholim lemalleot mehen ulehotzi lirshut harabbim, veosin passin sheyyihyu happassin osin [chalal] sevivot habbor reshut hayyachid, vimalle veyotzi veyaniach sham vetikkanes behemto kullah o roshah verubbah veyashkenna:

Deyumedin. shene ammudin. shekkol ammud meellu haarbaa nire kishnayim. deyu bilshon yavan shenayim. ucheshennoetz haammud heasuy kishnayim lifat deromit maaravit nimtza note dafno echad lammizrach vedafno echad latztzafon, vehashsheni lifat maaravit tzefonit note tziddo echad lammizrach vetziddo echad laddarom, ucheshennoten arbatan learba happeot nimtza lechol ruach shete ammot dofen amma keneged amma veharevach bentayim:

Vearbaa feshutin. baemtza noten lechol ruach luach rechava amma. uvizman sheen ben pas lefas mearbaa deyumedin [ellu] ella eser ammot o pachot mode rabbi meir deen tzarich lefassin peshutin, veim yesh benehen yoter mishshelosh esre amma ushelish mode rabbi yehuda detzarich peshutin, lo nechleku ella meeser ad shelosh esre amma ushelish, derabbi meir omer tzarich peshutim verabbi yehuda omer en tzarich. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Shete revakot shel shalosh shalosh bakar. sherochav kol bakar uvakar ammatayim pachot shelish, nimtza rochav shishsha bakar eser ammot, veze harevach sheyyachol litten ben pas lefas ledivre rabbi meir, veim yesh rochav yoter mizze tzarich sheyyarbe befassin peshutin:
Revakot. leshon egel marbek (Shmuel 1 28):
Rabbi yehuda omer shel arba arba. hen shelosh esre amma ushelish:
Keshurot aval lo muttarot. delo tema keen keshurot velo keshurot mammash, lehachi tana aval lo muttarot, lehachemir ulemaet revach shebbentayim:

Achat nichneset veachat yotzet. revaka achat shel bakar nichneset urevaka achat yotzet, veyesh yoter rochav mishsheillu hayu shetehen yotzot o shetehen nichnasot. vezo kulla hi, delo bainan metzumtzamot kol kach:

Matne adam al hakkalkala. sal sheyyesh bo perot tevalim, matne alav beyom tov rishon shel rosh hashshana veomer, im hayyom chol tehe zo teruma al ellu, veim hayyom kodesh en bidvaray kelum. sheen magbihin teruma beyom tov. ulemachar hu omer im etmol kodesh vehayyom chol tehe zo sheamarti etmol teruma al ellu, veim hayyom kodesh veetmol chol kevar hi teruma. veochel kalkala hammetukkenet umeshayyer hatteruma:
Velo hodu lo chachamim. hu rabbi yose kidamran, desavar kedushsha achat hen veen magbihim bahem teruma. vedavka bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana kedifrishit leel:
Vechen betza shennolda varishon. shel rosh hashshana:

Teachel bashsheni. deim harishon kodesh hashsheni chol, uvetza shennolda beyom tov mutteret bechol, deen hachana lechol. veim harishon chol vehashsheni kodesh nimtza shechol mechin leyom tov veshappir dami:
Velo hodu lo chachamim. bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana bilvad, dikdushsha achat hen. aval bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot modim lo:
Vehachalitzenu. zarzenu vehachalitzenu koach, kemo nechaletz chushim (Bamidbar 32). perush acher hatztzilenu umalletenu, kemo challetzeni Adonai‏ meadam ra (tehillim 140):
Im hayyom im machar. im hayyom hu hachalitzenu hayyom, veim machar hu hachalitzenu machar:

Velo hodu lo chachamim. lo lehazekir shel rosh chodesh berosh hashshana velo lehatenot im hayyom veim machar, ella omer vehachalitzenu setama bishne hayyamim veeno mazkir shel rosh chodesh kol ikkar. vahalacha kachachamim:

Bakkol mearvin. eruve techumin. deillu eruve chatzerot en mearvin ella bappat. vehay bakkol ditnan bematnitin, lav davka, kidamrinan baggemara en lemedin min hakkelalot afillu bemakom shenneemar bahen chutz, deha hacha tenan bakkol mearvin chutz min hammayim umin hammelach, veikka nammi kemehin ufitriyyot deen mearvin velo mishtattefim bahem, delav mazon ninhu, kemo mayim umelach:
Umishtattefim. shittufe mevoot:
Hakkol nikkach bechesef maaser. kedichtiv (Devarim 14) venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha:
Chutz min hammayim umin hammelach. delav peri mipperi hu:

Hannoder min hammazon. lo deamar yeaser alay mazon, deen nikra mazon ella chameshet hamminim dezayne vesaade, ella kegon deamar kol hazzan alay konam, vechol mille zayne umasbiim lefi shaa chutz min hammayim vehammelach:
Mearvin lenazir beyayin. deaf al gav dela chazi ledideh, chazi leacharine:
Uleyisrael bitruma. deha chazya lakkohanim:

Sumechos omer bechullin. demide dachazi leh bainan. uvayyayin lannazir lo faleg sumechos, mippene sheefshar sheyyishshael hannazir al nidro veyihye hayyayin muttar lo beotah shabbat, aval teruma i efshar shettihye reuya leyisrael, sheafillu yishshael hammafrish hatteruma aleha vahare hi keillu lo hurema, hare hi chozeret letivlah veasur leechol mimmenna ad sheyyachzor veyafrish teruma acheret, veen mafrishin teruma beshabbat afillu ben hashshemashot, hilkach lo chazya leh. veen halacha kesumechos:
Ulechohen bevet happeras. setama hi, velav sumechos kaamar la.

Bet happeras. sade shennechrash bah kever muttar lechohen likkanes sham keshehu menappeach veholech veroe sheeno nogea beetzem kisora. umishshum hachi muttar litten eruvo sham, shehare yachol lehikkanes bammakom shennatan sham eruvo vehave hu veeruvo bemakom echad:

Lachotz. laasot mechitztza beno lakkever shello yaahil, kegon sheyyikkanes sham beshidda teva umigdal, alma chazi leh. ufelugta derabbi yehuda verabbanan mokminan baggemara daafillu beyisrael pelige rabbanan aleh derabbi yehuda veamre deen mannichin eruve techumin bevet hakkevarot, velo nakat kohen ella lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehuda daafillu bechohen share. uveha kamiflege, derabbi yehuda savar af al gav deasur lehenot ulehishtammesh bevet hakkevarot, muttar lehanniach sham eruv, deen mearvin eruve techumin ella lidvar mitzva umitzvot lav lehenot nittenu, veaf al pi shemmishtammer sham haeruv achar keniyyato, deha ben hashshemashot kone uchevar naaset hammitzva vehu mishtammer sham kol hashshabbat, kasavar rabbi yehuda en adam makpid al eruvo im avad o nignav leachar shekkana. verabbanan savre adam makpid al eruvo leachar shekkana, verotze shello yigganev, hilkach keshehaeruv mishtammer bevet hakkevarot kol hashshabbat leachar shekkana ben hashshemashot venigmera mitzvato nimtza mishtammesh beissure hanaa, shehakkevarot asurim bahanaa, lefichach lo yanniach adam eruv bevet hakkevarot. vahalacha kachachamim:
Makkifim bekanim. neutzim veomdim, vezo hi mechitztzat sheti, aval shel chavalim haveya mechitztza shel erev:
Beshayyara dibberu. hekellu etzlan sheen tzerichim ella o sheti kegon kanim, o erev kegon chavalim, aval leyachid lo hekellu ella ad sheyyihye bah sheti vaerev. ushelosha bene adam hare hen kishyara:
Kol mechitztza sheenah shel sheti veshel erev kulei. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda paleg aleh daavu, vekaamar afillu lishyara bae sheti vaerev:

Echad mishshene devarim. o sheti o erev. veikka ben rabbanan kammae lerabbanan batrae, derabbanan kammae lo sharu leyachid ella dumeya dishyara, badderech, hoil veeno yachol laasot mechitztza reuya, velo bayyishshuv. verabbanan batrae amre echad mishshene devarim, ben leyachid ben lerabbim ben badderech ben bayyishshuv. vehilcheta kevatayhu. ella sheadam echad o shenayim sheshshavtu bammidbar en yecholim laasot mechitztza gedola yoter mibbet satayim shehu mea amma orech al chamishshim rochav kachatzar hammishkan, ushelosha bene adam o yoter hen sheyara vicholim laasot mechitztza gedola vaafillu kamma milin, kefi ma shetztzarich lahem velichle tashmisham velivhemtam, uvilvad shello yishshaer makom panuy betoch hammechitztza yoter mibbet satayim:
Patru vammachane. layyotzim lammilchama, vaafillu lemilchemet harshut:
Meviin etzim. veen choshshim mishshum gazel, vaafillu kartu otam baalehem vaasaum chavilot:
Ufeturim merchitzat yadayim. shellifne hasseuda, aval bammayim shelleachar hasseuda chayyavim, hoil venitkenu mechamat hassakkana shel melach sedomit hamesamme et haenayim, chamira sakkanta meissura:
Umiddemay. sheen tzerichin lehaferish terumat maaser shel demay, kegon im lakchu tevua meam haaretz:
Umillearev. eruve chatzerot, kegon meohel leohel bemachane mukkaf mechitztzot. aval eruve techumin tzerichin learev:

Ematay. hachitzona tehora kesheppasta happenimit o hachitzona al michya, daamaran leel shehachitzona tehora, hane mille bizman shehi chaadasha muvet, shehammichya chaadasha metzumtzemet lo fachot velo yoter. aval im hayta hammichya yetera mikkaadasha:

Hammotar siman pisyon lappenimit, vehachitzona temea. kelomar, im pasta happenimit al oto motar, shetehen lehachelit, penimit mishshum pisyon vechitzona mishshum michya. veim pasta hachitzona al oto motar, mikkol makom hachitzona lehachelit mishshum michya, vehappenimit lehasegir. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Haya vohak pachot mikkaadasha. samuch lappenimit, vehachitzona makkefet labbohak:

Siman pisyon lappenimit. im pasta happenimit vechisseta et habbohak, happenimit lehachelit, shehare fasta mibbachutz. veim hachitzona fasta vechisseta et habbohak, eno siman pisyon lachitzona, sheen hannega pose letocho. vehay denakat bohak pachot mikkaadasha, deim haya chaadasha haya metamme mishshum michya, dekayma lan michya metammea bechol hammarot. aval pachot mikkaadasha en kan michya, deen michya fechuta mikkaadasha:
Lannamal. makom shehassefinot chonot kesheyyotzot min hayyam el sefato:

Ma anu lered. min hassefina letoch hair, kelum banu michutz lattechum mishshechashecha. vehay namal lav mukkaf mechitztzot hava, dei hava mukkaf mechitztzot, ha kaamar rabban gamliel leel bintanuhu bedir o vesahar dimhallech et kullah:
Shekkevar hayiti mistakkel. bishfoferet shel kane chalul shehayta metukkenet lemiddat tzefiyyat alpayim amma:
Ze hedyot shehesit. davka hedyot shehesit. shennavi hammesit mitato vechenek:
Vehammesit et hahedyot. lav davka, shello matzinu chilluk ben mesit et hahedyot lemesit et hannavi. ella limute mesit et harabbim, kegon maddiche ir miyyisrael, shemmitatan bechenek:
Machminin. leshon maarav:
Im haya hammesit arum veeno yachol ledabber bifnehem. kelomar omer lannissat sheeno yachol ledabber bifnehem mippene yirat bet din:
Beyichud. kelomar, en ish immanu veyachol atta lomar atta ma sheamarta li chevar:
Haomer eevod. beechad mikkol halleshonot hallalu have mesit vechayyav:
Hammaddiach. veim maddiach et harabbim hu, eno chayyav ad sheyyomar bilshon rabbim nelech venaavod:
Mafshitin et begadav. dichtiv (Vayikra 24) veragmu oto, velo chesuto:
Mechassin oto millefanav. perek echad kelomar meat mimmennu millefanav. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Sheyyimsor lammolech. mosro beyad hakkemarim:
Veyaavir baesh. maaviro mitztzad ze letzad ze:

Ad sheyyimsor veyaavir baesh. shenneemar (Vayikra 18) lo titten lehaavir, uchetiv hatam (Devarim 18) lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh, ma haavara haamura sham baesh, af haavara haamura chan baesh:
Ov ze fittom. lokeach gulgolet shel met leachar shennitakkel habbasar umaktir lah veshoel mimmenna atidot vehi meshiva:
Vehamedabber mishshechyo. veyesh sheosim sheyyashiv hammet derech bet hashshechi:

Veyiddeoni. chayya sheshshemah yaddua, vetzuratah ketzurat adam befaneha veyadeha veragleha, vehi mechubberet betabburah lechevel hayyotze min hashshoresh shennishrash baaretz shemmishsham chiyyutah, uchesherotzim latzud otah morim bechitztzim el hachevel ad shehu nifsak vehi meta miyyad. vehi keruya vilshon chachamim bar nash detur:
Vehannishal bahem. shebba veshoel bahem lehaggid lo devar heatid [kegon shaul]:
Beazhara. deal tifnu el haovot:
Mi sheyyatza virshut. kegon leedut hachodesh o lehatztzil min haovde kochavim o min hannahar:
Kevar naasa maase. veencha tzarich lelech:
Yesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach. mimmakom shenneemar lo:

Keillu lo yatza. hachi kaamar, im hayu otan alpayim amma hannetunot lo lechol ruach mimmakom shenneemar lo nichnasot letoch alpayim shel techum beto, keillu lo yatza mittechumo dami, veholech ad beto vahare hu kevattechilla:

Shekkol hayyotzin lehatztzil chozrin limkoman. hachi kaamar, shekken matzinu kulla acheret bechol hayyotzin lehatztzil min haovde kochavim umin hammappolet, shemmippene sheyyatzu birshut hittiru lahem lachazor bichle zenan limkomam velo hitzrichum lehanniach kele zenan, hachi nammi hekellu [laze sheyyatza] birshut lihyot keillu lo yatza:
Rabbi yehuda omer niuul hu ze. shehorgo meummad venofel:

Saddan. etz ave takua baaretz kemot shel nappachim. uvabberayta fershu, detaama defaleg rabbi yehuda adderabbanan, mippene sheamra tora (sham 18) uvechukkotehem lo telechu. veamre leh rabbanan, kevan dichtiv sayif beorayta, deamar kera nakom yinnakem (Shemot 21), lo minnayhu gamrinan. vahalacha kachachamim:
Vehaya makkir ilan o gader. sheyyachol lehaggia sham kodem shettechshach, ella shehu ayef verotze lanuach bimkomo:

Lo amar kelum. hoil velo peresh eze arba ammot bachar lo mittachtav shel ilan, lav shevita hi veen lo ella arba ammot bammakom shehu sham, shehare lo kana shevita bimkomo kevan sheakar dato millishbot kan, vetachat hailan nammi lo kana shevita. vehane mille kesheyyesh tachtav shel ilan shemone ammot o yoter, deikka lememar dehay gisa bachar o dehay gisa bachar velo have siyyum, aval sheva ammot al karchacha mikketzat beto nikkar beamma emtzait dei efshar shello berrah, dei beemtza hailan berer lo arba ammot hare hi mehen, vei mehay gisa o mehay gisa hare hi mehen, hilkach kana sham [shevita]:
Amar shevitati veikkaro. hoil vesiyyem mekomo, otah shevita kona lo alpayim letzad raglav vealpayim letzad beto:
Nishtannu marehen. abbeharot tehorot kae. kegon dahavat kashsheleg ad shello nitgayyer, umishshennitgayyer naaset kesid hahechol:
Ketzemer lavan vechikrum betza. kelomar, techilla hayta chetzemer lavan veachshav naaset kikrum betza:

Naaset mispachat seet o mispachat azza. kelomar, shehasseet naaset mispachat, shechazra lihyot kattolada shellah. o shehaazza naaset kammispachat shellah. ufaroshe kamfaresh leresha dekatane hayta chashsheleg venaaset kesid hahechol, hayenu shennaaset azza mispachat. veotah shehayta chetzemer lavan venaaset kikrum betza, hayenu shennaaset seet mispachat:
Uchesid hahechol uchesheleg. kelomar hayta chesid hahechol veachshav naaset kashsheleg:
Rabbi akiva omer kulei. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Haya rachok mibbet hassekila. dekarov levet hassekila shemma tittaref dato velo yachol lehitvaddot:
Veten lo toda. veaf al gav deen adam neherag al pi atzmo, harigat achan horaat shaa hayta:
Kazot vechazot asiti. baggemara mefaresh shemmaal bacharamim bime moshe:
Shehu mezummam. sheedav hen zommin:
Lenakkot et atzman. min habberiyyot, veyotziu laaz al haddayyanim veal haedim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Bizman sheadam mitztaer. sheppuranut baa alav baavono:
Ma lashon omeret. beeze lashon shechina kovelet umenodedet alav:
Kallani meroshi. roshi chaved alay uzeroi chaved alay. keadam shehu ayef:
Kallani. eni kal meroshi:
Velo ze vilvad. over belo taase im helino:
Lo hayu kovrin otan bekivrot avotehen. lefi sheen kovrin rasha etzel tzaddik:
Shene kevarot hayu metukkanin levet din. lefi sheen kovrim mi shennitchayyev mita chamura etzel mi shennitchayyev mita kalla. vehilchata gemira la shenayim velo arbaa:
Shello yitmaatu mikkashshiur. baheret mikkaggeris, umichya mikkaadasha:
Uvimchunnas. shehashshete searot bemakom echad bannega:
Bimfuzzar. ze bemizrach hannega veze vammaarav:
Bimvutztzar. shete searot beemtza hannega, kemivtzar shebbeemtza hair:
Sheeno mevutztzar. bechut hayyotze min hannega, veyesh berachbo shete searot. ma sheen ken bemichya devainan mevutztzeret umechunneset:
Hafucha veshello hafucha. ben shehabbaheret kadma lammichya, ben shehammichya kadma labbaheret. ma sheen ken besear lavan, sheim kadam labbaheret, tahor:

Umeakkevet et hahofech kullo lavan. deim huchlat bemichya, ufarcha hatztzaraat bechullo chutz mimmekom hammichya, adayin tame hu. aval im parcha vechullo, af al gav dechol gufo male sear lavan, tahor, sheen sear lavan meakkev:

Ben beish echad. af al gav dema nafshach yesh bo vaheret achat sheppasta, otah shettechillatah kaggeris veachshav kassela, vehaya rauy lehachelito, afillu hachi hoil veeno yodea al eze nega machlit, tahor miggezerat hakkatuv dichtiv (Vayikra 13) veim paso tifse baor vetimme hakkohen oto, et hannega havvadday hu metamme, veeno metamme et hannega sheyyesh bo safek:

Ben bishne anashim. af al pi sheechad mehem taun hesger shivat yamim shenit besof shavua rishon, vehaacher muchlat, hoil veeno yodea eze lehasegir veeze lehachelit, shenehem tehorim miggezerat hakkatuv:
Rabbi akiva omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:

Kachatzi goren agulla kede sheyyehu roim ze et ze. deamar kera (Shir 7) sharrech aggan hassahar. sharrech aggan zo sanhedrin sheyyoshevet betabburo shel olam umeginna al kol haolam kullo, vehi doma lesahar, sheyyoshvim beiggul kachatzi yareach. targum yareach, sihara. uvaagulla shelema en yoshvim, mippene shetztzerichim baale dinim vehaedim likkanes uledabber bifne chullam:
Rabbi yehuda omer shelosha hayu. kede sheyyihyu shene edim al hamezakkin ushene edim al hamechayyevin. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Sheenan mittammein bevaheret. bearbaa marot negaim, seet vetoladtah baheret vetoladtah:
Toch haayin toch haozen. shekkol ellu enan chashuvim keor basar, vehakkatuv omer (sham 13) vehaya veor besaro:
Hakkematin. shebbishar hagguf:
Vehakkematin shebbatztzavvar. tana sefa, legalloye dikmatin deresha kematin shel shear hagguf hen. delo tema kematin detzavvar davka delo mitchaze cheacharine:
Tachat haddad. keshenniret kemenika et benah, ma sheeno nire veotah shaa eno mittamme:
Uvet hashshechi. keshennire chemosek zetim:
Kaf haregel. ma shettachat [hakkaarurit] shel haregel. dechol ellu enan or basar hannire:
Vehatztzipporen. la chashiva or basar:
Harosh vehazzakan. enan mittammein bevaheret, dichtiv (sham) netek hu tzaraat harosh o hazzakan hu, en larosh velazzakan tuma ella tumat netakin bilvad:
Hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach hammordin. shello nitrappeu yafe velo nikram haor shellahem kiklippat hashshum:
En mittammein mishshum nega. devishchin ketiv (sham) shechin venirpa, uvemichva nammi chetiv (sham) vehayta michyat hammichva:

Kedach. hu shechin shebba mechamat davar acher, kegon mechamat makkat even o etz o gefet o sid, umichva nammi shello vaa mechamat haesh atzmo ella mechamat toldot haesh, kegon remetz cham vegifsit cham, kol ellu keruyin kedach. leshon kikdoach esh hamasim. vekedach hammored nammi shello nitrappa velo heela kerum kiklippat hashshum, eno mittamme mishshum nega:
Hammordim. kol zeman shello nitrappeu shello heelu kerum, keruyin mordim, kelomar sheadayin omdim bemirdam. veit degarse morrim bishne reshin, leshon rar besaro (sham 15):
