Veen mitztarfim bannegaim. im haya chatzi geris nega beor besaro vachatzi geris beechad min hammekomot hallalu, en mitztarfim lechaggeris:
Veen hannega pose letochan. dechevan delo mittammeu vaom lo mittammeu nammi vappisyon:

Veenam mittammein mishshum michya. deim parach bechullo veyesh berosho o vechaf raglo o vakkematin basar chay, en mittammein mishshum michya. i nammi, im haya echad min hammekomot hallalu mevutztzar betoch hannega, eno mittamme mishshum michya:

Veenam meakkevim et hahofech kullo lavan. im parcha hatztzaraat bechullo chutz meechad mehammekomot hallalu, en meakkevin, dichtiv (Vayikra 13) vechisseta hatztzaraat et kol or hannega, or harauy lihyot bo nega, perat leellu sheen mittammein mishshum nega:

Chazar harosh vehazzakan venikrechu. shennikrach hassear shehaya vahen venaasu cheor basar. vechen hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach shennaasu tzarevet, shennitrappeu vekaram alehem or kiklippat hashshum:
Hare ellu mittammein bannegaim. bearbaa marot. vehu haddin dahava matze lemitne nitpashshetu hakkematin nammi mittammein bannegaim:

Veen mitztarfin bannegaim. rosh vezakan en mitztarfin. vechen or habbasar vehazzakan, o or habbasar veharosh, en mitztarfin. deim ba lo chatzi geris netek barosh, i nammi chatzi geris netek bazzakan, vachatzi geris nega beor basar, en mitztarfin. vechen chatzi geris shechin vachatzi geris michva, en mitztarfin lechaggeris:
Veen hannega pose letochan. nega shel or basar en pose lo venetek harosh velo venetek hazzakan velo vishchin velo vemichva, dela chashive cheor basar:
Veen mittammein mishshum michya. dintakim mittammein besear tzahov ufisyon, ushechin umichva besear lavan ufisyon:

Aval meakkevin et hahofech kullo lavan. sheim parcha hatztzaraat bechullo venishar harosh o hazzakan shennikrechu shello farcha hatztzaraat bahen, o hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach shennaasu tzarevet, tame ad sheyyifrach bechullo:

Harosh vehazzakan shello heelu sear. kegon katan shello tzamach zekano o lo hisir rosho, niddonim keor basar littamme bevaheret. vechen haddildulin shebbarosh uvazzakan delet behu sear, niddonim keor basar, umeakkevim et happericha, vehannega pose letochan, umitztarfin lechaggeris:
Ikkaran mashchir veroshan malbin tahor. deamar kera (Vayikra 13) vesear bannega hafach lavan, haikkar hassamuch lannega hafach lavan:
Kede likrotz bezug. kede sheyyinnatel befi hazzug shel misparayim. vahalacha, deshiur sear lavan, arko en pachot mikkede sheyyinnatel befi hazzug, aval hallavnunit shebbo bechol shehu:
Veniret kishtayim tahor. sheyyesh searot hamechullakot beroshan lishtayim uveikkaran enan ella echat:

Hachi garsinan, baheret uvah sear lavan vesear shachor tame. baheret shehi chaggeris metzumtzam uvah shete searot levanot, vehashshear melea searot shechorot, tame. velo amrinan shemmekom hassearot shechorot memaet habbaheret mikkaggeris:
Netano veilan. haomed birshut harabbim veyesh bo arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim o yoter:

Lemala measara en eruvo eruv. dechevan dehailan rachav arbaa, lemala measara have reshut hayyachid, vehu kana shevitato birshut harabbim, vechevan dei have bae lemishkal eruveh umechleh beshaa shehaeruv zoche lo, dehaynu ben hashshemashot, lo matze shakel leh demayte mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, lo have eruv:

Lematta measara hare ze eruv. dilmatta measara karmelit hi, dechol mishshelosha vead tisha berochav arbaa karmelit hi, vechevan dei shakel leh leeruveh en kan ella issur shevut, hare ze eruv. umatnitin rabbi hi deamar kol davar shehu mishshum shevut lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot. uveshaa shehaeruv zoche lo dehaynu ben hashshemashot matze shakel leh, venimtza hu veeruvo bemakom echad, hilkach have eruv:

Netano bevor. shebbakkarmelit kegon shebbabbika veshebbassadot, venitkavven lishbot babbika o bassade, hare ze eruv, devor atzmo reshut hayyachid vehu kana shevita bakkarmelit, uveshaa shehaeruv zoche lo dehaynu ben hashshemashot matze shakel leh, kerabbi deamar kol davar shehu mishshum shevut lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot:
Afillu gavoah mea amma. veen lematta rochav arbaa, delav reshut hayyachid hu, veaf al gav dilmala rachav arbaa, deha eruv al gabbe mekom arbaa bainan:

Talush venautz. hu dahave eruv, aval mechubbar lo have eruv, mishshum dechi shakel leh gezera shemma yiktom, lefi shehakkane rach hu ikka lemigzar shemma yiktom ki shakel leh, aval ilan kashe hu uven hashshemashot leshemma yaale veyitlosh lo chayshinan, aval ketimat kane ayde dirchicha vadday mikketma umichayyav mishshum kotzer. i nammi kane vekundas michlaf leh mechubbar betalush, dekanim harebe telushin neutzim venirin kimchubbarim, mishshum hachi ikka lemigzar shemma yiktom bimchubbar veyachshov shehu talush, aval beilan lekka lemigzar shemma yaale veyitlosh veyite lachshov detalush hu:
Netano vemmigdal. shel etz:

Veavad hammafteach hare ze eruv. uchegon shehammanul kashur bechutim vachavalim, sheim lo yimmatze hammafteach i efshar lechatchan ella besakkin. tanna kamma savar hoil veefshar liftoach al yede sheyyachtoch hachavalim besakkin en kan issur sekila ella issur shevut, dimkalkel hu bachatichat hachavalim vechol hamekalkelim peturim, veissur shevut ben hashshemashot bishat keniyyat haeruv lo gazru bo kidamran, hilkach have eruv, dematze mayte sakkin veyachtoch lachavalim veshakel leeruveh. verabbi eliezer savar en keli nittal ella letzorech tashmisho, veasur letaltel hassakkin kede lachtoch hachavalim, sheen tashmisho ella lachtoch hoochalim, vehoil veikka tarte, tiltul hassakkin, vachatichat hachavalim, afillu lerabbi deamar kol davar shehu mishshum shevut ben hashshemashot lo gazru, bichhay gavna mode degazru. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Bechol mare. hayenu kemare habbasar, ben kushi ben lavan ben adom:
Metamme vechol shehu. aval bemichya baya chaadasha:
Chutz min hannega, ma sheen ken bammichya. shehammichya tzericha lihyot betoch hannega:
Echad haoved. avoda zara bedavar shedderech avodato vechach:
Veechad hazzoveach kulei. veaf al pi sheen derech avodatah beachat mearba avodot hallalu, chayyav. vechol shear avodot chutz meellu, eno chayyav ad sheyyaavod kederech avodatah:
Vehamekabbelo alav leeloah. afillu vaamira vealma. deittakkash lizvicha, dichtiv (Shemot 32) vayyizbechu lo vayyomru elle elohecha:

Vehaomer lo eli atta. befanav. vaata sefa legalloye resha. dei tana resha hava amena hane mille befanav aval shello befanav lo, tana sefa befanav, mikkelal deresha shello befanav vaafillu hachi chayyav:
Hamegappef. mechabbek:
Over belo taase. lo taavdem yetera chetiv:
Hannoder bishmo. konam alay kol perot shebbaolam beshem avoda zara feloni:
Hamekayyem. nishba:
Over belo taase. veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru (sham 23):
Happoer atzmo. matriz rei lefanav:
Zo hi avodato. vaafillu nitkavven levazzoto, hoil vezo hi avodato chayyav chattat:
Vehazzorek even lemarkulis. sheovdim oto bizrikat avanim. vehamesallek even millefanav nammi chayyav, sheovdim oto nammi besilluk avanim:
Markulis. chilluf hashshevach. mar leshon chilluf hu, kemo bemar dechanta, bemar dishchuta. killus, shevach:
Zo hi avodato. vaafillu nitkavven leragmo, chayyav chattat:

Min hatztzad. min hakketannim bechachma shehayu yoshvim batztzad. deamar kera (sham 23) velo taane al riv, uchetiv rav, kelomar lo taane al mufla shebbevet din velintot middevarav, lefichach en shomin devarav ella vassof:
Hakkol kesherim ladun. vaafillu ger. vehu shettehe immo miyyisrael. umamzer nammi kasher ladun dine mamonot:
Veen hakkol kesherim ladun dine nefashot. dichtiv (Shemot 18) vehakel mealecha venasu ittecha, bedomin lecha, ma moshe rabbenu meyuchas af bet din meyuchasim:

Sheenan mittammein mishshum michya. dichtiv veraahu hakkohen, bainan sheyyire et hannega im hammichya kullo cheechad, uchesheyyesh kaggeris berosh hachotem o verashe etzbaot hu shofea elach vaelach veeno yachol lirot kullo cheechad:
Rashe aznayim. nechshavim keechad. vechen rashe daddin. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda shemmana rashe daddin shebbaish:
Verosh haggeviyya. hu gid haamma:
Veyabbalot. leshon [o charutz o yabbelet] (Vayikra 22). 592 belaaz:
Vedildulin. basar shepperesh veniddaldel. veit degarse vetiltulin, basar shennaasa chemo tel gavoah. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Arba mitot. sekila serefa hereg vachenek. sekila chamura misserefa, ushetehen mehereg ushelashtan mechenek. venafka minna lemi shennitchayyev shete mitot, dekayma lan deniddon bachamura:
Rabbi shimon omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Zo mitzvat hanniskalin. ha defarishna vefirkin dilel:
Meshakkein oto. shello yithappech ana vaana vetippol happetila al besaro:
Kasha letoch harakka. korchim sudar kasha letoch harakka. kasha mibbifnim lachanok, verakka mibbachutz lehagen:
Et happetila. petila shel avar madlik. umattich letoch piv:

Vechomeret. kovetzet. leshon chomarmeru meay (Eicha 2). veyalfinan mibbene aharon shenneemar bahem (Vayikra 10) kol bet yisrael yivku et hasserefa, velo nisrefu gufatam deha chetiv (sham) vayyikrevu vayyissaum bechuttonotam, hacha nammi mitkayyemet mitzvat serefa af al pi sheen nisrafim ella vene meayim bilvad. vehachi adif tefe, dichtiv (sham 19) veahavta lereacha kamocha, beror lo mita yafa:
Af hu im met beyadam. kelomar im haya met beyadam al yede chanikatam kodem zerikat happetila:
Lo hayu mekayyemim mitzvat serefa. lefichach lo hayu chonkim oto:
Ella fotchim et piv bitzvat. 123 belaaz. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shello haya vet din shel otah shaa baki. tzedokin hayu, sheen lahem gezera shava ella kera chemashmao:

Yesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach. desavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri cheftze hefker sheen lahem daat bealim konim shevita bimkoman veyesh lahem alpayim amma lechol ruach, vehayyashen sheen lo daat beshaa shekkone shevita dino kecheftze hefker veyesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach. verabbanan savre cheftze hefker en konin shevita bimkoman, ella hazzoche bahen molichan lemakom shehu yachol lelech, hacha nammi hayyashen eno kone shevita veen lo ella arba ammot bilvad. vahalacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri shehayyashen kone shevita bimkomo veyesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach. aval benichse hefker halacha kachachamim shehen keragle kol adam veen konin shevita bimkoman, ella hazzoche bahen molichan lemakom shehu yachol lelech:

Vachachamim omrim en lo ella arba ammot. hoil uveshaa shekkadash hayyom haya yashen lo kana shevita, veen lo ella arba ammot shezzikketa lo tora dichtiv (Shemot 16) shevu ish tachtav, vekomato shel adam benoni shalosh ammot veamma achat lifshot yadav veraglav:
Rabbi eliezer omer vehu veemtzaan. chachamim savre yahavinan leh arba ammot lechol ruach, verabbi eliezer savar ki yahavinan leh arba ammot hayenu shete ammot lechol tziddav:
Leeze ruach sheyyirtze. yittol arba ammot, veachar shebberer tzad echad en yachol lachazor velivror tzad acher:

Shemma titabber. shemma yaasu bet din haggadol elul meubbar veyihyu shene yamim tovim, yom 30‏ shel elul veyom 31, vehu tzarich lelech barishon letzad echad uvashsheni letzad acher, mearev shene eruvin umenichan beerev yom tov ze lechan veze lechan veomer vechulei:

Velo hodu lo chachamim. dekasavre kedushsha achat hen. vahalacha kachachamim bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana. delav mishshum sefeka bilvad ittekan shemma kiddeshu bet din et yom sheloshim o yom 31 veechad mehem chol, ella mishshum deshemma bau edim min hammincha ulemala, shennohagin oto hayyom kodesh ulemachar kodesh vetarvayhu kedushsha achat. aval bishar yamim tovim shel galuyyot delo atkun ella missefeka delo yadinan matay kiddeshu bet din haggadol et hachodesh, modim chachamim lerabbi yehuda dishte kedushshot hen. vachachamim haamurim kan hu rabbi yose:
Shenehem temein. devishnehem pasa:
Af al pi shechazru lihyot kassela. dehashta echad mehem tahor, hoil vehuzkeku lattuma, shenehem temeim. dichtiv (sham) vetiharo hakkohen, et havvadday hu metaher, veeno metaher et hassafek:
Ad sheyyachzeru lihyot kaggeris. dehashta vadday shenehem tehorim, shehappisyon shebbaavuro huchlat halach mishshenehem:
Nigmar haddin. chutz levet din. rachok mibbet din. shemma veod shemmolichin oto levet hassekila, yimtzeu lo zechut veyippater:
Vehassudarin beyado. lehanif. vehu siman lehachaziro:

Uvilvad sheyyehe mammash bidvarav. veim en mammash bidvarav, paam rishona usheniyya vilvad machazirin oto, dilma mechamat biatuta nistattemu taanotav veulay tityashshev dato alav veyizkor taanotav, yoter al kach en machazirin oto. umosrin lo shene talmide chachamim sheyyeayyenu im yesh mammash bidvarav, sheaz machazirin oto arba vechamesh peamim:
Ufeloni ufeloni edav. sheavar avera felonit beyom peloni beshaa felonit bemakom peloni. dilma ikka demezim lehu:
Kol sefek negaim. chutz mizze. desafek baheret kadma safek sear lavan kadam:
Hare hi chassela. naaset rechava ugedola chassela:
Safek shehi hi. ureuya lehachelit shehare fasa:
Safek sheacheret baa tachteha. veharishona halcha ureuya lehasegir, deen pisyon metamme vattechilla:
Tame. umachlito:
Haya gavoah shete komot. umappilo mishsham laaretz:
Hofcho al matnav. shekkeshehu mushkav perakdan megunne yoter:
Hamegaddef. mevarech et Adonai:
Vehaoved avoda zara. nammi megaddef hu. dichtiv (Bamidbar 15) vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama vegomer‏ et Adonai‏ hu megaddef, veotah parasha baavoda zara medabberet:

Veen danin shenayim beyom echad. bevet din echad. mishshum delo matze leappoche vizchutayhu dechol chad vechad. ella teliyyatan shel nashim hallalu horaat shaa hayta veen lemedim mimmenna. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Meshakkein. noatzim:
Vehaetz yotze mimmenna. kemin yated haya yotze min hakkora samuch leroshah:
Umakkif. somech zo etzel zo. kemo litrom shello min hammukkaf [eruvin daf lev]:
Vetolin oto. beyadav:

Hakkora mutta al hakkotel. lo hayta neutza vaaretz ella roshah echad al haaretz veroshah echad mutte venismach al hakkotel. vetaama derabbi yose, lefi shehaetz shennitla alav nikbar immo, veamra tora ki kavor tikberennu, mi sheeno mechussar ella kevura, yatza ze shemmechussar chafira telisha ukevura. verabbanan, chafira lav kelum hi, velo miata tora ella shello yihye haetz bimchubbar meikkaro. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ufasta chachatzi geris. letzad hammizrach:
Vehalach min haom kachatzi geris. letzad hammaarav:
Terae vattechilla. dachashiv kenega acher, venega chadash hu ze, veyasgir:
Vachachamim metaharim. dela chashiv pisyon ella im ken mosif al shiur hannega shehaya vattechilla, veze sheeno achshav ella chaggeris, nechshav karishon sheamad beenav, vetahor:

Muttar lehakeriv labbeer. happassin, velaasot hekkef katzar. uvilvad sheyyehe missefat habbeer ad ben happassin kede roshah verubbah shel para shehen shete ammot, aval batzir mehachi lo, shemma yimmashech achar parato veyotzi haddeli chutz lammechitztza:
Muttar leharechik kol shehu. laasot hekkef gadol kemo shellibbo chafetz:

Uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin. dechol ma shemmarchik min habbor marbe barevach shebben happassin, vetzarich leharebot befassin ad kede shello yehe ben pashut lefashut [uven pashut lidyumed] yoter mishshelosh esre amma ushelish, kedivre rabbi yehuda shehalacha kemoto:

Baheret kaggeris. merubba uretzua shel basar chay berochav kaadasha makkefet otah missaviv, ulechutz leoto vasar chay makkefet baheret kaggeris missaviv, vahare yesh kan shete veharot, achat penimit veachat chitzona, umichya mafseket benehen saviv:
Happenimit lehasegir. deen lah michya beemtzaah:
Vehachitzona lehachelit. demichya hammakkefet lappenimit siman tuma lachitzona, shehare hi mevutztzeret beemtzaah:

Shehabbaheret betochah. lefi shehabbaheret letochah enah chashuva siman tuma lachitzona, devainan mevutztzeret, nega mikkan venega mikkan umichya vaemtza, [beli hefsek davar acher betoch hammichya], vehacha yesh kan nega umichya venega umichya venega. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Nitmaata hammichya. sheppasta habbaheret aleha:
Vehalcha lah. o shehalcha lah kullah:
Im mibbifnim hi chalta. shebbaheret happenimit kisseta hammichya:
Siman pisyon lappenimit. umachlitah, shehare fasta mibbachutz:
Vehachitzona tehora. shehalcha michyatah o nitmaata mikkaadasha:
Im mibbachutz. shehabbaheret hachitzona kisseta hammichya:
Hachitzona tehora. shennitmaata michyatah o halcha, ufisyon lekka, sheen hannega pose letochah:
Vehappenimit lehasegir. shehannega amad beenav:
Ben kach uven kach. ben kalta mibbifnim ben kalta mibbachutz:
Tehora. shekkeshem sheim pasta hachitzona lammichya shebbetochah eno fisyon, kach kesheppasta happenimit lammichya shebbetoch habbaheret hachitzona eno fisyon. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Halach sear lavan. shehuchlat baavuro:
Vechazar sear lavan. acher tachtav:
Vechen bemichya vechen befisyon. o shello chazar sear lavan, ella shennolda vo michya shehi gam ken siman tuma, o sheppasa hannega:

Battechilla besof shavua rishon. kelomar, ben shehahechlet haya vattechilla keshehuva el hakkohen, ben besof shavua rishon, ben besof shavua sheni, ben leachar happetur kegon sheamad beenav shene shavuot ufetaro veachar happetur ba sear lavan vehechlito, bechol hane gavne im halach lo sear lavan vechazar sear lavan, o michya o fisyon, hare hi kemot shehayta. kelomar nishar betuma kemo shehaya, hoil veyesh bo siman tuma, af al pi sheen ze oto siman shehaya vishat hechlet:
Vechazar happisyon vechen besear lavan. ha dela katane hacha vechen bemichya, lefi shekkeshehalach happisyon uvat hammichya, peamim sheyyihye tahor, kegon shehammichya miata hannega mikkaggeris:
Baheret kaggeris. belo mekom michya. dehaynu tesha adashot baheret, vaadasha achat michya. eser adashot ben hakkol:
Geris. hen tesha adashot, umichya en pachot meadasha. vechol hecha ditninan baheret, hu haddin lishar marot chalakot ufetuchot:
Vehalcha hammichya. shebba hannega al mekomah:
Halach sear lavan. shennashar, o hafach leshachor:
Rabbi shimon metaher. ahalcha michya kae:
Shello hafachattu vaheret. shessear lavan kadam labbaheret shel mekom hammichya:

Shello hafachattu vaheret kaggeris. shessear lavan kadam labbaheret kaggeris, dimkom hammichya haya chaser mikkaggeris. vechan nammi lo faleg rabbi shimon ella ahalcha michya. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Gufah shel baheret. kaggeris. chatzi fol:
Hakkilki. shem makom. ufolin shebbo gedolim:
Merubba. vezehu shiur metzumtzam shebbevaheret. veim haya hannega agol o al tzura acheret, im yesh bo chede sheyyikkanes betoch hannega kaggeris hakkilki merubba, tame, veim lav, tahor:
Mearvin bidmay. bechikkar shellekachah meam haaretz velo hifrish mimmenna terumat maaser shel demay:
Uvemaaser rishon kulei‏ aval lo vetevel vechulei. kullan meforashin bemassechet shabbat perek mefannin:
Hashsholeach et eruvo beyad cheresh kulei. leholicho lesof alpayim amma. vedavka beeruve techumin eno eruv im shelacho beyad katan, aval beeruve chatzerot kayma lan katan gove et haeruv:
Beyad mi sheeno mode vaeruv. kegon kuti o tzedoki:
Veim amar leacher. kasher, lekabbelo min happasul veyolichennu hakkasher lesof alpayim amma:
Hare ze eruv. uvilvad sheyyehe hu omed veroe beshaa shehappasul notno leyad hakkasher, af al pi sheeno roe keshehakkasher molicho, dachazaka shaliach ose shelichuto:
Ad sheyyefaresh et hashshem. vivarech hashshem bashshem. shenneemar (sham 24) venokev shem Adonai, (sham) benakvo shem, sheyyinkov hashshem bashshem:
Bechol yom. kol zeman shehayu nosim venotnim bivdikat haedim:
Hayu danin otan bechinnuy. kol adam shemmehappech davar umedabber kemi shemmekallel vetole veacher karuy kinnuy bilshon chachamim. uvilshon mikra, ki lo yadati achanne (Iyov 32):
Yakke yose et yose. ani shamati mippene shehu ven arba otiyyot veole vegimatriyya elohim, lechach mechanne shem ben arba otiyyot leyose:
Nigmar haddin. uvaim bet din lomar chayyav hu, lo hayu yecholim lehargo al pi edut zo sheshshamu, shehare lo shamu mippihem ella killat kinnuy:
Ella motziim et kol haadam lachutz. dignay hu lehashemia birkat hashshem larabbim:
Vekorin velo meachin. olamit. tefira alekkesanderit sheen hakkeria nikkeret, aval shear tefirot muttar:
Af ani shamati chamohu. veeno tzarich lehazekir birkat shem bashshem:
Vehashshelishi omer. atya cheman deamar ma shenayim edut achat af shelosha edut achat:

Ellu veharot tehorot. shehayu vo kodem mattan tora. mi shehayta bo tzaraat kodem mattan tora, lo haya tame mechamat oto nega leachar mattan tora, dichtiv (Vayikra 13) adam ki yihye veor besaro, perat laze shekkevar haya. vechol hane nammi dachashiv, mehatam nafke, devainan sheyyivvaled hannega beshaa sherauy littamme vo velo kodem, kemo ger ad shello nitgayyer vekatan ad shello nolad, vechen kullam:
Bekemet venitgalla. shehaya mittechilla hannega mustar betoch hakkemet vehaya tahor mippene shehu vevet hassetarim, veachar kach nitgalla:
Uvammordim. kelomar bishchin umichva hammordim shello nitrappeu velo heelu kerum kiklippat hashshum:

Ad shello heelu sear. ba hannega, dachashive keor basar, hayenu techillatan tuma. ucheshealu searot, have tohora, sheddinan bintakim. ucheshennikrechu, hayenu sofan tuma. vechen shechin umichva vekedach dead shello vau ba hannega, hayenu tuma. ucheshebba hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach, hayenu tohora. devainan sheyyakdim hashshechin vehammichva lasseet, dichtiv (Vayikra 13) vehaya bimkom hashshechin seet, sheyyakdim hashshechin lasseet velo shettakdim hasseet lashshechin. keshechazru venaasu tzarevet, hayenu tuma:
Vechayu. shennitrappeu yafe:
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov metamme. kevan devattechilla ba hannega beor habbasar vechazar sofo lekadmuto, lo chayshinan lehefsek shebbentayim:
Vachachamim metaharim. hoil vehifsik hattohora shebbentayim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Yesh besear. shessear lavan metamme vattechilla. keshehuva el hakkohen veyesh bannega sear lavan, tame. ma sheen ken befisyon, sheeno metamme ella vesof shavua:

Umetamme vechol mare loven. afillu lematta mearbaa marot, dichtiv (Vayikra 13) umare hannega amok, mare hannega amok velo mare sear lavan amok. ma sheen ken befisyon, sheen pisyon metamme lematta mearbaa marot, shebbeotan marot shehaom metamme, happisyon metamme:
Veen bo siman tohora. veillu befisyon yesh bo siman tohora, sheim parach bechullo tahor:
Metamme vechol shehu. aval sear lavan eno metamme befachot mishshete searot, demiut sear shetayim:
Chutz min hannega. kesheppasa chutz lannega, tame. aval sear lavan bainan sheyyehe vannega, kedichtiv (Vayikra 13) vesear bannega hafach lavan:

Hayu vodkin otan. achar sheiyyemu alehen hayu vodkin otan: besheva chakirot. keneged shiva leshonot shenneemru vammikra bechayyave mitot bet din, vedarashta vechakarta veshaalta hetev (Devarim 13), hare chan shelosha. veshaalta eno min hamminyan, shemmimmennu lamadnu vedikot. uvemakom acher hu omer (sham 17) vehuggad lecha veshamata vedarashta hetev, yesh kan shenayim acherim, hare lecha chamishsha, uvemakom acher omer (sham 19) vedarshu hashshoftim hetev, shenayim acherim, hare chan shiva:
Beeze shavua. shel yovel:
Beezo shana. shel shavua:
Beeze yom. shel shabbat:
Beezo shaa. shel yom. shekkol sheva chakirot hallalu meviot otan lide hazamma, veshemma en edim lahazimman lechol hayyom veyesh edim lahazimman leotah shaa:

Rabbi yose omer. en tzarich ella shalosh chakirot, beeze yom beezo shaa beeze makom. veen halacha kerabbi yose, ella afillu amru haedim etmol harago, bodkin otan besheva chakirot, kede shettittaref datan alehen veyodu im yesh pesul beedutan:

Makkirin attem oto. heharug. shemma nachri hu. vezo enah min hachakirot shemmeviot lide hazamma, ella chishar bedikot sheenan ella laasot haedut muchcheshet, shemma lo yomar haechad kedivre chavero, vehu vehen yihyu feturim:
Et mi avad. lifor o lemarkulis:
Uvamme avad. bezibbuach o vehishtachavaya:
Mi sheyyashav badderech. lanuach, velo haya yodea shehaya bitchum hair, vechashcha lo sham, uchesheamad raa shehu samuch lair uvitchumah:
Lo yikkanes. lair lihyot keanshe hair, ella mimmakom shechashcha lo yimdod alpayim amma vead makom sheyyichlu yelech bair vetu lo:
Rabbi yehuda omer yikkanes. veyelech kol hair vechutza lah alpayim amma kivne hair. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Belo mitkavven. shello yada keshechashcha lo shehu bitchum hair, velo nitkavven lihyot shevitato bair ella bimkomo:
Veim eno makkir. ilan o gader:
O sheeno vaki vahalacha. veeno yodea sheyyoil lo kesheyyomar shevitati bemakom peloni. veamar shevitati bimkomo. zacha lo mekomo:

Agullot. divare miklat deminnayhu yalfinan alpayim amma shel techum shabbat ketiv (Bamidbar la) [ze yihye lahem migreshe hearim]. laze atta noten peot, dehaynu zaviyyot vei atta noten peot leshovte shabbat. verabbanan devau merubbaot darshi ze leribbuye, kaze yihyu kol shovte shabbat. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ketavla merubbaat. katav harambam lefi shei efshar laasot merubba metzumtzam bechiuun, tana ketavla merubbaat, kelomar kederech shebbene adam regilim lerabbea, af al pi sheeno merubba betzimtzum:
Niskar et hazzaviyyot. arba happeot shebbaalachsono shel merubba haodfot al haiggul shebbetocho:
Nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanin. umeatta tzerichin lissa velitten baddavar:
Potchin bizchut. im lo avarta al tira:
Amar achad min haedim yesh li lelammed alav zechut. afillu zechut, vechol shekken chova. meshattekim oto, dichtiv (Bamidbar la) veed echad lo yaane, ben lizchut ben lechova:
Amar achad min hattalmidim. hayyoshvim lifne haddayyanim. yesh li lelammed alav chova:
Meshattekin oto. dichtiv (sham) veed echad lo yaane venefesh lamut, lamut hu deeno one, ha lizchut one:
Eno yored mishsham kol hayyom. vaafillu sheen mammash bidvarav. aval yesh mammash bidvarav, eno yored mishsham leolam:
Ad sheyyekallelem bashshem. beechad min hashshemot hameyuchadim:
Killelam bechinnuy. rachum, channun, erech appayim:

Echad dine mamonot vechulei‏ shenneemar mishpat echad yihye lachem. uvedine nefashot ketiv (Devarim 13) vedarashta vechakarta. vezehu din tora. aval amru chachamim sheen maarichin bidrisha vachakira bedine mamonot, shello tinol delet bifne lovin. ella im ken rau vet din shehaddin merumme. uderisha vachakira hu hashsheela vainyan beatzmo, kegon kamma hilvahu umatay hilvahu uveeze inyan hilvahu uveeze makom hilvahu. veyesh min acher min hashsheela shennikret bedika, veeno vainyan beatzmo, kegon sheyyishalu lo me haya lavush, kelim shechorim o chelim levanim, omed haya o yoshev beshaa shehilvahu:
Potchim. massao umattano shel din. ben lizchut ben lechova:
Machazirin. sotrin et haddin achar sheggemaruhu veyadu shettau:
Veen hakkol melammedin chova. sheim amar echad min hattalmidim yesh li lelammed alav chova en shomin lo:
Danim bayyom vegomrin ballayla. dichtiv (Shemot 18) veshaftu et haam bechol et, uchetiv (Devarim 21) vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav, ha chetzad, yom litchillat din, velayla ligmar din:
Danin bayyom vegomrin bayyom. dichtiv (Bamidbar 25) vehoka otam laAdonai‏ neged hashshamesh:
Gomrim bo vayyom ben lizchut ben lechova [vechulei]. deamar kera (yeshaya 1) meleati mishpat tzedek yalin bah:

Lefichach en danim lo veerev shabbat. shennimtza gemar dino veshabbat, ulehashhoto achar shabbat i efshar mippene innuy haddin, uleduno vo vayyom i efshar, sheen arba mitot bet din dochin et hashshabbat, shenneemar (Shemot la) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat, limmed al mechuyyave serefa sheen sorfin otan beshabbat, vehu haddin lishar chayyave mitot:
Nitakkel habbasar. kevar nitkapper lo vemitato uvevizyono:
Melakketin et haatzamot. vekovrim otan bekivrot avotan:

Velo hayu mitabbelim. kede sheyyehe vizyonan kappara lahem. veit deamre, lefi shehaavelut chala mishsheyyissatem haggolel, uveotah shaa en mitabbelim alehem, shello nigmera chapparatan ad sheyyitakkel habbasar, vehoil veiddeche haavelut iddeche:
Ad shettehe naara. velo ketanna pechuta mibbat shetem esre shana veyom echad, velo vogeret sheavru aleha shetem esre shana veshishsha chodashim veyom echad:
Betula. velo veula. veim nivala shello chedarkah adayin betula hi. vaafillu vau aleha asara vene adam kullam shello chedarkah, kullam biskila:
Meorasa. velo nesua:
Vehi vevet aviha. sheim masar haav lishluche habbaal, habba aleha achar kach eno viskila ella vechenek:
Afillu hi kevet kor. appelugta dilel kae agginna vekarpef:

Anshe chatzer sheshshachach achad mehem velo erev. ulemachar bittel reshut chatzero lachaverav, shehaya oser alehen millehotzi mibbattehen lechatzer, shehechatzer birshut kullan vechelko oser aleha. hoil uvittel reshut chatzero bittel af reshut beto, af al pi shello peresh, venaasa oreach etzlam, lefichach af beto muttar lahem. aval asur lo lehachenis ulehotzi mibbeto lechatzer, af al pi shehu muttar lehachenis ulehotzi mibbattehem lechatzer kishar kol adam hannichnas levet chavero shemmuttar lo lehotzi mibbet chavero lechatzer, deha reshuta dechad hu, mikkol makom mibbeto asur hu lehotzi. velo amrinan kevan devittel lehu reshut beto hare beto kevattehem, divshaa shemmotzi mibbeto lechatzer chozer umachazik birshuto hu veoser alehen, keditnan behaddar im haoved kochavim, mi shennatan reshuto vechazar vehotzi ben beshogeg ben bemezid hare ze oser:
Sheyyotzin beakravnin befesach. mishshum maror. veakravnin yerek shealin shello domot leakrav. vaani shamati siv haggadel sevivot haddekel:

Uvikkashti li chaver. lishlosha devarim hallalu im shama mippiv, velo matzati. veen halacha keechad mehen. degabbe ginna vekarpef lo share tefe mibbet satayim. veanshe chatzer sheshshachach echad mehen velo erev uvittel reshuto velo bittel beto, af lahem asur beto, aval mibbattehem lechatzer muttar. veakravnin lav maror hu veen adam yotze bo yede chovato befesach:
Meayyemin al haedim. shello yaidu sheker:
Meomed. shehaddaat nota shehu chen:
Dine mamonot. im heid lechayyev laze mamon shello chaddin, machaziro lo umitkapper:
Lefichach nivra yechidi. lehareotcha shemmeadam echad nityashshev milluo shel olam:
Rashuyyot harebe. elohut harebe yesh vechol echad bara et shello:
Ma lanu velatztzara hazzot. lehachenis roshenu vidaga zo vaafillu al haemet:
Vahalo chevar neemar vehu ed. vechayyavin attem lehaggid ma sheritem:
Veshemma tomru ma lanu lachuv. lihyot mechuyyavim bedamo shel ze, noach lanu laamod beim lo yaggid:
Hare hu omer uvaavod reshaim rinna. veim rasha hu en kan avon kelal:
Ravta habbaheret. mibbachutz:
Temea. shehare fasta vaor:
Nitmaata tehora. vaafillu hayta hammichya kaadasha:
Ravta hammichya. venaaset kaadasha, temea:
Nitmaata. sheppasta habbaheret aleha:
Rabbi meir metamme. dachashiv leh pisyon mibbifnim kemo mibbachutz:
Vachachamim metaharim. defisyon shebbifnim la chashiv pisyon. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ufasta chachatzi geris vaod kulei‏ rabbi akiva metamme. mishshum veod deishtayyar bah min happisyon. uvefasta leachar happetur ayre:
Vachachamim metaharin. dechevan daazal leh chatzi geris min haom, lekka minnega chadash ella chatzi geris veod:
Ufasta chaggeris vaod. leachar happetur, veachar kach halcha lah kol haom velo nishtayyer ella haggeris vaod hechadash:
Rabbi akiva metamme. deha fasa leh mishshiur kamma. verabbanan savre, kevan daazal leh kamma kulleh, vehay nega dekae chadash, terae vattechilla veyasgir:
Mi shehotziuhu ovde chochavim. leanso, chutz lattechum:
O ruach raa. shennichnas bo shed venitrefa dato veyatza chutz lattechum, vechazar venishtappa vahare hu chutz lattechum:

Hecheziruhu letoch hattechum keillu lo yatza. vahare kol hair lo kearba ammot kaasher bitchilla vechutzah lah alpayim amma lechol ruach, vedavka keshehotziuhu vehechziruhu beal karcho. aval yatza ledato af al pi shehechziruhu beal karcho, o hotziuhu beal karcho vechazar ledato, en lo ella arba ammot:
Holichuhu leir acheret. vahare hi mukkefet mechitztzot, o shennetanuhu vedir o vesahar shehen mukkafin vehekkefan gadol:
Mehallech et kullah. dehoil umukkefet mechitztzot hare hi kearba ammot:

Rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva omrim en lo ella arba ammot. dechevan delo shavat baavir mechitztzot mibbeod yom lo mehanne leh mechitztzot. verabbotay pershu mishshum degazre dir vesahar attu bika sheen lah mechitztzot, uvevika kulle alma modu deen lo ella arba ammot:
Mipperandisin. shem makom:
Vehifliga. keshehi mitracheket missefat hayyam venichneset beemtzao kare hafelaga, lashon palge mayim (tehillim 1):

Hillechu et kullah. hayu mehallechin bechol hassefina. veaf al pi shehassefina halcha beshabbat veyatzu chutz lattechum, have kemi sheyyatza chutz lattechum venittan bedir o vesahar, shehassefina mukkefet mechitztzot:

Sheratzu lehachamir al atzman. dildidhu nammi degazre dir vesahar attu bika, bisfina kol zeman shehi mehallechet haya muttar lehallech et kullah, veod shehare shavtu baavir mechitztzot mibbeod yom, ella sheratzu lehachemir. vahalacha kerabban gamliel ucherabbi elazar ben azarya:
Maavirin oto lemachar. maavirin et haddin ad lemachar, mishshum halanat haddin:
Shenem asar mechayyevin veachad asar mezakkin. vehattayatcha leraa al pi echad leta, hilkach yosifu dayyanim:

Vaafillu shenayim veesrim mezakkin o mechayyevin veechad omer eni yodea yosifu dayyanim. dehay deamar eni yodea keman deleteh dami, veen danin dine nefashot lo lizchut velo lechova befachot mishshelosha veesrim:

Shenayim shenayim. im nitchalleku hashshenayim shehosifu ze lechan veze lechan, deakkatti lekka hattaya lo letova al pi echad velo leraa al pi shenayim, tzarich lehosif od shenayim. vechen ad shivim veechad:

Ad sheyyire echad min hamechayyevim divre hamezakkin. deikka hattaya letova al pi echad. vehu haddin im yire echad min hamezakkim divre hamechayyevim, devishat gemar din kayma lan deaf hamelammed zechut yachol lelammed chova. vehay delo tane o ad sheyyire echad min hamezakkin divre hamechayyevin, detanna azzechut kamhaddar:
Baheret uvah michya ufisyon. baheret kaggeris vehisgiro, ulesof shavua matza vo michya ufisyon vehechlito:
Halcha hammichya. kegon shebba aleha hannega, temea habbaheret mippene happisyon:
Halach happisyon. kegon shekkansa habbaheret vechazra lechaggeris:
Vechen sear lavan ufisyon. im halach haechad, tame mippene hashsheni:
Halcha vechazra vesof hashshavua. kegon shehisgiro al baheret kaggeris, vehalcha habbaheret beemtza hashshavua, uvesof hashshavua chazra:
Hare hi chemot shehayta. umasgiro hesger sheni:

Leachar happetur. deraa otah hakkohen besof shavua keshehalcha lah ufetaro, im achare chen chazra, terae vattechilla. vehay chazra hayenu bimkomah harishon, dei vemakom acher, im ken hare zo baheret acheret:
Hayta azza. kashsheleg, keshehisgiro: venaaset keha.
Besof shavua rishon, kegon kesid o chikrum. o shehayta chikrum bishat hesger, venaaset azza chashsheleg besof shavua rishon:
Hare hi chemot shehayta. uteuna hesger sheni, kemo amad beenav:
Uvilvad shello titmaet mearbaa marot. sheim nitmaata mearbaa marot, potro miyyad vetahor:
Kansa ufasta. hecha dehisgirah bevaheret kaggeris, uvesof shavua kansa, veachar kach pasta et mekom hakkinnus velo yoter. o sheppasta vesof shavua, veachar kach kansa et mekom happisyon velo yoter:
Rabbi akiva metamme. shehare fasa:
Vachachamim metaharim. sheen ze fisyon, ella hare hi kemo shehayta. vei kae besof shavua rishon, masgiro hesger sheni. vei kae besof shavua sheni, potro vetahor:
Rabbi yehuda omer ad bet satayim. lo yaase hekkef gadol labbeer ella ad bet satayim:
Leginna ulekarpef. sheen hekkefan ledira:
Karpef. hekkef gadol chutz lair lehachenis sham etzim leotzar:
Dir. shel behemot sheosin bassadot hayyom kan ulemachar kan kede lezabbelah biglale behema:
Sachar. [hekkef mechitztza] labbehemot bair. veit degarse sahar, bet haasurim:
Chatzer. makom megulle shellifne habbattim:
Muktze. rechava sheachore habbattim, dechol hane hekkefan ledira hu. vehane passe beraot nammi hoil umemehen reuyot lishtiyyat adam tashmish mealleyuta hu:

Umuttar leharechik kol shehu. kelomar keshem shekkol ellu shehukkefu ledira afillu gedolim ad eser korim muttar letaltel bahem, kach muttar leharechik hahekkef shel passe beraot kol ma shellibbo chafetz, vechen halacha:

Venolda vaheret kachatzi geris uvah shete searot hare zo lehachelit. kol hecha ditnan uvah shete searot o uvah saara achat, lav daatu searot uvaheret bahade hadade, ella devaheret kadma veachar kach bau searot:
Veim sear lavan kodem levaheret tahor. dichtiv (Vayikra 13) vehi hafcha sear lavan, habbaheret hi sheggarma lassear sheyyehafech lelavan:
Safek tame. safek im sear lavan kadam labbaheret, o vaheret kadma lesear lavan, tame:
Verabbi yehoshua kiha. garsinan. milleshon tikhena shinnav. kelomar, hayu shinnav kehot middivre haomer safek tame. deihu savar safek tahor. veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Shezze yada beibburo shel chodesh. ze sheamar bishnayim yada shehachodesh sheavar male haya, veyom rishon shel chodesh shehu yom sheloshim, mechodesh sheavar haya. vedavka ad chatzi hachodesh, aval mechatzi hachodesh vaelach edutan betela, shechazaka en over chatzi hachodesh ad shekkol haolam yodim matay kiddeshu vet din hachodesh:
Rabbi yehuda omer kayyemet. daavid eynash detae chulle hay:
Chamma vammizrach. mimmekom zerichat hachamma ad emtza harakia karuy mizrach, umeemtza harakia ad mekom hashshekia karuy maarav:

Veshalosh shurot. vechol shura shel esrim ushelosha talmide chachamim. shemma yechalku haddayyanim veyihyu rubban mechayyevin umiutan mezakkin, vehattaya leraa enah al pi echad kedichtiv (Shemot 23) lo tihye achare rabbim leraot, vetzarich lehosif shenayim shenayim ad shivim veechad, shelleolam en mosifin al haddayyanim yoter mishshivim veechad, hilkach tzarich lehoshiv lifnehem arbaim ushemona lehashelamat shivim veechad. velav orach ara laasot shurot talmidim merubbe mishshel dayyanim, hilkach avdinan shalosh shurot:
Vechol echad makkir et mekomo. lefi shekkeseder chachmatam hayu moshivim otam, lefichach haya chol echad tzarich lehakkir et mekomo:
Hutzrechu lismoch. kegon shemmet echad min haddayyanim:

Velo haya yoshev bimkomo shel rishon. velo haya oto shennivrar min hakkahal yoshev bimkomo shel rishon, ella vemakom harauy lo besof shura hashshelishit. lefi shehakkatan min hattalmidim shebbashshurot, gadol min haggadol shebbakkahal:
Makkifin shelosha chavalim. ashsheyara shechanta babbika kae:

Ze lemala mizze. al gabbe yetedot saviv, min hachevel hattachton lakkarka pachot mishshelosha, vahare keillu kullo omed, dechol pachot mishshelosha kelavud dami, umimmennu laemtzai pachot mishshelosha, hare omed shishsha tefachim pachot shene mashshehuyin bishne haavirin, umeemtzai laelyon pachot mishshelosha, hare tisha tefachim omed bishlosha haavirin pachot shelosha mashshehuyin:
Shiur ovi hachavalim yoter al tefach. shelosha mashshehuyin, kede sheyyehe ben hakkol asara tefachim:
Baheret kaggeris ufasta chaggeris. besheppasta leachar happetur ayre:
Rabbi akiva metamme. deyesh kan nega vesiman tuma immo:

Terae vattechilla. veaf al gav dichshetterae vattechilla nammi yetammeenna hakkohen miyyad, demichya vesear lavan metammeim battechilla, mikkol makom nafka minna dilrabbanan bae atoye karban akkol chad vechad. ulerabbi akiva kenega rishon chashuv, vechi mittasse mehay mayte chad karban. uvechol hanach diflige rabbi akiva vachachamim bematnitin, halacha kachachamim:
Veen bah kelum. en bah sear lavan:

Uvah saara achat venolda vaheret kulei‏ hare zo lehasegir. veaf al pi shekkadam kaggeris baheret lassear haacharon, kevan delo kadma et harishon, lo mahane, devainan shettakdim kaggeris baheret lishte hassearot:
Baheret kachatzi geris uvah shete searot kulei‏ hare zo lehasegir. veaf al gav dachatzi geris harishon kadam lishte searot, lo mahane, ad sheyyakdim haggeris shalem lishte searot:
Ravta habbaheret. mibbachutz:
Temea. mishshum pisyon:
Nitmaata tehora. delekka chaggeris:
Ravta hammichya. vechansa habbaheret:
Tehora. deen hammichya mevutztzeret, devainan baheret kaadasha mikkol tzad saviv lammichya:

Veod amar rabbi yehuda ven bava. mishshum deamar chada lechumra gabbe passin, deamar en osin otan ella liver harabbim, vehasheta kaamar chumra acharita deaf bemukkaf ledira lo share tefe mibbet satayim, mishshum hachi tana veod:
Shomera. sukkat shomrim. deaf al gav dehukkaf ledira, bet satayim hu deshare, tefe lo:
Semucha lair. dehoil ukerova leveto dato lehishtammesh bah tamid uchemukkaf ledira dami:

Uvilvad shettehe shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim. velo yoter. vetanna kamma nammi dilel deamru lo lo amru bet satayim ella lakkarpef velagginna aval im haya dir o sahar o chatzer vechulei, kerabbi akiva kaamar, dehecha deikka bet dira afillu tuva nammi, ucheshello hukkaf ledira bet satayim. umay benayhu, amrinan baggemara deikka benayhu davar muat, shebbet satayim yoter al shivim amma veshirayim revuim, vetanna kamma share bevet satayim shelemim, ulerabbi akiva shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim vetu lo. vechetzad yadanu devet satayim yoter al shivim amma veshirayim revuim, deha amrinan baggemara vechamma hen satayim, kachatzar hammishkan, vachatzar hammishkan ketiv beh (Shemot 27) orech hechatzer mea baamma verochav chamishshim bachamishshim, vedarshinan may chamishshim bachamishshim, amra tora tol chamishshim shearko yater al rachbo vesabbev chamishshim hannotarim leshiur shabbat, dahavu lehu shivim amma vearbaa tefachim merubbaim. ketzad, ase mehem chamesh retzuot shel eser amma rochav vearkan chamishshim, ten achat lemizrachah veachat lemaaravah, hare rachbah shivim vearkah chamishshim, sim achat laddarom veachat latztzafon, hare shivim al shivim, ella shehakkeranot pegumim lechol keren vekeren eser al eser mippene hattosefet shehosafta. tol min hartzua hachamishshit arba chatichot shel eser [al eser] vesim learba keranot, venitmalleu. tol eser al eser hannotarim shehem shishshim tefachim [al shishshim tefachim] vaase otam retzuot shel shene tefachim, hare sheloshim retzuot orech kol achat eser ammot, shehen shelosh meot amma. ten shivim lechol ruach, hare shivim [ammot] vearbaa tefachim al shivim ammot vearbaa tefachim, ella shehakkeranot pegumim tefachayim al tefachayim, venisharu beyadcha esrim amma, tol mehem shemona tefachim vesim lakkeranot venitmalleu, venisharu beyadcha shemone esre ammot vearbaa tefachim orech berochav tefachayim, vehayenu davar muat, sheim bata lechallekan ulehakkif en maggia tosefet lerochav shene shelishe etzba, deha bae lemebad minnah retzuot shel 283 [ammot] orech lehakkif haarba ruchot. kach matzati perush shita zo beferushe Rashi, venachon hu. veharambam bikkesh cheshbonot rabbim velo yaradti lesof dato. uvamme sheamar rabbi akiva afillu en bah echad meellu metaltelim betochah, hilcheta kevateh. aval bemay defaleg achachamim deamru lo dilel vesavar deshivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim vetu lo, beha halacha kachachamim. divvet satayim kachatzar hammishkan share, shehu davar muat yoter al shivim amma veshirayim revuim:

Im hayta arkah yoter al rachbah. veaf al gav demiet rachbah vehosif al arkah veen bechullah ella bet satayim, en metaltelin, dimrubba hu desharu rabbanan hecha delo hukkaf ledira. vahalacha kerabbi yose defaleg adderabbi eliezer velo bae merubbaot:

Matne adam al eruvo. meniach shene eruvin, echad lesof alpayim lemizrach beto veechad lesof alpayim lemaarav beto, veomer im bau ovde kochavim lammizrach vetzarich ani livroach mippenehem yikne li eruvi shebbammaarav veyihyu li lemaarav beti arbaat alafim amma. veaf al gav delo atu ad lemachar, amrinan yesh berera, deven hashshemashot kana leh eruva deidach gisa:
Hareni chivne iri. alpayim meiri lechol ruach, veeni tzarich lehistakker lechan ulehafsid mikkan:
Im ba chacham lammizrach. chutz litchum iri verotze ani lilmod mippiv, veachshav eni yodea leeze tzad yavo, ulemachar eshma mibbene adam habbaim mishsham lechan al yede eruv:

Rabbi yehuda omer. im bau mikkan umikkan, veechad mehem rabbo, yelech etzel rabbo velo etzel haacher, dekim lan begavveh devishat keniyyat eruv ben hashshemashot dateh delikne leh hahu eruv diltzad rabbeh. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda, dezimnin denicha leh leeynash bechavreh tefe merabbeh:

Ellu hen hanniskalin. it minnayhu dichtiv behu sekila vehedya, vehanach delo chetiva vehu sekila ketiv behu damav bo demehem bam, vechol makom shenneemar damav bo demehem bam eno ella sekila, deyalfinan meov veyiddeoni dichtiv (Vayikra 20) baeven yirgemu otam demehem bam:
Vehannoten mizzaro lammolech. kasavar hay tanna molech lav avoda zara hu ella chok haummot bealma hu. middetana avoda zara, vetana molech:
Vehamekallel aviv veimmo. chamur mimmakke, deikka tarte kelon aviv veimmo umotzi shem shamayim levattala, deha tenan eno chayyav ad sheyyekallelem bashshem:
Vehammesit. et hayechidim:
Vehammaddiach. ir hanniddachat:
Vehamechashshef. dichtiv (Shemot 22) mechashshefa lo techayye, usemich leh kol shochev im behema mot yumat, ma shochev im behema biskila, af mechashshefa biskila:
Habba al haem chayyav aleha. shete chattaot. divchullehu arayot [ketiv behu charet uchetiv behu chilluk chattaot]. vaafillu veguf echad. vechen halacha:
Ben min haerusin. dechevan shekkiddeshah, ishto hi, dichtiv (Vayikra 20) veish asher yikkach et ishsha, mishsheat lekicha nikret ishto. vehach kicha kiddushin hen, degamar kicha kicha missede efron:
Ben zakkay. rabban yochanan ben zakkay. vetalmid dan lifne rabbo haya beotah shaa, lechach koro ben zakkay:
Beuktze teenim. shehayu meidim alav sheharago tachat hatteena. uvadak ben zakkay, teena zo uktzeha dakkim o gassim. oketz, zenav happeri mekom chibburo lailan:

Amar echad eni yodea edutan betela. deshuv i atta yachol lahazimman beotah chakira, vechol zeman shei efshar lekayyem torat hazamma veechad min haedim, kol haedut betela, vaafillu hen mea, deen haedim naasim zommim ad sheyyizzomu chullan:
Bedikot. afillu amru chullan en anu yodim, mitzvat hazamma reuya lehitkayyem, deen hazamma teluya ella vachakira lomar immanu heyitem beotah shaa bemakom acher:
Edutan betela. kol edutan betela. [shebbaggemara], hu vehen peturim:

Hayu shenayim. omdim rachok ze mizze shesh ammot, demuvlain shete ammot shel kol echad letoch shel chavero, meviin veochlin betoch shete ammot. uvilvad shello yifshot ze yado letoch shetayim hachitzonot sheen lo bahem kelum veyotzi lesham pitto o chafatzav:
Vehaemtzai muvla benehem. shete ammotav betoch shel ze ushete ammotav betoch shel ze. hu muttar im kol echad, pone lechan umishtammesh im ze ufone lechan umishtammesh im ze:
Leshalosh chatzerot. vehem zo etzel zo:
Petuchot lirshut harabbim. dechol achat reshut leatzmah veen lahem derisat haregel zo al zo, dehashta enan osrot zo al zo:

Ervu shetehen im haemtzait hi mutteret immahen vechulei. verabbanan afligu aleh derabbi shimon beha veamre kullan asurot zo vazzo. vehasheta kaamar lehu rabbi shimon vahalo ze haddavar shehayu shalosh vehaemtzai muvla bentayim veattem modim shehu muttar immahen vehem muttarim immo dome leshalosh chatzerot, veammay kamippallegitu alay beshalosh chatzerot, veamre leh rabbanan hatam beshalosh chatzerot mittoch shemmerubbim hem shetayim hachitzonot haasurot zo bezo yavou lehotzi mizzo lezo, vehaemtzait lo yehavah addatah velo madkera lehu, deamre shemma echad middiyyure haemtzait shemmuttar bazzo uvazzo hu shemmotzi. aval hacha bishlosha anashim i ate chad mishshene hachitzonim laafoke letoch shete ammot shel hachitzon haacher, haemtzai yahev addateh umadkar leh. vahalacha kerabbi shimon beshalosh chatzerot, sheshshete hachitzonot bilvad asurot zo im zo:
